```ts
// src/lib/landing/registration/config.ts
// Registration settings, stored in page content as content.registration.
// Pure module (no server-only imports): used by the editor, the public widget and the API.
import { z } from "zod";
import { isSafeUrl } from "../simple-text";

export type Mode = "live" | "recorded";
export const MODES = ["live", "recorded"] as const;
export type RegistrationStatus = "pending" | "paid" | "underpaid" | "reserved" | "free";

export interface RegionDef { key: string; label: string; currency: string; classTime: string; timezoneLabel: string; accountKeys: string[] }
// key: short upper-case code such as "PK" | "UAE" | "KSA" | "PH" | "IN" | "INTL"; currency ISO code such as "PKR"
export interface OptionDef { key: string; label: string; kind: "bundle" | "module"; free: boolean; waGroupUrl: string }
// waGroupUrl: "" or https://chat.whatsapp.com/<code>. An option is offered in a region only when prices[option][region] exists.
export interface TierDef { key: string; label: string; minSize: number; maxSize: number; percentOff: number }
// "individual" is implicit (size 1, 0%) and is NOT listed in tiers. Fixed-size tier: minSize === maxSize.
export interface PriceCell {
  amount: number;                              // regular per-person price in the region currency
  earlyAmount?: number;                        // per-person Early Bird price
  groupTotals?: Record<string, number>;        // explicit TOTAL per fixed-size tier, used when Early Bird is NOT applied
  earlyGroupTotals?: Record<string, number>;   // explicit TOTAL per fixed-size tier, used when Early Bird IS applied
}
export interface RegistrationConfig {
  enabled: boolean;
  modes: Mode[];
  recordedPercentOfRegular: number;    // recorded price = round(regular * pct / 100), ignores Early Bird
  regions: RegionDef[];
  defaultRegionKey: string;
  options: OptionDef[];
  moduleMix: { enabled: boolean; bundleOptionKey: string };
  tiers: TierDef[];
  prices: Record<string, Record<string, PriceCell>>;   // prices[optionKey][regionKey]
  earlyBirdEndsAt: string;             // ISO-8601 WITH offset; "" = no Early Bird
  capacity: number;                    // 0 = unlimited; counts people, excludes test rows
  whatsappVerifyNumber: string;        // digits only, e.g. "923700199429"
  successTitle: string;
  eventLabel: string;                  // used in the WhatsApp verify message and the Sheet
  refPrefix: string;                   // "PPC" -> PZA-PPC-001
  professions: string[];               // [] = free-text profession field
  discoveryOptions: string[];
  pixelId: string;                     // "" = global default (NEXT_PUBLIC_META_PIXEL_ID)
}

export const INDIVIDUAL = "individual";
export const MAX_GROUP_SIZE = 50;
export const WA_GROUP_URL_RE = /^https:\/\/chat\.whatsapp\.com\/[A-Za-z0-9]{10,40}$/;
export const REGION_KEY_RE = /^[A-Z]{2,6}$/;
export const ITEM_KEY_RE = /^[a-z0-9_]{1,32}$/;
export const ACCOUNT_KEY_RE = /^[a-z0-9_]{2,40}$/;
export const CURRENCY_RE = /^[A-Z]{3}$/;
export const REF_PREFIX_RE = /^[A-Z0-9]{2,6}$/;
const PIXEL_RE = /^\d{0,20}$/;
const MAX_MONEY = 10_000_000;

export const DEFAULT_REGISTRATION: RegistrationConfig = {
  enabled: false,
  modes: ["live"],
  recordedPercentOfRegular: 100,
  regions: [],
  defaultRegionKey: "",
  options: [],
  moduleMix: { enabled: false, bundleOptionKey: "" },
  tiers: [],
  prices: {},
  earlyBirdEndsAt: "",
  capacity: 0,
  whatsappVerifyNumber: "",
  successTitle: "Registration received!",
  eventLabel: "",
  refPrefix: "",
  professions: [],
  discoveryOptions: [],
  pixelId: "",
};

// ------------------------------------------------------------ schema (structural only)

const money = z.number().min(0).max(MAX_MONEY);
const amountMap = z.record(z.string().max(32), money);
const text = (max: number) => z.string().max(max);

export const registrationConfigSchema: z.ZodType<RegistrationConfig> = z.object({
  enabled: z.boolean(),
  modes: z.array(z.enum(MODES)).max(2),
  recordedPercentOfRegular: z.number().int().min(1).max(100),
  regions: z.array(z.object({
    key: text(6),
    label: text(80),
    currency: text(3),
    classTime: text(80),
    timezoneLabel: text(80),
    accountKeys: z.array(text(40)).max(8),
  })).max(12),
  defaultRegionKey: text(6),
  options: z.array(z.object({
    key: text(32),
    label: text(120),
    kind: z.enum(["bundle", "module"]),
    free: z.boolean(),
    waGroupUrl: text(200).refine((v) => v === "" || isSafeUrl(v), "Enter a full link starting with https://"),
  })).max(12),
  moduleMix: z.object({ enabled: z.boolean(), bundleOptionKey: text(32) }),
  tiers: z.array(z.object({
    key: text(32),
    label: text(80),
    minSize: z.number().int().min(1).max(MAX_GROUP_SIZE),
    maxSize: z.number().int().min(1).max(MAX_GROUP_SIZE),
    percentOff: z.number().min(0).max(90),
  })).max(6),
  prices: z.record(text(32), z.record(text(6), z.object({
    amount: money,
    earlyAmount: money.optional(),
    groupTotals: amountMap.optional(),
    earlyGroupTotals: amountMap.optional(),
  }))),
  earlyBirdEndsAt: text(40),
  capacity: z.number().int().min(0).max(100_000),
  whatsappVerifyNumber: text(20),
  successTitle: text(80),
  eventLabel: text(80),
  refPrefix: text(6),
  professions: z.array(text(80)).max(30),
  discoveryOptions: z.array(text(80)).max(30),
  pixelId: z.string().regex(PIXEL_RE, "The Pixel ID is digits only."),
});

// ------------------------------------------------------------ tolerant loader

function isRecord(v: unknown): v is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof v === "object" && v !== null && !Array.isArray(v);
}
const BAD_KEYS = new Set(["__proto__", "constructor", "prototype"]);
const okKey = (k: string, max: number) => k.length >= 1 && k.length <= max && !BAD_KEYS.has(k);
const str = (v: unknown, max: number, fallback = "") => (typeof v === "string" ? v.slice(0, max) : fallback);
const isMoney = (v: unknown): v is number => typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v) && v >= 0;
const num = (v: unknown, min: number, max: number, fallback: number) =>
  typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v) ? Math.min(max, Math.max(min, v)) : fallback;
const int = (v: unknown, min: number, max: number, fallback: number) => Math.round(num(v, min, max, fallback));
const strList = (v: unknown, maxItems: number, maxLen: number): string[] =>
  Array.isArray(v) ? v.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === "string").slice(0, maxItems).map((x) => x.slice(0, maxLen)) : [];
function list<T>(v: unknown, max: number, f: (x: Record<string, unknown>) => T | null): T[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(v)) return [];
  return v.filter(isRecord).map(f).filter((x): x is T => x !== null).slice(0, max);
}

function amountRecord(v: unknown): Record<string, number> | undefined {
  if (!isRecord(v)) return undefined;
  const out: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const [k, x] of Object.entries(v)) if (okKey(k, 32) && isMoney(x)) out[k] = Math.min(x, MAX_MONEY);
  return Object.keys(out).length > 0 ? out : undefined;
}

function priceCell(v: unknown): PriceCell | null {
  if (!isRecord(v) || !isMoney(v.amount)) return null;
  const cell: PriceCell = { amount: Math.min(v.amount, MAX_MONEY) };
  if (isMoney(v.earlyAmount)) cell.earlyAmount = Math.min(v.earlyAmount, MAX_MONEY);
  const g = amountRecord(v.groupTotals);
  if (g) cell.groupTotals = g;
  const eg = amountRecord(v.earlyGroupTotals);
  if (eg) cell.earlyGroupTotals = eg;
  return cell;
}

/** Tolerant loader for anything read from the database or a snapshot. Never throws; always fresh objects. */
export function normalizeRegistration(raw: unknown): RegistrationConfig {
  const r = isRecord(raw) ? raw : {};
  const prices: Record<string, Record<string, PriceCell>> = {};
  if (isRecord(r.prices)) {
    for (const [optionKey, byRegion] of Object.entries(r.prices)) {
      if (!okKey(optionKey, 32) || !isRecord(byRegion)) continue;
      const row: Record<string, PriceCell> = {};
      for (const [regionKey, c] of Object.entries(byRegion)) {
        if (!okKey(regionKey, 6)) continue;
        const cell = priceCell(c);
        if (cell) row[regionKey] = cell;
      }
      if (Object.keys(row).length > 0) prices[optionKey] = row;
    }
  }
  const mm = isRecord(r.moduleMix) ? r.moduleMix : {};
  const rawModes = r.modes;
  return {
    enabled: r.enabled === true,
    modes: Array.isArray(rawModes) ? MODES.filter((m) => rawModes.includes(m)) : [...DEFAULT_REGISTRATION.modes],
    recordedPercentOfRegular: int(r.recordedPercentOfRegular, 1, 100, 100),
    regions: list(r.regions, 12, (x) => (typeof x.key === "string"
      ? {
          key: str(x.key, 6), label: str(x.label, 80), currency: str(x.currency, 3),
          classTime: str(x.classTime, 80), timezoneLabel: str(x.timezoneLabel, 80), accountKeys: strList(x.accountKeys, 8, 40),
        }
      : null)),
    defaultRegionKey: str(r.defaultRegionKey, 6),
    options: list(r.options, 12, (x) => (typeof x.key === "string"
      ? {
          key: str(x.key, 32),
          label: str(x.label, 120),
          kind: x.kind === "module" ? ("module" as const) : ("bundle" as const),
          free: x.free === true,
          waGroupUrl: typeof x.waGroupUrl === "string" && (x.waGroupUrl === "" || isSafeUrl(x.waGroupUrl)) ? x.waGroupUrl.slice(0, 200) : "",
        }
      : null)),
    moduleMix: { enabled: mm.enabled === true, bundleOptionKey: str(mm.bundleOptionKey, 32) },
    tiers: list(r.tiers, 6, (x) => (typeof x.key === "string"
      ? {
          key: str(x.key, 32), label: str(x.label, 80),
          minSize: int(x.minSize, 1, MAX_GROUP_SIZE, 2), maxSize: int(x.maxSize, 1, MAX_GROUP_SIZE, 2),
          percentOff: num(x.percentOff, 0, 90, 0),
        }
      : null)),
    prices,
    earlyBirdEndsAt: str(r.earlyBirdEndsAt, 40),
    capacity: int(r.capacity, 0, 100_000, 0),
    whatsappVerifyNumber: str(r.whatsappVerifyNumber, 20),
    successTitle: str(r.successTitle, 80, DEFAULT_REGISTRATION.successTitle),
    eventLabel: str(r.eventLabel, 80),
    refPrefix: str(r.refPrefix, 6),
    professions: strList(r.professions, 30, 80),
    discoveryOptions: strList(r.discoveryOptions, 30, 80),
    pixelId: typeof r.pixelId === "string" && PIXEL_RE.test(r.pixelId) ? r.pixelId : "",
  };
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------ readiness (plain words)

/** ISO-8601 with an explicit Z or +hh:mm offset, so every visitor sees the same cutoff instant. */
export function isValidInstant(v: string): boolean {
  const s = v.trim();
  return /(Z|[+-]\d{2}:\d{2})$/.test(s) && Number.isFinite(Date.parse(s));
}

function duplicates(keys: string[]): string[] {
  return [...new Set(keys.filter((k, i) => keys.indexOf(k) !== i))];
}

export function registrationProblems(r: RegistrationConfig): { message: string }[] {
  const out: { message: string }[] = [];
  const add = (message: string) => out.push({ message });
  const name = (label: string, key: string) => (label.trim() === "" ? key : label);

  if (r.modes.length === 0) add("Choose Live, Recorded or both (Registration setup).");
  if (r.regions.length === 0) add("Add at least one country people can register from (Registration setup).");
  if (r.options.length === 0) add('Add at least one thing people can buy, for example "Full Course" (Registration setup).');

  for (const k of duplicates(r.regions.map((x) => x.key))) add(`Two countries use the same code "${k}". Give each country its own code.`);
  for (const g of r.regions) {
    if (!REGION_KEY_RE.test(g.key)) add(`The country code "${g.key}" must be 2 to 6 capital letters, for example PK.`);
    if (g.label.trim() === "") add(`Give the country "${g.key}" a name.`);
    if (!CURRENCY_RE.test(g.currency)) add(`Set the currency for ${name(g.label, g.key)} as a 3-letter code, for example PKR.`);
  }
  if (r.regions.length > 0 && !r.regions.some((g) => g.key === r.defaultRegionKey)) {
    add("Choose which country is selected first (Registration setup).");
  }

  for (const k of duplicates(r.options.map((o) => o.key))) add(`Two options use the same code "${k}". Give each option its own code.`);
  for (const o of r.options) {
    if (!ITEM_KEY_RE.test(o.key)) add(`The option code "${o.key}" must use small letters, digits or _ only.`);
    if (o.label.trim() === "") add(`Give the option "${o.key}" a name.`);
    if (o.waGroupUrl.trim() !== "" && !WA_GROUP_URL_RE.test(o.waGroupUrl.trim())) {
      add(`The WhatsApp group link for "${name(o.label, o.key)}" must look like https://chat.whatsapp.com/...`);
    }
  }

  for (const k of duplicates(r.tiers.map((t) => t.key))) add(`Two group discounts use the same code "${k}".`);
  for (const t of r.tiers) {
    if (!ITEM_KEY_RE.test(t.key) || t.key === INDIVIDUAL) add(`"${name(t.label, t.key)}" needs a different code (small letters, digits or _, not "individual").`);
    if (t.minSize < 2) add(`"${name(t.label, t.key)}" must be for at least 2 people.`);
    if (t.maxSize < t.minSize) add(`"${name(t.label, t.key)}": the largest group size cannot be smaller than the smallest.`);
  }

  if (r.moduleMix.enabled && !r.options.some((o) => o.key === r.moduleMix.bundleOptionKey && o.kind === "bundle")) {
    add("Choose which bundle replaces every module when someone picks them all (Registration setup).");
  }

  for (const o of r.options) {
    const row = r.prices[o.key] ?? {};
    if (o.free) {
      if (!r.regions.some((g) => row[g.key] !== undefined)) {
        add(`"${name(o.label, o.key)}" is free but not offered in any country. Tick at least one country for it.`);
      }
      continue;
    }
    for (const g of r.regions) {
      const cell = row[g.key];
      if (!cell) add(`Add the price of "${name(o.label, o.key)}" for ${name(g.label, g.key)}.`);
      else if (cell.earlyAmount !== undefined && cell.earlyAmount > cell.amount) {
        add(`The Early Bird price of "${name(o.label, o.key)}" for ${name(g.label, g.key)} is higher than the regular price.`);
      }
    }
  }

  const allFree = r.options.length > 0 && r.options.every((o) => o.free);
  if (!allFree) {
    for (const g of r.regions) {
      if (g.accountKeys.length === 0) add(`Choose at least one payment account for ${name(g.label, g.key)}.`);
      for (const k of g.accountKeys) if (!ACCOUNT_KEY_RE.test(k)) add(`The payment account "${k}" for ${name(g.label, g.key)} is not a known account code.`);
    }
  }

  if (r.earlyBirdEndsAt.trim() !== "" && !isValidInstant(r.earlyBirdEndsAt)) {
    add("The Early Bird end date is not a valid date and time.");
  }
  if (!REF_PREFIX_RE.test(r.refPrefix)) {
    add("Set a short code for reference numbers: 2 to 6 capital letters or digits, for example PPC (Registration setup).");
  }
  if (r.eventLabel.trim() === "") {
    add('Give the registration a short name for messages and the Sheet, for example "PPC Batch 3" (Registration setup).');
  }
  if (!allFree || r.whatsappVerifyNumber !== "") {
    if (!/^\d{8,15}$/.test(r.whatsappVerifyNumber)) {
      add("The WhatsApp number for payment checks must be digits only with the country code, for example 923700199429.");
    }
  }
  return out;
}
```

### Task 3: Pricing engine

**Files:**
- Create: `src/lib/landing/registration/pricing.ts`
- Test: `tests/landing-registration-pricing.test.ts`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes (Task 2): `RegistrationConfig`, `PriceCell`, `TierDef`, `OptionDef`, `Mode`, `INDIVIDUAL` from `src/lib/landing/registration/config.ts`; fixtures `ppcConfig()`, `mdcConfig()`, `w20Config()`, `PPC_EB_ENDS`, `DURING_PPC_EB`, `AFTER_PPC_EB`, `DURING_MDC_EB`, `AFTER_MDC_EB` from `tests/fixtures/landing-registration.ts`.
- Produces (`src/lib/landing/registration/pricing.ts`, pure):
  - `interface QuoteInput { config: RegistrationConfig; regionKey: string; mode: Mode; optionKeys: string[]; tierKey: string; groupSize: number; now: Date }`
  - `type QuoteResult` exactly as the contract (`ok: true` fields `currency, regionKey, mode, optionKeys, tierKey, groupSize, earlyBirdApplied, isFree, listPerPerson, perPerson, total, savings`; `ok: false` reasons `"no_region" | "no_option" | "no_price" | "bad_tier" | "bad_group_size" | "mode_not_offered" | "free_group" | "mixed_free"`). `optionKeys` in an ok result is the RESOLVED selection (after the module-mix collapse, in config order) - use it for the sheet, the option label, promo checks and WhatsApp groups.
  - `computeQuote(i: QuoteInput): QuoteResult`, `isEarlyBird(config: RegistrationConfig, now: Date): boolean`
  - Helpers later tasks use: `resolveOptionKeys(config: RegistrationConfig, optionKeys: string[]): string[]` (drops unknown keys, de-duplicates, config order, applies `moduleMix`), `availableOptions(config: RegistrationConfig, regionKey: string): OptionDef[]` (options with a price cell in that region; the widget lists only these).
- Rules (contract + Task 2's `earlyGroupTotals`): Early Bird = live mode and `now < earlyBirdEndsAt` (absolute instant; `""` or unparsable = never). Recorded = `Math.round(amount * recordedPercentOfRegular / 100)` per option, never Early Bird, never explicit totals. Group tier: `perPerson = Math.round(base * (100 - percentOff) / 100)` (same as `base * (1 - off/100)` without float drift), `total = perPerson * groupSize`; override when exactly one option, live mode and the cell has `earlyGroupTotals[tier]` (Early Bird applied) or `groupTotals[tier]` (not applied): `total` = that value, `perPerson = Math.round(total / groupSize)`. Check order: region, mode, option keys, free/paid mix, group size and tier, price cells, free group.

```ts
// tests/landing-registration-pricing.test.ts
import { describe, it, expect } from "vitest";

import {
  ppcConfig, mdcConfig, w20Config, PPC_EB_ENDS, DURING_PPC_EB, AFTER_PPC_EB, DURING_MDC_EB, AFTER_MDC_EB,
} from "./fixtures/landing-registration";

const ppc = (p: Partial<QuoteInput> = {}) =>
  computeQuote({ config: ppcConfig(), regionKey: "PK", mode: "live", optionKeys: ["full"], tierKey: "individual", groupSize: 1, now: DURING_PPC_EB, ...p });
const mdc = (p: Partial<QuoteInput> = {}) =>
  computeQuote({ config: mdcConfig(), regionKey: "PK", mode: "live", optionKeys: ["workshop"], tierKey: "individual", groupSize: 1, now: DURING_MDC_EB, ...p });
const w20 = (p: Partial<QuoteInput> = {}) =>
  computeQuote({ config: w20Config(), regionKey: "PK", mode: "live", optionKeys: ["pro"], tierKey: "individual", groupSize: 1, now: AFTER_PPC_EB, ...p });

describe("isEarlyBird", () => {
  it("is an absolute instant: on until the millisecond before the cutoff, off at the cutoff", () => {
    const c = ppcConfig();
    const end = Date.parse(PPC_EB_ENDS);
    expect(isEarlyBird(c, new Date(end - 1))).toBe(true);
    expect(isEarlyBird(c, new Date(end))).toBe(false);
    expect(isEarlyBird(c, new Date(end + 1))).toBe(false);
  });
  it("is never on without a valid end date", () => {
    expect(isEarlyBird({ ...ppcConfig(), earlyBirdEndsAt: "" }, DURING_PPC_EB)).toBe(false);
    expect(isEarlyBird({ ...ppcConfig(), earlyBirdEndsAt: "soon" }, DURING_PPC_EB)).toBe(false);
  });
});

      ok: true, currency: "PKR", regionKey: "PK", mode: "live", optionKeys: ["full"], tierKey: "individual", groupSize: 1,
      earlyBirdApplied: true, isFree: false, listPerPerson: 6000, perPerson: 4800, total: 4800, savings: 1200,

  it("after Early Bird: 6,000 individual, 14,400 for 3 (the Early Bird total is not reused), 22,500 for 5", () => {
    expect(ppc({ now: AFTER_PPC_EB })).toMatchObject({ ok: true, total: 6000, earlyBirdApplied: false, savings: 0 });
    expect(ppc({ now: AFTER_PPC_EB, tierKey: "group3", groupSize: 3 })).toMatchObject({ total: 14400, perPerson: 4800, savings: 3600 });
    expect(ppc({ now: AFTER_PPC_EB, tierKey: "group5", groupSize: 5 })).toMatchObject({ total: 22500, perPerson: 4500 });

});

describe("PPC modules", () => {
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement the engine**

```ts
// src/lib/landing/registration/pricing.ts
// The one price calculation. The server recomputes every quote with this; the widget uses it for display only.
import { INDIVIDUAL, type Mode, type OptionDef, type PriceCell, type RegistrationConfig, type TierDef } from "./config";

export interface QuoteInput {
  config: RegistrationConfig;
  regionKey: string;
  mode: Mode;
  optionKeys: string[];
  tierKey: string; // "individual" or a TierDef.key
  groupSize: number;
  now: Date;
}

export type QuoteResult =
  | {
      ok: true; currency: string; regionKey: string; mode: Mode; optionKeys: string[]; tierKey: string; groupSize: number;
      earlyBirdApplied: boolean; isFree: boolean;
      listPerPerson: number; // regular (non-early) per-person price, for strike-through
      perPerson: number;     // price per person after Early Bird / recorded / tier
      total: number;         // total due for the whole registration BEFORE promo
      savings: number;       // listPerPerson * groupSize - total, >= 0
    }
  | { ok: false; reason: "no_region" | "no_option" | "no_price" | "bad_tier" | "bad_group_size" | "mode_not_offered" | "free_group" | "mixed_free" };

type Failure = Extract<QuoteResult, { ok: false }>;
const fail = (reason: Failure["reason"]): Failure => ({ ok: false, reason });

export function isEarlyBird(config: RegistrationConfig, now: Date): boolean {
  if (config.earlyBirdEndsAt.trim() === "") return false;
  const end = Date.parse(config.earlyBirdEndsAt);
  return Number.isFinite(end) && now.getTime() < end;
}

/** Known keys only, no duplicates, in config order; every module (or the bundle itself) collapses to the bundle. */
export function resolveOptionKeys(config: RegistrationConfig, optionKeys: string[]): string[] {
  const wanted = new Set(optionKeys);
  let keys = config.options.filter((o) => wanted.has(o.key)).map((o) => o.key);
  const mm = config.moduleMix;
  if (mm.enabled && config.options.some((o) => o.key === mm.bundleOptionKey)) {
    const modules = config.options.filter((o) => o.kind === "module").map((o) => o.key);
    const hasBundle = keys.includes(mm.bundleOptionKey);
    const allModules = modules.length > 0 && modules.every((k) => keys.includes(k));
    if (hasBundle || allModules) {
      const rest = keys.filter((k) => k !== mm.bundleOptionKey && !modules.includes(k));
      keys = config.options.map((o) => o.key).filter((k) => k === mm.bundleOptionKey || rest.includes(k));
    }
  }
  return keys;
}

/** Options that have a price in this region (a free option is offered where it has a 0 cell). */
export function availableOptions(config: RegistrationConfig, regionKey: string): OptionDef[] {
  return config.options.filter((o) => config.prices[o.key]?.[regionKey] !== undefined);
}

const sum = (xs: number[]) => xs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);

export function computeQuote(i: QuoteInput): QuoteResult {
  const { config } = i;
  const region = config.regions.find((r) => r.key === i.regionKey);
  if (!region) return fail("no_region");
  if (!config.modes.includes(i.mode)) return fail("mode_not_offered");
  if (i.optionKeys.length === 0 || i.optionKeys.some((k) => !config.options.some((o) => o.key === k))) return fail("no_option");

  const keys = resolveOptionKeys(config, i.optionKeys);
  const opts = keys.map((k) => config.options.find((o) => o.key === k) as OptionDef);
  const freeCount = opts.filter((o) => o.free).length;
  if (freeCount > 0 && freeCount < opts.length) return fail("mixed_free");

  if (!Number.isInteger(i.groupSize) || i.groupSize < 1) return fail("bad_group_size");
  let tier: TierDef | null = null;
  if (i.tierKey === INDIVIDUAL) {
    if (i.groupSize !== 1) return fail("bad_group_size");
  } else {
    tier = config.tiers.find((t) => t.key === i.tierKey) ?? null;
    if (!tier) return fail("bad_tier");
    if (i.groupSize < tier.minSize || i.groupSize > tier.maxSize) return fail("bad_group_size");
  }

  const cells = keys.map((k) => config.prices[k]?.[region.key]);
  if (cells.some((c) => c === undefined)) return fail("no_price");
  const priced = cells as PriceCell[];

  const head = { currency: region.currency, regionKey: region.key, mode: i.mode, optionKeys: keys, tierKey: i.tierKey, groupSize: i.groupSize };
  if (freeCount === opts.length) {
    if (tier) return fail("free_group");
    return { ok: true, ...head, earlyBirdApplied: false, isFree: true, listPerPerson: 0, perPerson: 0, total: 0, savings: 0 };
  }

  const early = i.mode === "live" && isEarlyBird(config, i.now);
  const pct = config.recordedPercentOfRegular;
  const regular = (c: PriceCell) => (i.mode === "recorded" ? Math.round((c.amount * pct) / 100) : c.amount);
  const effective = (c: PriceCell) => (i.mode === "recorded" ? regular(c) : early && c.earlyAmount !== undefined ? c.earlyAmount : c.amount);

  const listPerPerson = sum(priced.map(regular));
  const unit = sum(priced.map(effective));
  const earlyBirdApplied = early && priced.some((c) => c.earlyAmount !== undefined && c.earlyAmount !== c.amount);

  let perPerson = unit;
  let total = unit;
  if (tier) {
    const cell = priced[0];
    const usesEarly = early && cell.earlyAmount !== undefined;
    const explicit = keys.length === 1 && i.mode === "live"
      ? (usesEarly ? cell.earlyGroupTotals : cell.groupTotals)?.[tier.key]
      : undefined;
    if (explicit !== undefined) {
      total = explicit;
      perPerson = Math.round(explicit / i.groupSize);
    } else {
      perPerson = Math.round((unit * (100 - tier.percentOff)) / 100);
      total = perPerson * i.groupSize;
    }
  }

  const savings = Math.max(0, listPerPerson * i.groupSize - total);
  return { ok: true, ...head, earlyBirdApplied, isFree: false, listPerPerson, perPerson, total, savings };
}
```

### Task 4: Promo rules and WhatsApp group selection

**Files:**
- Create: `src/lib/landing/registration/promo.ts`
- Create: `src/lib/landing/registration/wa-groups.ts`
- Test: `tests/landing-registration-promo.test.ts`, `tests/landing-registration-wa-groups.test.ts`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `WA_GROUP_URL_RE`, `Mode`, `RegistrationConfig` (Task 2, `config.ts`); `resolveOptionKeys(config, optionKeys): string[]` (Task 3, `pricing.ts`); fixtures `ppcConfig()`, `w20Config()`, `WA` (Task 2).
- Produces:
  - `promo.ts` (pure): `interface PromoCode` and `type PromoResult` exactly as the contract (note the contract spelling `oneperEmail`); `type PromoFailureReason = Extract<PromoResult, { ok: false }>["reason"]`; `applyPromo(p: { promo: PromoCode | null; pageId: string; optionKeys: string[]; currency: string; total: number; now: Date; emailAlreadyUsed: boolean }): PromoResult`; `promoMessage(reason: PromoFailureReason): string`. Callers pass the RESOLVED `quote.optionKeys` and `quote.total`. Check order: unknown, inactive, not_started, expired, exhausted, wrong_page, wrong_option, already_used. `optionKeys` on a code means every selected option must be in that list. Percent codes are capped by `maxDiscountPercent` (0 = no cap); fixed codes read `fixedAmounts[currency]` (missing = `wrong_option`) and are also capped by `maxDiscountPercent` when it is set; `discount` is rounded and clamped to `[0, total]`.
  - `wa-groups.ts` (pure): `interface WaGroupButton { label: string; url: string }` (`label` = the option's label; the UI writes "Join … group" around it); `isValidWaGroupUrl(url: string): boolean`; `selectWaGroups(config: RegistrationConfig, optionKeys: string[], mode: Mode): WaGroupButton[]`. Rules: recorded = `[]`; after resolving the selection, if it contains any `bundle` option only the bundle groups are shown; otherwise one button per selected option with a valid link, in config order.

```ts
// tests/landing-registration-promo.test.ts
import { describe, it, expect } from "vitest";
import { applyPromo, promoMessage, type PromoCode, type PromoFailureReason } from "@/lib/landing/registration/promo";

const NOW = new Date("2026-10-13T12:00:00Z");
const promo = (p: Partial<PromoCode> = {}): PromoCode => ({
  id: "promo-1", code: "PPC10", type: "percent", value: 10, fixedAmounts: {}, maxDiscountPercent: 0,
  pageIds: [], optionKeys: [], maxUses: null, usedCount: 0, oneperEmail: false,
  startsAt: null, endsAt: null, active: true, ownerAgentId: null, ...p,
});
const apply = (p: PromoCode | null, extra: Partial<Parameters<typeof applyPromo>[0]> = {}) =>
  applyPromo({ promo: p, pageId: "page-1", optionKeys: ["full"], currency: "PKR", total: 4800, now: NOW, emailAlreadyUsed: false, ...extra });

describe("applyPromo: amounts", () => {
  it("takes 10% off the Early Bird individual total: 4,800 -> 4,320", () => {
    expect(apply(promo())).toEqual({ ok: true, promoId: "promo-1", code: "PPC10", discount: 480, total: 4320 });
  });
  it("applies after the group price: 10% of the 11,500 group total", () => {
    expect(apply(promo(), { total: 11500 })).toMatchObject({ ok: true, discount: 1150, total: 10350 });
  });
  it("rounds the discount to a whole amount", () => {
    expect(apply(promo(), { total: 4805 })).toMatchObject({ discount: 481, total: 4324 });
  });
  it("caps a percent code at max_discount_percent", () => {
    expect(apply(promo({ value: 50, maxDiscountPercent: 30 }))).toMatchObject({ discount: 1440, total: 3360 });
  });
  it("never discounts more than the total", () => {
    expect(apply(promo({ value: 150 }))).toMatchObject({ discount: 4800, total: 0 });
    expect(apply(promo({ type: "fixed", value: 0, fixedAmounts: { PKR: 9999 } }))).toMatchObject({ discount: 4800, total: 0 });
  });
  it("uses the per-currency amount for a fixed code, capped by max_discount_percent", () => {
    expect(apply(promo({ type: "fixed", fixedAmounts: { PKR: 500, USD: 5 } }))).toMatchObject({ discount: 500, total: 4300 });
    expect(apply(promo({ type: "fixed", fixedAmounts: { USD: 5 } }), { currency: "USD", total: 44 })).toMatchObject({ discount: 5, total: 39 });
    expect(apply(promo({ type: "fixed", fixedAmounts: { PKR: 2000 }, maxDiscountPercent: 10 }))).toMatchObject({ discount: 480 });
  });
  it("a free registration stays free", () => {
    expect(apply(promo(), { total: 0 })).toMatchObject({ ok: true, discount: 0, total: 0 });
  });
});

describe("applyPromo: refusals", () => {
  it("unknown when there is no code", () => expect(apply(null)).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "unknown" }));
  it("inactive", () => expect(apply(promo({ active: false }))).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "inactive" }));
  it("not_started before starts_at, fine from that instant", () => {
    expect(apply(promo({ startsAt: "2026-10-14T00:00:00Z" }))).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "not_started" });
    expect(apply(promo({ startsAt: NOW.toISOString() }))).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
  });
  it("expired from ends_at on", () => {
    expect(apply(promo({ endsAt: NOW.toISOString() }))).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "expired" });
    expect(apply(promo({ endsAt: "2026-10-13T12:00:01Z" }))).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
  });
  it("exhausted when every use is taken; unlimited when max_uses is null", () => {
    expect(apply(promo({ maxUses: 20, usedCount: 20 }))).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "exhausted" });
    expect(apply(promo({ maxUses: 20, usedCount: 19 }))).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
    expect(apply(promo({ maxUses: null, usedCount: 5000 }))).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
  });
  it("wrong_page when the code is for other pages", () => {
    expect(apply(promo({ pageIds: ["page-2"] }))).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "wrong_page" });
    expect(apply(promo({ pageIds: ["page-2", "page-1"] }))).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
  });
  it("wrong_option unless every chosen option is covered", () => {
    expect(apply(promo({ optionKeys: ["m1"] }))).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "wrong_option" });
    expect(apply(promo({ optionKeys: ["m1"] }), { optionKeys: ["m1", "m2"] })).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "wrong_option" });
    expect(apply(promo({ optionKeys: ["m1", "m2", "m3"] }), { optionKeys: ["m1", "m2"] })).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
  });
  it("wrong_option for a fixed code without an amount in this currency", () => {
    expect(apply(promo({ type: "fixed", fixedAmounts: { PKR: 500 } }), { currency: "AED", total: 160 })).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "wrong_option" });
  });
  it("already_used only when the code is one per email", () => {
    expect(apply(promo({ oneperEmail: true }), { emailAlreadyUsed: true })).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "already_used" });
    expect(apply(promo({ oneperEmail: false }), { emailAlreadyUsed: true })).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
  });
  it("reports inactive before expired", () => {
    expect(apply(promo({ active: false, endsAt: "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z" }))).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "inactive" });
  });
});

describe("promoMessage", () => {
  it("gives a distinct plain sentence for every reason", () => {
    const reasons: PromoFailureReason[] = ["unknown", "inactive", "not_started", "expired", "exhausted", "wrong_page", "wrong_option", "already_used"];
    const texts = reasons.map(promoMessage);
    for (const t of texts) expect(t).toMatch(/^[A-Z].+\.$/);
    expect(new Set(texts).size).toBe(reasons.length);
    expect(promoMessage("expired")).toBe("This promo code has expired.");
  });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/landing/registration/promo.ts
// Pure promo-code rules. The server is the only place a code takes effect (legacy codes were never checked).

export interface PromoCode {
  id: string;
  code: string;
  type: "percent" | "fixed";
  value: number;                          // percent for "percent" codes
  fixedAmounts: Record<string, number>;   // per-currency amount for "fixed" codes
  maxDiscountPercent: number;             // 0 = no cap
  pageIds: string[];                      // [] = every page
  optionKeys: string[];                   // [] = every option
  maxUses: number | null;
  usedCount: number;
  oneperEmail: boolean;
  startsAt: string | null;
  endsAt: string | null;
  active: boolean;
  ownerAgentId: string | null;
}

export type PromoResult =
  | { ok: true; promoId: string; code: string; discount: number; total: number }
  | { ok: false; reason: "unknown" | "inactive" | "not_started" | "expired" | "exhausted" | "wrong_page" | "wrong_option" | "already_used" };

export type PromoFailureReason = Extract<PromoResult, { ok: false }>["reason"];

const fail = (reason: PromoFailureReason): PromoResult => ({ ok: false, reason });

export function applyPromo(p: {
  promo: PromoCode | null;
  pageId: string;
  optionKeys: string[];
  currency: string;
  total: number;
  now: Date;
  emailAlreadyUsed: boolean;
}): PromoResult {
  const promo = p.promo;
  if (!promo) return fail("unknown");
  if (!promo.active) return fail("inactive");
  const now = p.now.getTime();
  if (promo.startsAt && now < Date.parse(promo.startsAt)) return fail("not_started");
  if (promo.endsAt && now >= Date.parse(promo.endsAt)) return fail("expired");
  if (promo.maxUses !== null && promo.usedCount >= promo.maxUses) return fail("exhausted");
  if (promo.pageIds.length > 0 && !promo.pageIds.includes(p.pageId)) return fail("wrong_page");
  if (promo.optionKeys.length > 0 && !p.optionKeys.every((k) => promo.optionKeys.includes(k))) return fail("wrong_option");
  if (promo.oneperEmail && p.emailAlreadyUsed) return fail("already_used");

  const total = Math.max(0, p.total);
  const capPct = promo.maxDiscountPercent > 0 ? promo.maxDiscountPercent : null;
  let discount: number;
  if (promo.type === "percent") {
    const pct = capPct === null ? promo.value : Math.min(promo.value, capPct);
    discount = (total * pct) / 100;
  } else {
    const amount = promo.fixedAmounts[p.currency];
    if (typeof amount !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(amount)) return fail("wrong_option");
    discount = capPct === null ? amount : Math.min(amount, (total * capPct) / 100);
  }
  discount = Math.min(total, Math.max(0, Math.round(discount)));
  return { ok: true, promoId: promo.id, code: promo.code, discount, total: total - discount };
}

const MESSAGES: Record<PromoFailureReason, string> = {
  unknown: "We could not find that promo code. Check the spelling.",
  inactive: "This promo code is no longer active.",
  not_started: "This promo code is not active yet.",
  expired: "This promo code has expired.",
  exhausted: "This promo code has been fully used.",
  wrong_page: "This promo code is not valid for this event.",
  wrong_option: "This promo code does not apply to what you chose.",
  already_used: "You have already used this promo code.",
};

export function promoMessage(reason: PromoFailureReason): string {
  return MESSAGES[reason];
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/landing/registration/wa-groups.ts
// Which WhatsApp group buttons a registration gets (success screen and emails).
import { WA_GROUP_URL_RE, type Mode, type OptionDef, type RegistrationConfig } from "./config";
import { resolveOptionKeys } from "./pricing";

export interface WaGroupButton { label: string; url: string }

export function isValidWaGroupUrl(url: string): boolean {
  return WA_GROUP_URL_RE.test(url.trim());
}

export function selectWaGroups(config: RegistrationConfig, optionKeys: string[], mode: Mode): WaGroupButton[] {
  if (mode === "recorded") return [];
  const keys = resolveOptionKeys(config, optionKeys);
  const chosen = keys
    .map((k) => config.options.find((o) => o.key === k))
    .filter((o): o is OptionDef => o !== undefined);
  const bundles = chosen.filter((o) => o.kind === "bundle");
  const shown = bundles.length > 0 ? bundles : chosen;
  return shown
    .filter((o) => isValidWaGroupUrl(o.waGroupUrl))
    .map((o) => ({ label: o.label, url: o.waGroupUrl.trim() }));
}
```

### Task 5: Submit schema and Sheet row mapping

The human option label and the WhatsApp verify message live in ONE module, `src/lib/landing/registration/labels.ts` (`registrationOptionLabel`, `buildVerifyMessage` with `isFree`, `whatsappVerifyUrl`), created by Task 8; this task does not create a second one.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/lib/landing/registration/submit-schema.ts`
- Create: `src/lib/landing/registration/sheet-row.ts`
- Test: `tests/landing-registration-submit.test.ts`, `tests/landing-registration-sheet-row.test.ts`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `Mode`, `RegistrationStatus`, `MAX_GROUP_SIZE` (Task 2).
- Produces:
  - `submit-schema.ts`: `interface Person`, `interface RegisterPayload` exactly as the contract, plus `interface Attribution { refCode: string; utm: Record<string, string>; fbp: string; fbc: string; eventId: string; sessionId: string }` and `registerPayloadSchema: z.ZodType<RegisterPayload>`. Behaviour: email trimmed + lower-cased + format-checked; name trimmed, 2-120 chars; WhatsApp 10-15 digits, only digits/space/+/-/( ) allowed; profession required (1-120); `lead.consent` must be `true`; `lead.city` / `lead.discovery` optional (default ""); `members.length === groupSize - 1` (error path `["members"]`); every email in the registration distinct (path `["members"]`); `honeypot` must be `""` (a route that wants to silently drop bots checks the raw body before parsing); `promoCode` trimmed + upper-cased; unknown top-level keys (for example a client `total`) are stripped. Attribution never blocks a registration: an over-long or malformed field becomes `""` / `{}` (`utm`: at most 10 keys, key <= 40, value <= 200 chars; `fbp` <= 200; `fbc` <= 500; `eventId`/`sessionId` <= 100; `refCode` letters/digits/`-` <= 40). `testMode` defaults to `false`.
  - `sheet-row.ts`: `SHEET_HEADERS: string[]` (23 columns A-W, exact contract order), `type SheetRowType = "individual" | "lead" | "member"`, `interface SheetRegistration` (fields below), `ROW_TYPE_LABELS`, `STATUS_LABELS`, `sheetSafe(v: string): string` (prefixes `'` to values starting with `=`, `+`, `-`, `@`, tab or CR so Sheets stores them as text), `formatSubmittedAt(iso: string): string` (`"13 Oct 2026, 19:30 PKT"`, Asia/Karachi), `toSheetRow(r: SheetRegistration): string[]` (length 23).

`SheetRegistration` fields (Part B fills them from the database rows):
`rowType, name, email, whatsapp, profession, discovery, optionLabel, promoCodeText` (what the person typed), `promoCodeUsed` (validated code or ""), `voucherUrl, submittedAt` (ISO), `expectedAmount` (whole-registration total; not shown on member rows), `currency, groupLeadEmail` (lead's email on lead and member rows, own email on individual rows, as the legacy GAS did), `paymentMethodLabel` (account label, "" for free), `amountReceived: number | null, status: RegistrationStatus, emailStatus, source, refId` (members carry the LEAD's ref, ruling 1), `regionKey, agentName, utmCampaign`.

```ts
// src/lib/landing/registration/submit-schema.ts
// The register route's request body (the `payload` JSON string). The server recomputes the price;
// nothing here is trusted for money.
import { z } from "zod";
import { MAX_GROUP_SIZE, type Mode } from "./config";

export interface Person { name: string; email: string; whatsapp: string; profession: string }
export interface Attribution { refCode: string; utm: Record<string, string>; fbp: string; fbc: string; eventId: string; sessionId: string }
export interface RegisterPayload {
  regionKey: string; mode: Mode; optionKeys: string[]; tierKey: string; groupSize: number;
  lead: Person & { city: string; discovery: string; consent: true };
  members: Person[];            // length === groupSize - 1 (0 for individual)
  paymentMethod: string;        // account key, "" for free
  promoCode: string;
  honeypot: string;             // must be ""
  attribution: Attribution;
  testMode: boolean;            // honoured only for an authenticated admin
}

const EMAIL_RE = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
const digitCount = (v: string) => v.replace(/\D/g, "").length;

const personSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().trim().min(2, "Enter the full name (at least 2 letters).").max(120, "Use 120 characters or fewer."),
  email: z.string().trim().toLowerCase().max(200, "Use 200 characters or fewer.").regex(EMAIL_RE, "Enter a valid email address."),
  whatsapp: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .max(30, "Use 30 characters or fewer.")
    .regex(/^[+\d\s()-]*$/, "Use digits only, with the country code.")
    .refine((v) => digitCount(v) >= 10 && digitCount(v) <= 15, "Enter the WhatsApp number with the country code (at least 10 digits)."),
  profession: z.string().trim().min(1, "Choose a profession.").max(120, "Use 120 characters or fewer."),
});

const emptyAttribution = (): Attribution => ({ refCode: "", utm: {}, fbp: "", fbc: "", eventId: "", sessionId: "" });

const attributionSchema = z
  .object({
    refCode: z.string().trim().max(40).regex(/^[A-Za-z0-9-]*$/).catch(""),
    utm: z
      .record(z.string().max(40), z.string().max(200))
      .refine((o) => Object.keys(o).length <= 10)
      .catch(() => ({})),
    fbp: z.string().max(200).catch(""),
    fbc: z.string().max(500).catch(""),
    eventId: z.string().max(100).catch(""),
    sessionId: z.string().max(100).catch(""),
  })
  .catch(emptyAttribution);

export const registerPayloadSchema: z.ZodType<RegisterPayload> = z
  .object({
    regionKey: z.string().trim().min(1, "Choose your country.").max(6),
    mode: z.enum(["live", "recorded"]),
    optionKeys: z.array(z.string().min(1).max(32)).min(1, "Choose what you want to register for.").max(12),
    tierKey: z.string().min(1).max(32),
    groupSize: z.number().int().min(1).max(MAX_GROUP_SIZE),
    lead: personSchema.extend({
      city: z.string().trim().max(120).default(""),
      discovery: z.string().trim().max(120).default(""),
      consent: z.literal(true, { message: "Please accept the registration terms to continue." }),
    }),
    members: z.array(personSchema).max(MAX_GROUP_SIZE - 1).default([]),
    paymentMethod: z.string().trim().max(40).default(""),
    promoCode: z.string().trim().toUpperCase().max(40).default(""),
    honeypot: z.literal("", { message: "Invalid input" }).default(""),
    attribution: attributionSchema,
    testMode: z.boolean().catch(false),
  })
  .superRefine((v, ctx) => {
    if (v.members.length !== v.groupSize - 1) {
      ctx.addIssue({
        code: "custom",
        path: ["members"],
        message: v.groupSize === 1 ? "An individual registration has no group members." : `Add the details of all ${v.groupSize - 1} group members.`,
      });
    }
    const emails = [v.lead.email, ...v.members.map((m) => m.email)];
    const dup = emails.find((e, i) => emails.indexOf(e) !== i);
    if (dup) ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", path: ["members"], message: `Each person needs their own email address (${dup} is used twice).` });
  });
```

```ts
// src/lib/landing/registration/sheet-row.ts
// One registration row -> one Sheet row, in the legacy column order (A-T) plus U-W.
import type { RegistrationStatus } from "./config";

export const SHEET_HEADERS: string[] = [
  "Name", "Email", "WhatsApp", "Profession", "Discovery", "Registration Option", "Consent", "Row Type", "Promo Code",
  "Voucher URL", "Submitted At", "Expected Amount", "Group Lead Email", "Payment Method", "Amount", "Payment Confirmation",
  "Email Confirmation", "Source", "Ref ID", "Region", "Agent", "Promo Code Used", "UTM Campaign",
];

export type SheetRowType = "individual" | "lead" | "member";

export interface SheetRegistration {
  rowType: SheetRowType;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  whatsapp: string;
  profession: string;
  discovery: string;
  optionLabel: string;
  promoCodeText: string;       // what the person typed
  promoCodeUsed: string;       // the validated code, "" when none applied
  voucherUrl: string;
  submittedAt: string;         // ISO-8601
  expectedAmount: number;      // whole-registration total; not shown on member rows
  currency: string;
  groupLeadEmail: string;      // lead's email on lead + member rows, own email on individual rows
  paymentMethodLabel: string;  // e.g. "Faysal Bank"; "" for free
  amountReceived: number | null;
  status: RegistrationStatus;
  emailStatus: string;
  source: string;
  refId: string;               // members carry the LEAD's ref
  regionKey: string;
  agentName: string;
  utmCampaign: string;
}

export const ROW_TYPE_LABELS: Record<SheetRowType, string> = { individual: "Individual", lead: "Group Lead", member: "Group Member" };
export const STATUS_LABELS: Record<RegistrationStatus, string> = { pending: "Pending", paid: "Paid", underpaid: "Underpaid", reserved: "Reserved", free: "Free" };

/** Sheets turns a value starting with = + - @ (or a tab/CR) into a formula; a leading ' keeps it as text. */
export function sheetSafe(v: string): string {
  return /^[=+\-@\t\r]/.test(v) ? `'${v}` : v;
}

const PKT = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", {
  timeZone: "Asia/Karachi", day: "2-digit", month: "short", year: "numeric", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hourCycle: "h23",
});

export function formatSubmittedAt(iso: string): string {
  const t = Date.parse(iso);
  if (!Number.isFinite(t)) return iso;
  const parts = Object.fromEntries(PKT.formatToParts(new Date(t)).map((p) => [p.type, p.value]));
  return `${parts.day} ${parts.month} ${parts.year}, ${parts.hour}:${parts.minute} PKT`;
}

export function toSheetRow(r: SheetRegistration): string[] {
  const member = r.rowType === "member";
  const cells = [
    r.name,                                                          // A Name
    r.email,                                                         // B Email
    r.whatsapp,                                                      // C WhatsApp
    r.profession,                                                    // D Profession
    r.discovery,                                                     // E Discovery
    r.optionLabel,                                                   // F Registration Option
    member ? "Covered by Group Lead consent" : "Yes — accepted T&C", // G Consent
    ROW_TYPE_LABELS[r.rowType],                                      // H Row Type
    r.promoCodeText,                                                 // I Promo Code
    r.voucherUrl,                                                    // J Voucher URL
    formatSubmittedAt(r.submittedAt),                                // K Submitted At
    member ? "" : `${r.currency} ${r.expectedAmount}`,               // L Expected Amount
    r.groupLeadEmail,                                                // M Group Lead Email
    r.paymentMethodLabel,                                            // N Payment Method
    r.amountReceived === null ? "" : String(r.amountReceived),       // O Amount
    STATUS_LABELS[r.status],                                         // P Payment Confirmation
    r.emailStatus,                                                   // Q Email Confirmation
    r.source,                                                        // R Source
    r.refId,                                                         // S Ref ID
    r.regionKey,                                                     // T Region
    r.agentName,                                                     // U Agent
    r.promoCodeUsed,                                                 // V Promo Code Used
    r.utmCampaign,                                                   // W UTM Campaign
  ];
  return cells.map((c) => sheetSafe(c));
}
```

- [ ] **Step 1: Create the shared Supabase test fake**

This is test infrastructure, not production code; the Phase 1 builder in `tests/landing-data.test.ts` stays as it is.

```ts
// tests/helpers/supabase-mock.ts
/**
 * Chainable fake of the service-role Supabase client for the Phase 2 landing tests.
 *
 * Two ways to answer queries:
 *  - handler mode: set `state.handler` to a function that scripts each reply;
 *  - memory mode: `state.handler = memoryHandler(store)` evaluates eq / neq / in / is /
 *    gte / lte / gt / lt / ilike against in-memory tables, so data layers can run end to end.
 * Every terminal call (await, single, maybeSingle) records an Op in `state.ops`.
 */
export type Res = { data: unknown; error: unknown; count?: number | null };
export type FilterKind = "eq" | "neq" | "in" | "is" | "gte" | "lte" | "gt" | "lt" | "ilike";
export interface Op {
  table: string;
  op: "select" | "insert" | "update" | "delete" | "upsert" | "rpc";
  payload?: unknown;
  filters: [FilterKind, string, unknown][];
  orders: [string, boolean][];
  limit?: number;
  single: boolean;
  count: boolean;
  head: boolean;
  returning: boolean;
  upsertOptions?: Record<string, unknown>;
}
export type Store = Record<string, Record<string, unknown>[]>;
export type RpcHandler = (fn: string, args: unknown, store: Store) => Res;

function newOp(table: string, op: Op["op"] = "select"): Op {
  return { table, op, filters: [], orders: [], single: false, count: false, head: false, returning: false };
}

export function createSupabaseMock() {
  const state: { ops: Op[]; handler: (op: Op) => Res; users: Record<string, { email: string }> } = {
    ops: [],
    handler: () => ({ data: null, error: null }),
    users: {},
  };

  function from(table: string) {
    const op = newOp(table);
    const done = () => {
      state.ops.push(op);
      return Promise.resolve(state.handler(op));
    };
    const filter = (kind: FilterKind) => (key: string, value: unknown) => {
      op.filters.push([kind, key, value]);
      return b;
    };
    const b: Record<string, unknown> = {
      select: (_cols?: string, opts?: { count?: string; head?: boolean }) => {
        if (op.op !== "select") op.returning = true;
        if (opts?.count) op.count = true;
        if (opts?.head) op.head = true;
        return b;
      },
      insert: (p: unknown) => { op.op = "insert"; op.payload = p; return b; },
      update: (p: unknown) => { op.op = "update"; op.payload = p; return b; },
      upsert: (p: unknown, o?: Record<string, unknown>) => { op.op = "upsert"; op.payload = p; op.upsertOptions = o; return b; },
      delete: () => { op.op = "delete"; return b; },
      eq: filter("eq"),
      neq: filter("neq"),
      in: filter("in"),
      is: filter("is"),
      gte: filter("gte"),
      lte: filter("lte"),
      gt: filter("gt"),
      lt: filter("lt"),
      ilike: filter("ilike"),
      order: (key: string, o?: { ascending?: boolean }) => { op.orders.push([key, o?.ascending !== false]); return b; },
      limit: (n: number) => { op.limit = n; return b; },
      maybeSingle: () => { op.single = true; return done(); },
      single: () => { op.single = true; return done(); },
      then: (res: (v: Res) => unknown, rej: (e: unknown) => unknown) => done().then(res, rej),
    };
    return b;
  }

  function rpc(fn: string, args: unknown) {
    const op = newOp(fn, "rpc");
    op.payload = args;
    state.ops.push(op);
    return Promise.resolve(state.handler(op));
  }

  const client = {
    from,
    rpc,
    auth: {
      admin: {
        getUserById: async (id: string) => ({
          data: { user: state.users[id] ? { id, email: state.users[id].email } : null },
          error: null,
        }),
      },
    },
  };

  return {
    state,
    client,
    find: (table: string, kind: Op["op"]) => state.ops.filter((o) => o.table === table && o.op === kind),
    reset: () => {
      state.ops = [];
      state.handler = () => ({ data: null, error: null });
      state.users = {};
    },
  };
}

export function filterValue(op: Op, kind: FilterKind, key: string): unknown {
  return op.filters.find(([k, f]) => k === kind && f === key)?.[2];
}

function compare(a: unknown, b: unknown): number {
  if (typeof a === "number" && typeof b === "number") return a - b;
  return String(a ?? "").localeCompare(String(b ?? ""));
}

function matches(row: Record<string, unknown>, filters: Op["filters"]): boolean {
  return filters.every(([kind, key, value]) => {
    const v = row[key];
    switch (kind) {
      case "eq": return v === value;
      case "neq": return v !== value;
      case "in": return Array.isArray(value) && value.includes(v);
      case "is": return value === null ? v === null || v === undefined : v === value;
      case "gte": return compare(v, value) >= 0;
      case "lte": return compare(v, value) <= 0;
      case "gt": return compare(v, value) > 0;
      case "lt": return compare(v, value) < 0;
      case "ilike": return typeof v === "string" && v.toLowerCase() === String(value).toLowerCase();
    }
  });
}

function shape(op: Op, rows: Record<string, unknown>[]): Res {
  const count = op.count ? rows.length : null;
  if (op.head) return { data: null, error: null, count };
  if (op.single) return { data: rows[0] ?? null, error: null, count };
  return { data: rows, error: null, count };
}

export function memoryHandler(store: Store, rpc?: RpcHandler): (op: Op) => Res {
  let seq = 0;
  return (op: Op): Res => {
    if (op.op === "rpc") {
      return rpc ? rpc(op.table, op.payload, store) : { data: null, error: { message: `no rpc ${op.table}` } };
    }
    const table = (store[op.table] ??= []);
    if (op.op === "insert" || op.op === "upsert") {
      const items = (Array.isArray(op.payload) ? op.payload : [op.payload]) as Record<string, unknown>[];
      const inserted = items.map((p) => ({ id: `${op.table}-${++seq}`, created_at: new Date().toISOString(), ...p }));
      table.push(...inserted);
      return shape(op, inserted);
    }
    const hit = table.filter((r) => matches(r, op.filters));
    if (op.op === "update") {
      for (const r of hit) Object.assign(r, op.payload as Record<string, unknown>);
      return shape(op, hit);
    }
    if (op.op === "delete") {
      store[op.table] = table.filter((r) => !hit.includes(r));
      return shape(op, hit);
    }
    let rows = [...hit];
    for (const [key, asc] of [...op.orders].reverse()) {
      rows.sort((a, b) => (asc ? 1 : -1) * compare(a[key], b[key]));
    }
    if (op.limit !== undefined) rows = rows.slice(0, op.limit);
    return shape(op, rows);
  };
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/landing/registration/utm.ts
/** The only attribution keys we store; anything else in a query string is dropped. */
export const UTM_KEYS = ["utm_source", "utm_medium", "utm_campaign", "utm_content", "utm_term"] as const;

export function cleanUtm(raw: unknown): Record<string, string> {
  const out: Record<string, string> = {};
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== "object") return out;
  for (const key of UTM_KEYS) {
    const v = (raw as Record<string, unknown>)[key];
    if (typeof v === "string" && v.trim() !== "") out[key] = v.trim().slice(0, 200);
  }
  return out;
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/data/landing-payment-accounts.ts
import "server-only";
import { createAdminSupabase } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";

export type PaymentAccountKind = "bank" | "wallet" | "paypal";
export interface PaymentAccount {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  kind: PaymentAccountKind;
  rows: { label: string; value: string }[];
  displayText: string;
}

const KINDS: readonly string[] = ["bank", "wallet", "paypal"];

function cleanRows(raw: unknown): { label: string; value: string }[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
  return raw.flatMap((r) => {
    if (!r || typeof r !== "object") return [];
    const { label, value } = r as Record<string, unknown>;
    return typeof label === "string" && typeof value === "string" ? [{ label, value }] : [];
  });
}

/**
 * The global payment-account library (seeded by migration 0069). With `keys`, only those
 * accounts come back, in the caller's order (a region lists its accounts in display order);
 * unknown keys are skipped. Throws on a read error so a route answers 500 instead of
 * showing a pay step with no accounts.
 */
export async function listPaymentAccounts(keys?: string[]): Promise<PaymentAccount[]> {
  const wanted = keys ? [...new Set(keys)] : undefined;
  if (wanted && wanted.length === 0) return [];
  const admin = createAdminSupabase();
  let query = admin.from("payment_accounts").select("key, label, kind, rows, display_text").order("key");
  if (wanted) query = query.in("key", wanted);
  const { data, error } = await query;
  if (error) throw error;
  const all: PaymentAccount[] = (data ?? []).map((r) => ({
    key: r.key,
    label: r.label,
    kind: KINDS.includes(r.kind) ? (r.kind as PaymentAccountKind) : "bank",
    rows: cleanRows(r.rows),
    displayText: r.display_text ?? "",
  }));
  if (!wanted) return all;
  return wanted.flatMap((k) => all.filter((a) => a.key === k));
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/data/landing-promo-codes.ts
import "server-only";
import { createAdminSupabase } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";
import type { Database, Json } from "@/lib/supabase/database.types";
import type { PromoCode } from "@/lib/landing/registration/promo";

type Row = Database["public"]["Tables"]["landing_promo_codes"]["Row"];
type Insert = Database["public"]["Tables"]["landing_promo_codes"]["Insert"];
type Update = Database["public"]["Tables"]["landing_promo_codes"]["Update"];

export type PromoCodeInput = Omit<PromoCode, "id" | "usedCount">;
export type PromoWriteResult = { ok: true; id: string } | { ok: false; reason: "duplicate" | "not-found" | "db-error" };

const COLUMNS =
  "id, code, type, value, fixed_amounts, max_discount_percent, page_ids, option_keys, max_uses, used_count, one_per_email, starts_at, ends_at, active, owner_agent_id";
const UNIQUE_VIOLATION = "23505";

export function normalizePromoCode(raw: string): string {
  return raw.trim().toUpperCase();
}

function numberRecord(raw: unknown): Record<string, number> {
  const out: Record<string, number> = {};
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== "object" || Array.isArray(raw)) return out;
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(raw as Record<string, unknown>)) {
    if (typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v)) out[k] = v;
  }
  return out;
}

function mapRow(r: Row): PromoCode {
  return {
    id: r.id,
    code: r.code,
    type: r.type === "fixed" ? "fixed" : "percent",
    value: Number(r.value),
    fixedAmounts: numberRecord(r.fixed_amounts),
    maxDiscountPercent: Number(r.max_discount_percent),
    pageIds: r.page_ids ?? [],
    optionKeys: r.option_keys ?? [],
    maxUses: r.max_uses,
    usedCount: r.used_count,
    oneperEmail: r.one_per_email,
    startsAt: r.starts_at,
    endsAt: r.ends_at,
    active: r.active,
    ownerAgentId: r.owner_agent_id,
  };
}

function toRow(i: Partial<PromoCodeInput>): Update {
  const row: Update = {};
  if (i.code !== undefined) row.code = normalizePromoCode(i.code);
  if (i.type !== undefined) row.type = i.type;
  if (i.value !== undefined) row.value = i.value;
  if (i.fixedAmounts !== undefined) row.fixed_amounts = i.fixedAmounts as unknown as Json;
  if (i.maxDiscountPercent !== undefined) row.max_discount_percent = i.maxDiscountPercent;
  if (i.pageIds !== undefined) row.page_ids = i.pageIds;
  if (i.optionKeys !== undefined) row.option_keys = i.optionKeys;
  if (i.maxUses !== undefined) row.max_uses = i.maxUses;
  if (i.oneperEmail !== undefined) row.one_per_email = i.oneperEmail;
  if (i.startsAt !== undefined) row.starts_at = i.startsAt;
  if (i.endsAt !== undefined) row.ends_at = i.endsAt;
  if (i.active !== undefined) row.active = i.active;
  if (i.ownerAgentId !== undefined) row.owner_agent_id = i.ownerAgentId;
  return row;
}

/** Codes are stored uppercase; lookups normalize first. Throws on a read error. */
export async function getPromoByCode(code: string): Promise<PromoCode | null> {
  const normalized = normalizePromoCode(code);
  if (!normalized) return null;
  const admin = createAdminSupabase();
  const { data, error } = await admin.from("landing_promo_codes").select(COLUMNS).eq("code", normalized).maybeSingle();
  if (error) throw error;
  return data ? mapRow(data as Row) : null;
}

export async function listPromoCodes(): Promise<PromoCode[]> {
  const admin = createAdminSupabase();
  const { data, error } = await admin.from("landing_promo_codes").select(COLUMNS).order("created_at", { ascending: false });
  if (error) throw error;
  return (data ?? []).map((r) => mapRow(r as Row));
}

export async function createPromoCode(input: PromoCodeInput): Promise<PromoWriteResult> {
  const admin = createAdminSupabase();
  const { data, error } = await admin.from("landing_promo_codes").insert(toRow(input) as Insert).select("id").single();
  if (error) return { ok: false, reason: error.code === UNIQUE_VIOLATION ? "duplicate" : "db-error" };
  return { ok: true, id: data.id };
}

export async function updatePromoCode(id: string, patch: Partial<PromoCodeInput>): Promise<PromoWriteResult> {
  const admin = createAdminSupabase();
  const { data, error } = await admin.from("landing_promo_codes").update(toRow(patch)).eq("id", id).select("id").maybeSingle();
  if (error) return { ok: false, reason: error.code === UNIQUE_VIOLATION ? "duplicate" : "db-error" };
  if (!data) return { ok: false, reason: "not-found" };
  return { ok: true, id: data.id };
}

/**
 * True when this email already has a real (non-test) registration that used the promo.
 * Throws on a read error: a one-per-email code must not be granted on a DB blip.
 */
export async function emailUsedPromo(promoId: string, email: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const admin = createAdminSupabase();
  const { count, error } = await admin
    .from("landing_registrations")
    .select("id", { count: "exact", head: true })
    .eq("promo_code_id", promoId)
    .eq("email", email.trim().toLowerCase())
    .eq("is_test", false);
  if (error) throw error;
  return (count ?? 0) > 0;
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/data/landing-agent-links.ts
import "server-only";
import { createAdminSupabase } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";
import { slugify } from "@/lib/landing/slug";

const CODE_RE = /^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/;
const UNIQUE_VIOLATION = "23505";
const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5;

/** "Ayesha Siddiqui" -> "ayesha". Used as the readable half of a "name-xxx" code. */
export function agentCodeBase(fullName: string): string {
  const first = slugify(fullName).split("-")[0] ?? "";
  return first.slice(0, 12) || "agent";
}

/** Three base-36 characters, e.g. "7k2". `random` is injectable for tests. */
export function randomSuffix(random: () => number = Math.random): string {
  let s = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) s += Math.min(35, Math.floor(random() * 36)).toString(36);
  return s;
}

export function normalizeAgentCode(raw: string): string | null {
  const c = raw.trim().toLowerCase();
  return c.length >= 3 && c.length <= 40 && CODE_RE.test(c) ? c : null;
}

export class AgentLinkError extends Error {
  constructor(public readonly reason: "not-sales-agent" | "db-error") {
    super(reason);
  }
}

/**
 * One short code per sales agent (the page comes from the URL: /e/<slug>?ref=<code>).
 * Idempotent: an agent who already has a code gets it back. Throws AgentLinkError.
 */
export async function getOrCreateAgentLink(agentId: string, random: () => number = Math.random): Promise<{ code: string }> {
  const admin = createAdminSupabase();
  const existing = await admin.from("landing_agent_links").select("code").eq("agent_id", agentId).maybeSingle();
  if (existing.error) throw new AgentLinkError("db-error");
  if (existing.data) return { code: existing.data.code };

  const { data: profile, error: profileError } = await admin.from("profiles").select("full_name, role").eq("id", agentId).maybeSingle();
  if (profileError) throw new AgentLinkError("db-error");
  if (!profile || profile.role !== "sales_agent") throw new AgentLinkError("not-sales-agent");

  const base = agentCodeBase(profile.full_name);
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < MAX_ATTEMPTS; attempt++) {
    const code = `${base}-${randomSuffix(random)}`;
    const inserted = await admin.from("landing_agent_links").insert({ agent_id: agentId, code }).select("code").single();
    if (!inserted.error) return { code: inserted.data.code };
    if (inserted.error.code !== UNIQUE_VIOLATION) throw new AgentLinkError("db-error");
    // Either the code collided, or a parallel request just created this agent's link: re-read.
    const again = await admin.from("landing_agent_links").select("code").eq("agent_id", agentId).maybeSingle();
    if (again.data) return { code: again.data.code };
  }
  throw new AgentLinkError("db-error");
}

/**
 * Maps a ?ref= code to the agent, only while that profile is still a sales agent.
 * Never throws: attribution must never block a registration.
 */
export async function resolveAgentCode(code: string): Promise<{ agentId: string } | null> {
  const normalized = normalizeAgentCode(code);
  if (!normalized) return null;
  try {
    const admin = createAdminSupabase();
    const { data: link } = await admin.from("landing_agent_links").select("agent_id").eq("code", normalized).maybeSingle();
    if (!link) return null;
    const { data: profile } = await admin.from("profiles").select("role").eq("id", link.agent_id).maybeSingle();
    return profile?.role === "sales_agent" ? { agentId: link.agent_id } : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}
```

```ts
/** Best-effort analytics write. Never throws and never logs the payload. */
export async function recordFunnelEvent(e: {
  pageId: string;

  type: FunnelEventType;
  utm: Record<string, string>;
  agentId: string | null;
}): Promise<void> {

      page_id: e.pageId,
      session_id: e.sessionId,
      type: e.type,
      utm: cleanUtm(e.utm) as unknown as Json,
      agent_id: e.agentId,
    });
    if (error) console.warn("[landing-funnel] insert failed:", error.code);
  } catch {
    console.warn("[landing-funnel] insert crashed");
  }
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/data/landing-public.ts
import "server-only";
import { createAdminSupabase } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";
import type { Database } from "@/lib/supabase/database.types";
import { normalizeContent, type LandingContent } from "@/lib/landing/content";
import type { RegistrationConfig } from "@/lib/landing/registration/config";

type PageRow = Database["public"]["Tables"]["landing_pages"]["Row"];
type Picked = Pick<PageRow, "id" | "slug" | "title" | "status" | "published" | "sheet_id" | "drive_folder_id" | "ref_prefix" | "course_id">;

export interface RegistrablePage {
  id: string;
  slug: string;
  title: string;
  status: "published" | "closed";
  content: LandingContent;
  registration: RegistrationConfig;
  sheetId: string | null;
  driveFolderId: string | null;
  refPrefix: string | null;
  courseId: string | null;
}

const COLUMNS = "id, slug, title, status, published, sheet_id, drive_folder_id, ref_prefix, course_id";

function toPage(r: Picked | null): RegistrablePage | null {
  if (!r || r.status === "draft" || !r.published) return null;
  const content = normalizeContent(r.published);
  return {
    id: r.id,
    slug: r.slug,
    title: r.title,
    status: r.status === "closed" ? "closed" : "published",
    content,
    registration: content.registration,
    sheetId: r.sheet_id,
    driveFolderId: r.drive_folder_id,
    refPrefix: r.ref_prefix,
    courseId: r.course_id,
  };
}

/** Public lookup used by every /api/landing/[slug]/* route. Throws on a read error. */
export async function getRegistrablePage(slug: string): Promise<RegistrablePage | null> {
  const admin = createAdminSupabase();
  const { data, error } = await admin.from("landing_pages").select(COLUMNS).eq("slug", slug).maybeSingle();
  if (error) throw error;
  return toPage(data as Picked | null);
}

/** Same as getRegistrablePage, by id (background jobs know the page id, not the slug). */
export async function getRegistrablePageById(id: string): Promise<RegistrablePage | null> {
  const admin = createAdminSupabase();
  const { data, error } = await admin.from("landing_pages").select(COLUMNS).eq("id", id).maybeSingle();
  if (error) throw error;
  return toPage(data as Picked | null);
}
```

  - Part A: `RegistrationConfig`, `Mode`, `DEFAULT_REGISTRATION` (`config.ts`); `QuoteResult` (`pricing.ts`); `PromoResult` (`promo.ts`); `RegisterPayload`, `Person` (`submit-schema.ts`); `normalizeContent`, `emptyContent`, `LandingContent` (`content.ts`).
  - RPC `landing_create_registration(p_page_id uuid, p_rows jsonb, p_promo_id uuid, p_is_test boolean, p_capacity integer) returns jsonb` -> `{ ref_id, registration_ids }`, raising `promo_exhausted` / `capacity_full` (also `invalid_rows` / `page_not_found`, mapped to `db-error`). Task 1 behaviour: `p_rows` is a JSON array whose FIRST element is the individual/lead row and the rest are members; the RPC sets `ref_id` on the first row only, sets `lead_registration_id` on the others to the first row's id, and returns `registration_ids` in the same order (lead first).
  - `landing_registrations` columns (Task 1): `id, page_id, row_type, lead_registration_id, ref_id, name, email, whatsapp, profession, city, region, discovery, consent, option_label, option_keys, mode, tier_key, group_size, promo_code_id, promo_code_text, expected_amount, currency, payment_method, voucher_url, status, amount_received, email_status, status_changed_at, status_source, student_id, agent_id, referral_code, utm, fbp, fbc, event_id, session_id, is_test, created_at, updated_at`. The text columns `whatsapp, profession, city, discovery, option_label, promo_code_text, payment_method, voucher_url, email_status, referral_code, fbp, fbc, event_id, session_id` and `expected_amount` are NOT NULL (default `''` / `0`), so the row builder writes `""` / `0`, never `null`.
- Produces:
  - `registrationOptionLabel(config, sel: { mode: Mode; optionKeys: string[]; tierKey: string; groupSize: number }): string`
  - `buildVerifyMessage(config, d: { name; email; refId; optionLabel; isFree: boolean }): string` ("" when free or no verify number)
  - `whatsappVerifyUrl(number: string, message: string): string`
  - `RegistrationStatus` (re-exported from `config.ts`, Task 2), `RowType`, `OkQuote`, `OkPromo`, `CreateRegistrationInput { page: { id: string; refPrefix: string | null }; config; payload; quote: OkQuote; promo: OkPromo | null; voucherUrl: string; studentId: string | null; agentId: string | null; isTest: boolean }`
  - `buildRegistrationRows(input): RegInsert[]` (pure, exported for tests)
  - `createRegistration(input): Promise<{ ok: true; refId: string; registrationIds: string[]; total: number; currency: string } | { ok: false; reason: "promo_exhausted" | "capacity_full" | "db-error" }>`
  - `getRegistrationStatus(refId: string, email: string, pageId?: string): Promise<{ status: RegistrationStatus; name: string; eventLabel: string } | null>` (with `pageId`, a ref from another page is `null`)
  - `attachVoucher(refId, email, voucherUrl): Promise<boolean>`
  - `OpenRegistration { id; refId; status: "pending" | "underpaid"; name; optionLabel; optionKeys: string[]; mode: Mode; expectedAmount: number | null; currency }`, `findOpenRegistration(pageId, email): Promise<OpenRegistration | null>`
  - `linkRegistrationsToStudent(userId, email): Promise<number>` (never throws)
  - `countRecentRegistrations(email, sinceIso): Promise<number>` (0 on error)
  - `RegistrationRecord`, `RegistrationBundle { lead: RegistrationRecord; members: RegistrationRecord[] }`, `getRegistrationBundle(leadId): Promise<RegistrationBundle | null>`, `markEmailStatus(registrationId, value: string): Promise<void>`
  - Fixtures: `PPC_CONFIG`, `W20_CONFIG`, `PRE_EB` (a `Date` before PPC Early Bird ends), `contentWith(config): LandingContent`, `ppcPayload(over?): RegisterPayload`, `groupMembers(n): Person[]`

```ts
/** 13 Oct 2026 10:00 UTC: before the PPC Early Bird cutoff (15 Oct 19:00 UTC). */
export const PRE_EB = new Date("2026-10-13T10:00:00Z");

export function contentWith(config: RegistrationConfig): LandingContent {
  return { ...emptyContent("course"), registration: config };
}

export function groupMembers(n: number): Person[] {
  return Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => ({
    name: `Member ${i + 1}`,
    email: `Member${i + 1}@Example.com`,
    whatsapp: `+92300000000${i + 1}`,
    profession: "Pharmacist",

    regionKey: "PK",

    testMode: false,
    ...over,
  };
}
```

```ts
describe("createRegistration", () => {
  it("calls the RPC with the built rows and returns the ref", async () => {

    const call = db.find("landing_create_registration", "rpc")[0].payload as Record<string, unknown>;
    expect(call).toMatchObject({ p_page_id: "page-1", p_promo_id: null, p_is_test: false, p_capacity: 0 });
    expect((call.p_rows as unknown[]).length).toBe(1);
    expect(db.find("landing_pages", "update")).toHaveLength(0);
  });
  it("maps the RPC's exhausted and capacity errors", async () => {
    db.state.handler = () => ({ data: null, error: { code: "P0001", message: "promo_exhausted" } });
    expect(await createRegistration(input())).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "promo_exhausted" });
    db.state.handler = () => ({ data: null, error: { code: "P0001", message: "capacity_full" } });
    expect(await createRegistration(input())).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "capacity_full" });
    db.state.handler = () => ({ data: null, error: { code: "42883", message: "function does not exist" } });
    expect(await createRegistration(input())).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "db-error" });
  });
  it("rejects a malformed RPC reply", async () => {

    expect(await createRegistration(input())).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "db-error" });

  it("backfills the page ref prefix once, never for test registrations", async () => {
    db.state.handler = (op) => (op.op === "rpc" ? { data: { ref_id: "PZA-PPC-001", registration_ids: ["reg-1"] }, error: null } : { data: null, error: null });

    expect(upd.filters).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([["eq", "id", "page-1"], ["is", "ref_prefix", null]]));
    db.reset();
    db.state.handler = () => ({ data: { ref_id: "TEST-12345", registration_ids: ["reg-1"] }, error: null });
    await createRegistration(input({ page: { id: "page-1", refPrefix: null }, isTest: true }));
    expect(db.find("landing_pages", "update")).toHaveLength(0);
  });

describe("getRegistrationStatus", () => {
  const store = () => ({
    landing_registrations: [lead({ row_type: "lead", status: "paid" }), member({ status: "pending" })],
    landing_pages: [{ id: "page-1", title: "PPC Batch 3 page", published: contentWith(PPC_CONFIG) }],
  });
  it("matches ref plus email, normalizing both", async () => {
    db.state.handler = memoryHandler(store());
    expect(await getRegistrationStatus("pza-ppc-001", "  AYESHA@example.com ")).toEqual({ status: "paid", name: "Ayesha Khan", eventLabel: "PPC Batch 3" });
  });
  it("a member uses the lead's ref and shares the lead's status", async () => {
    db.state.handler = memoryHandler(store());
    expect(await getRegistrationStatus("PZA-PPC-001", "bilal@example.com")).toEqual({ status: "paid", name: "Bilal", eventLabel: "PPC Batch 3" });
  });
  it("returns null for a wrong email or an unknown ref", async () => {
    db.state.handler = memoryHandler(store());
    expect(await getRegistrationStatus("PZA-PPC-001", "someone@else.com")).toBeNull();
    expect(await getRegistrationStatus("PZA-PPC-999", "ayesha@example.com")).toBeNull();
    expect(await getRegistrationStatus("", "")).toBeNull();
  });
  it("with a page id, a ref that belongs to another page is null", async () => {
    db.state.handler = memoryHandler(store());
    expect(await getRegistrationStatus("PZA-PPC-001", "ayesha@example.com", "page-1")).toEqual({ status: "paid", name: "Ayesha Khan", eventLabel: "PPC Batch 3" });
    expect(await getRegistrationStatus("PZA-PPC-001", "ayesha@example.com", "page-2")).toBeNull();
    expect(filterValue(db.find("landing_registrations", "select").at(-1)!, "eq", "page_id")).toBe("page-2");
  });
});

describe("attachVoucher and findOpenRegistration", () => {
  it("attaches a voucher only to a pending or underpaid registration", async () => {
    const s = { landing_registrations: [lead()] };

    expect(s.landing_registrations[0].voucher_url).toBe("https://drive.google.com/file/d/v2/view");
    expect(filterValue(db.find("landing_registrations", "update")[0], "in", "status")).toEqual(["pending", "underpaid"]);
    s.landing_registrations[0].status = "paid";
    expect(await attachVoucher("PZA-PPC-001", "ayesha@example.com", "https://drive.google.com/file/d/v3/view")).toBe(false);
  });
  it("finds the open real registration for this page and email", async () => {
    db.state.handler = memoryHandler({
      landing_registrations: [
        lead({ id: "t1", ref_id: "TEST-12345", is_test: true }),
        lead({ id: "p1", ref_id: "PZA-PPC-002", status: "paid" }),
        lead({ id: "o1", ref_id: "PZA-PPC-003", status: "underpaid" }),
        member({ id: "m9", email: "ayesha@example.com" }),

      id: "o1", refId: "PZA-PPC-003", status: "underpaid", name: "Ayesha Khan", optionLabel: "Live - Full Course - Individual",
      optionKeys: ["full"], mode: "live", expectedAmount: 4800, currency: "PKR",

  });
});
```
