```ts
// src/lib/landing/registration/labels.ts
import type { Mode, RegistrationConfig } from "./config";

/**
 * Human label written to the Sheet ("Registration Option"), the emails and the WhatsApp
 * verify message, e.g. "Live - Full Course - Group of 3". Plain hyphens on purpose: the
 * label is pasted into WhatsApp and Sheets, where long dashes render inconsistently.
 */
export function registrationOptionLabel(
  config: RegistrationConfig,
  sel: { mode: Mode; optionKeys: string[]; tierKey: string; groupSize: number },
): string {
  const options = sel.optionKeys.map((k) => config.options.find((o) => o.key === k)?.label ?? k).join(", ");
  let tierText = "Individual";
  if (sel.tierKey !== "individual") {
    const tier = config.tiers.find((t) => t.key === sel.tierKey);
    const label = tier?.label ?? sel.tierKey;
    tierText = tier && tier.minSize !== tier.maxSize ? `${label}, ${sel.groupSize} people` : label;
  }
  const parts = config.modes.length > 1 ? [sel.mode === "recorded" ? "Recorded" : "Live", options, tierText] : [options, tierText];
  return parts.join(" - ");
}

/** The prefilled WhatsApp message from the legacy PPC/MDC success screen. "" when not applicable. */
export function buildVerifyMessage(
  config: RegistrationConfig,
  d: { name: string; email: string; refId: string; optionLabel: string; isFree: boolean },
): string {
  if (d.isFree || !config.whatsappVerifyNumber) return "";
  return (
    `Hi PZ Academy! I just registered for ${config.eventLabel} and submitted my payment voucher.\n\n` +
    `Name: ${d.name}\nEmail: ${d.email}\nRef: ${d.refId}\nRegistration: ${d.optionLabel}\n\n` +
    "Please verify my payment. Thank you!"
  );
}

export function whatsappVerifyUrl(number: string, message: string): string {
  return `https://wa.me/${number.replace(/\D/g, "")}?text=${encodeURIComponent(message).replace(/'/g, "%27")}`;
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/data/landing-registrations.ts
import "server-only";
import { createAdminSupabase } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";
import type { Database, Json } from "@/lib/supabase/database.types";
import { normalizeContent } from "@/lib/landing/content";
import type { Mode, RegistrationConfig, RegistrationStatus } from "@/lib/landing/registration/config";
import type { QuoteResult } from "@/lib/landing/registration/pricing";
import type { PromoResult } from "@/lib/landing/registration/promo";
import type { RegisterPayload } from "@/lib/landing/registration/submit-schema";
import { registrationOptionLabel } from "@/lib/landing/registration/labels";
import { cleanUtm } from "@/lib/landing/registration/utm";

type RegRow = Database["public"]["Tables"]["landing_registrations"]["Row"];
type RegInsert = Database["public"]["Tables"]["landing_registrations"]["Insert"];
type CreateArgs = Database["public"]["Functions"]["landing_create_registration"]["Args"];

export type { RegistrationStatus } from "@/lib/landing/registration/config";
export type RowType = "individual" | "lead" | "member";
export type OkQuote = Extract<QuoteResult, { ok: true }>;
export type OkPromo = Extract<PromoResult, { ok: true }>;

export interface CreateRegistrationInput {
  page: { id: string; refPrefix: string | null };
  config: RegistrationConfig;
  payload: RegisterPayload;
  quote: OkQuote;
  promo: OkPromo | null;
  voucherUrl: string;
  studentId: string | null;
  agentId: string | null;
  isTest: boolean;
}
export type CreateRegistrationResult =
  | { ok: true; refId: string; registrationIds: string[]; total: number; currency: string }
  | { ok: false; reason: "promo_exhausted" | "capacity_full" | "db-error" };

export interface OpenRegistration {
  id: string;
  refId: string;
  status: "pending" | "underpaid";
  name: string;
  optionLabel: string;
  optionKeys: string[];
  mode: Mode;
  expectedAmount: number | null;
  currency: string;
}

export interface RegistrationRecord {
  id: string;
  pageId: string;
  rowType: RowType;
  leadRegistrationId: string | null;
  refId: string | null;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  whatsapp: string;
  profession: string;
  city: string;
  region: string;
  discovery: string;
  consent: boolean;
  optionLabel: string;
  optionKeys: string[];
  mode: Mode;
  tierKey: string;
  groupSize: number;
  promoCodeText: string | null;
  expectedAmount: number | null;
  amountReceived: number | null;
  currency: string;
  paymentMethod: string | null;
  voucherUrl: string | null;
  status: RegistrationStatus;
  emailStatus: string | null;
  agentId: string | null;
  studentId: string | null;
  utm: Record<string, string>;
  isTest: boolean;
  createdAt: string;
}
export interface RegistrationBundle { lead: RegistrationRecord; members: RegistrationRecord[] }

const OPEN_STATUSES = ["pending", "underpaid"];
const HEAD_ROW_TYPES = ["individual", "lead"];

const lower = (s: string) => s.trim().toLowerCase();
// Tolerant readers: column nullability lives in Part A's types; these keep the mapping total.
const str = (v: unknown): string => (typeof v === "string" ? v : "");
const strOrNull = (v: unknown): string | null => (typeof v === "string" && v !== "" ? v : null);
const numOrNull = (v: unknown): number | null => (v === null || v === undefined || v === "" ? null : Number(v));
const strArray = (v: unknown): string[] => (Array.isArray(v) ? v.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === "string") : []);

function mapRecord(r: RegRow): RegistrationRecord {
  const row = r as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
  return {
    id: str(row.id),
    pageId: str(row.page_id),
    rowType: (["individual", "lead", "member"].includes(str(row.row_type)) ? row.row_type : "individual") as RowType,
    leadRegistrationId: strOrNull(row.lead_registration_id),
    refId: strOrNull(row.ref_id),
    name: str(row.name),
    email: str(row.email),
    whatsapp: str(row.whatsapp),
    profession: str(row.profession),
    city: str(row.city),
    region: str(row.region),
    discovery: str(row.discovery),
    consent: row.consent === true,
    optionLabel: str(row.option_label),
    optionKeys: strArray(row.option_keys),
    mode: row.mode === "recorded" ? "recorded" : "live",
    tierKey: str(row.tier_key) || "individual",
    groupSize: Number(row.group_size ?? 1),
    promoCodeText: strOrNull(row.promo_code_text),
    expectedAmount: numOrNull(row.expected_amount),
    amountReceived: numOrNull(row.amount_received),
    currency: str(row.currency),
    paymentMethod: strOrNull(row.payment_method),
    voucherUrl: strOrNull(row.voucher_url),
    status: str(row.status) as RegistrationStatus,
    emailStatus: strOrNull(row.email_status),
    agentId: strOrNull(row.agent_id),
    studentId: strOrNull(row.student_id),
    utm: cleanUtm(row.utm),
    isTest: row.is_test === true,
    createdAt: str(row.created_at),
  };
}

/**
 * One row per person, lead/individual FIRST (the RPC gives that row the ref id and links
 * the rest to it). Members carry no money, voucher or payment method: the lead pays for
 * the group. Members are never linked to the logged-in user (they are other people).
 */
export function buildRegistrationRows(input: CreateRegistrationInput): RegInsert[] {
  const { payload: p, quote: q, promo } = input;
  const status: RegistrationStatus = q.isFree ? "free" : "pending";
  const shared = {
    page_id: input.page.id,
    option_label: registrationOptionLabel(input.config, q),
    option_keys: q.optionKeys,
    mode: q.mode,
    tier_key: q.tierKey,
    group_size: q.groupSize,
    region: q.regionKey,
    currency: q.currency,
    status,
    agent_id: input.agentId,
    referral_code: lower(p.attribution.refCode),
    utm: cleanUtm(p.attribution.utm) as unknown as Json,
    session_id: p.attribution.sessionId.trim(),
    is_test: input.isTest,
    promo_code_id: promo?.promoId ?? null,
    promo_code_text: promo?.code ?? "",
  };
  const head: RegInsert = {
    ...shared,
    row_type: q.tierKey === "individual" ? "individual" : "lead",
    name: p.lead.name.trim(),
    email: lower(p.lead.email),
    whatsapp: p.lead.whatsapp.trim(),
    profession: p.lead.profession.trim(),
    city: p.lead.city.trim(),
    discovery: p.lead.discovery.trim(),
    consent: true,
    expected_amount: promo ? promo.total : q.total,
    payment_method: q.isFree ? "" : p.paymentMethod,
    voucher_url: input.voucherUrl,
    student_id: input.studentId,
    fbp: p.attribution.fbp.trim(),
    fbc: p.attribution.fbc.trim(),
    event_id: p.attribution.eventId.trim(),
  };
  const members: RegInsert[] = p.members.map((m) => ({
    ...shared,
    row_type: "member",
    name: m.name.trim(),
    email: lower(m.email),
    whatsapp: m.whatsapp.trim(),
    profession: m.profession.trim(),
    city: "",
    discovery: "",
    consent: true, // covered by the group lead's consent, as on the legacy sheets
    expected_amount: 0,  // the lead's row carries the whole-registration total
    payment_method: "",
    voucher_url: "",
    student_id: null,
    fbp: "",
    fbc: "",
    event_id: "",
  }));
  return [head, ...members];
}

export async function createRegistration(input: CreateRegistrationInput): Promise<CreateRegistrationResult> {
  const admin = createAdminSupabase();
  if (!input.isTest && !input.page.refPrefix && input.config.refPrefix.trim()) {
    // The ref counter needs the page's prefix; pages registered before their sheet existed get it here.
    await admin.from("landing_pages").update({ ref_prefix: input.config.refPrefix.trim().toUpperCase() }).eq("id", input.page.id).is("ref_prefix", null);
  }
  const args = {
    p_page_id: input.page.id,
    p_rows: buildRegistrationRows(input) as unknown as Json,
    p_promo_id: input.promo?.promoId ?? null,
    p_is_test: input.isTest,
    p_capacity: input.config.capacity,
  };
  const { data, error } = await admin.rpc("landing_create_registration", args as unknown as CreateArgs);
  if (error) {
    const text = `${error.message ?? ""} ${error.details ?? ""}`;
    if (text.includes("promo_exhausted")) return { ok: false, reason: "promo_exhausted" };
    if (text.includes("capacity_full")) return { ok: false, reason: "capacity_full" };
    console.error("[landing-registrations] create failed:", error.code);
    return { ok: false, reason: "db-error" };
  }
  const out = (data ?? {}) as { ref_id?: unknown; registration_ids?: unknown };
  const ids = strArray(out.registration_ids);
  if (typeof out.ref_id !== "string" || out.ref_id === "" || ids.length === 0) return { ok: false, reason: "db-error" };
  return { ok: true, refId: out.ref_id, registrationIds: ids, total: input.promo ? input.promo.total : input.quote.total, currency: input.quote.currency };
}

/**
 * Ref + email lookup for the public status page. A member uses the lead's ref and their own
 * email; everyone in a group shares the lead's status. With `pageId` (the public status route
 * passes the page of the slug in the URL) a ref from another event is null. Throws on a read error.
 */
export async function getRegistrationStatus(
  refId: string,
  email: string,
  pageId?: string,
): Promise<{ status: RegistrationStatus; name: string; eventLabel: string } | null> {
  const ref = refId.trim().toUpperCase();
  const mail = lower(email);
  if (!ref || !mail) return null;
  const admin = createAdminSupabase();
  let headQuery = admin.from("landing_registrations").select("id, page_id, name, email, status").eq("ref_id", ref);
  if (pageId) headQuery = headQuery.eq("page_id", pageId);
  const { data: head, error } = await headQuery.maybeSingle();
  if (error) throw error;
  if (!head) return null;
  let name: string | null = head.email === mail ? head.name : null;
  if (name === null) {
    const { data: m, error: mErr } = await admin.from("landing_registrations").select("name").eq("lead_registration_id", head.id).eq("email", mail).maybeSingle();
    if (mErr) throw mErr;
    name = m?.name ?? null;
  }
  if (name === null) return null;
  const { data: page } = await admin.from("landing_pages").select("title, published").eq("id", head.page_id).maybeSingle();
  const eventLabel = page ? normalizeContent(page.published).registration.eventLabel || page.title : "";
  return { status: head.status as RegistrationStatus, name, eventLabel };
}

/** Resubmission: a new voucher on the same row. Only while the payment is still open. */
export async function attachVoucher(refId: string, email: string, voucherUrl: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const admin = createAdminSupabase();
  const { data, error } = await admin
    .from("landing_registrations")
    .update({ voucher_url: voucherUrl })
    .eq("ref_id", refId.trim().toUpperCase())
    .eq("email", lower(email))
    .in("status", OPEN_STATUSES)
    .select("id");
  if (error) {
    console.error("[landing-registrations] attachVoucher failed:", error.code);
    return false;
  }
  return (data ?? []).length > 0;
}

export async function findOpenRegistration(pageId: string, email: string): Promise<OpenRegistration | null> {
  const admin = createAdminSupabase();
  const { data, error } = await admin
    .from("landing_registrations")
    .select("id, ref_id, status, name, option_label, option_keys, mode, expected_amount, currency")
    .eq("page_id", pageId)
    .eq("email", lower(email))
    .in("row_type", HEAD_ROW_TYPES)
    .in("status", OPEN_STATUSES)
    .eq("is_test", false)
    .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
    .limit(1)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (error) throw error;
  if (!data || !data.ref_id) return null;
  const row = data as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
  return {
    id: str(row.id),
    refId: str(row.ref_id),
    status: row.status === "underpaid" ? "underpaid" : "pending",
    name: str(row.name),
    optionLabel: str(row.option_label),
    optionKeys: strArray(row.option_keys),
    mode: row.mode === "recorded" ? "recorded" : "live",
    expectedAmount: numOrNull(row.expected_amount),
    currency: str(row.currency),
  };
}

/** Links guest registrations to the account that just signed in with the same email. Never throws. */
export async function linkRegistrationsToStudent(userId: string, email: string): Promise<number> {
  try {
    const admin = createAdminSupabase();
    const { data, error } = await admin
      .from("landing_registrations")
      .update({ student_id: userId })
      .eq("email", lower(email))
      .is("student_id", null)
      .eq("is_test", false)
      .select("id");
    if (error) {
      console.warn("[landing-registrations] link failed:", error.code);
      return 0;
    }
    return (data ?? []).length;
  } catch {
    return 0;
  }
}

/** Registrations (not members) by this email since `sinceIso`. Fails open (0) so a DB blip never blocks sign-ups. */
export async function countRecentRegistrations(email: string, sinceIso: string): Promise<number> {
  const admin = createAdminSupabase();
  const { count, error } = await admin
    .from("landing_registrations")
    .select("id", { count: "exact", head: true })
    .eq("email", lower(email))
    .in("row_type", HEAD_ROW_TYPES)
    .gte("created_at", sinceIso);
  if (error) return 0;
  return count ?? 0;
}

export async function getRegistrationBundle(leadId: string): Promise<RegistrationBundle | null> {
  const admin = createAdminSupabase();
  const { data: head, error } = await admin.from("landing_registrations").select("*").eq("id", leadId).maybeSingle();
  if (error) throw error;
  if (!head) return null;
  const { data: members, error: mErr } = await admin
    .from("landing_registrations")
    .select("*")
    .eq("lead_registration_id", leadId)
    .order("created_at", { ascending: true });
  if (mErr) throw mErr;
  return { lead: mapRecord(head as RegRow), members: (members ?? []).map((m) => mapRecord(m as RegRow)) };
}

export async function markEmailStatus(registrationId: string, value: string): Promise<void> {
  const admin = createAdminSupabase();
  const { error } = await admin.from("landing_registrations").update({ email_status: value }).eq("id", registrationId);
  if (error) throw error;
}
```

```ts
    });

  it("uploadLandingVoucher rejects a non-https url", async () => {
```

```js

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Landing-page registrations (Phase 2): one spreadsheet per event, created by
 * the app. LANDING_HEADERS must stay identical to SHEET_HEADERS in
 * src/lib/landing/registration/sheet-row.ts (tests/landing-event-sheet.test.ts
 * pins it). ROOT_FOLDER_NAME, getOrCreateFolder_ and sanitizeFolderName_ come
 * from gas/payment-screenshots/Code.gs, which shares this Apps Script project.
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
const LANDING_TAB_NAME = "Form Responses 1";
const LANDING_HEADERS = ["Name", "Email", "WhatsApp", "Profession", "Discovery", "Registration Option", "Consent", "Row Type", "Promo Code", "Voucher URL", "Submitted At", "Expected Amount", "Group Lead Email", "Payment Method", "Amount", "Payment Confirmation", "Email Confirmation", "Source", "Ref ID", "Region", "Agent", "Promo Code Used", "UTM Campaign"];
const LANDING_STATUS_VALUES = ["Paid", "Pending", "Underpaid", "Reserved", "Free"];
const LANDING_SHEETS_FOLDER_NAME = "Landing Sheets";
const LANDING_VOUCHERS_FOLDER_NAME = "Landing Vouchers";
const LANDING_HEADER_BG = "#023122";
const LANDING_LEAD_BG = "#E8F5E0";
const LANDING_MEMBER_BG = "#F4FBF0";
const LANDING_COL = { NAME: 1, EMAIL: 2, ROW_TYPE: 8, VOUCHER: 10, STATUS: 16, REF: 19 };
const LANDING_VOUCHER_MIME = ["image/jpeg", "image/png", "image/webp", "application/pdf"];
const LANDING_HEADER_NOTE =
  "Only P (Payment Confirmation) and O (Amount) are for the team to edit. Every other column is written by the PZ Academy app and will be overwritten.";

function handleCreateEventSheet_(body) {
  const title = String(body.title || "").trim();
  if (!title) return jsonResponse_({ status: "error", message: "Missing title" });
  try {
    const ss = SpreadsheetApp.create(title.slice(0, 90) + " - Registrations");
    const sheet = ss.getSheets()[0];
    sheet.setName(LANDING_TAB_NAME);
    sheet
      .getRange(1, 1, 1, LANDING_HEADERS.length)
      .setValues([LANDING_HEADERS])
      .setBackground(LANDING_HEADER_BG)
      .setFontColor("#FFFFFF")
      .setFontWeight("bold")
      .setFontSize(10)
      .setVerticalAlignment("middle");
    sheet.getRange(1, 1).setNote(LANDING_HEADER_NOTE);
    sheet.setFrozenRows(1);
    sheet.setRowHeight(1, 32);
    applyLandingStatusValidation_(sheet, 2, sheet.getMaxRows() - 1);

    const root = getOrCreateFolder_(DriveApp.getRootFolder(), ROOT_FOLDER_NAME);
    DriveApp.getFileById(ss.getId()).moveTo(getOrCreateFolder_(root, LANDING_SHEETS_FOLDER_NAME));
    const vouchersRoot = getOrCreateFolder_(root, LANDING_VOUCHERS_FOLDER_NAME);
    const eventFolder = getOrCreateFolder_(vouchersRoot, landingFolderName_(body.folderName || title));

    return jsonResponse_({ status: "success", sheetId: ss.getId(), driveFolderId: eventFolder.getId() });
  } catch (err) {
    return jsonResponse_({ status: "error", message: String(err) });
  }
}

function handleAppendRegistrationRows_(body) {
  if (!body.sheetId || !Array.isArray(body.rows)) {
    return jsonResponse_({ status: "error", message: "Missing sheetId or rows" });
  }
  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  try {
    lock.waitLock(10000);
  } catch (err) {
    return jsonResponse_({ status: "error", message: "Sheet is busy, try again" });
  }
  try {
    const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(body.sheetId);
    const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(LANDING_TAB_NAME) || ss.getSheets()[0];
    const lastRow = sheet.getLastRow();

    // Idempotent: a retried job must not duplicate rows. Ref ID + Email is the row key
    // (members carry their lead's Ref ID and their own email).
    const seen = {};
    if (lastRow >= 2) {
      const emails = sheet.getRange(2, LANDING_COL.EMAIL, lastRow - 1, 1).getDisplayValues();
      const refs = sheet.getRange(2, LANDING_COL.REF, lastRow - 1, 1).getDisplayValues();
      for (let i = 0; i < emails.length; i++) seen[landingRowKey_(refs[i][0], emails[i][0])] = true;
    }

    const fresh = [];
    for (const row of body.rows) {
      if (!Array.isArray(row) || row.length !== LANDING_HEADERS.length) {
        return jsonResponse_({ status: "error", message: "Each row must have " + LANDING_HEADERS.length + " cells" });
      }
      const key = landingRowKey_(row[LANDING_COL.REF - 1], row[LANDING_COL.EMAIL - 1]);
      if (seen[key]) continue;
      seen[key] = true;
      fresh.push(row);
    }
    if (fresh.length === 0) return jsonResponse_({ status: "success", appended: 0 });

    const start = lastRow + 1;
    const values = fresh.map((r) => r.map((c, i) => (i === LANDING_COL.VOUCHER - 1 ? "" : landingCell_(c))));
    sheet.getRange(start, 1, fresh.length, LANDING_HEADERS.length).setValues(values);

    for (let i = 0; i < fresh.length; i++) {
      const r = start + i;
      const type = String(fresh[i][LANDING_COL.ROW_TYPE - 1]);
      const bg = type === "Group Lead" ? LANDING_LEAD_BG : type === "Group Member" ? LANDING_MEMBER_BG : "#FFFFFF";
      sheet.getRange(r, 1, 1, LANDING_HEADERS.length).setBackground(bg);
      if (type === "Group Lead") sheet.getRange(r, LANDING_COL.NAME).setFontWeight("bold");
      sheet.setRowHeight(r, 28);
      const url = String(fresh[i][LANDING_COL.VOUCHER - 1] || "");
      if (/^https:\/\/[^\s"]+$/.test(url)) {
        sheet
          .getRange(r, LANDING_COL.VOUCHER)
          .setFormula('=HYPERLINK("' + url + '","View Receipt")')
          .setFontWeight("bold")
          .setFontColor("#0F3D22");
      }
    }
    applyLandingStatusValidation_(sheet, start, fresh.length);
    return jsonResponse_({ status: "success", appended: fresh.length });
  } catch (err) {
    return jsonResponse_({ status: "error", message: String(err) });
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

/** Public, unauthenticated registrants' payment screenshots. SHARED_SECRET gate like the other Drive actions. */
function handleUploadLandingVoucher_(body) {
  const expectedSecret = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperty("SHARED_SECRET");
  if (!expectedSecret || body.secret !== expectedSecret) {
    return jsonResponse_({ status: "error", message: "Unauthorized" });
  }
  const { pageSlug, mimeType, base64, filename, folderId } = body;
  if (!pageSlug || !mimeType || !base64 || !filename) {
    return jsonResponse_({ status: "error", message: "Missing required fields" });
  }
  if (LANDING_VOUCHER_MIME.indexOf(mimeType) === -1) {
    return jsonResponse_({ status: "error", message: "Unsupported file type" });
  }
  try {
    const safeName = String(filename).replace(/[^\w.-]/g, "_").slice(0, 100);
    const blob = Utilities.newBlob(Utilities.base64Decode(base64), mimeType, safeName);
    const file = landingVoucherFolder_(pageSlug, folderId).createFile(blob);
    file.setSharing(DriveApp.Access.ANYONE_WITH_LINK, DriveApp.Permission.VIEW);
    return jsonResponse_({ status: "success", url: file.getUrl(), fileId: file.getId() });
  } catch (err) {
    return jsonResponse_({ status: "error", message: String(err) });
  }
}

/** The event's folder when folderId is a direct child of "PZ Academy/Landing Vouchers"; else a folder named after the slug. */
function landingVoucherFolder_(pageSlug, folderId) {
  const root = getOrCreateFolder_(DriveApp.getRootFolder(), ROOT_FOLDER_NAME);
  const vouchersRoot = getOrCreateFolder_(root, LANDING_VOUCHERS_FOLDER_NAME);
  if (folderId) {
    try {
      const folder = DriveApp.getFolderById(String(folderId));
      const parents = folder.getParents();
      while (parents.hasNext()) {
        if (parents.next().getId() === vouchersRoot.getId()) return folder;
      }
    } catch (err) {
      // Unknown or inaccessible id: fall back to the slug folder below.
    }
  }
  return getOrCreateFolder_(vouchersRoot, sanitizeFolderName_(pageSlug));
}

function applyLandingStatusValidation_(sheet, startRow, numRows) {
  if (numRows < 1) return;
  const rule = SpreadsheetApp.newDataValidation().requireValueInList(LANDING_STATUS_VALUES, true).setAllowInvalid(false).build();
  sheet.getRange(startRow, LANDING_COL.STATUS, numRows, 1).setDataValidation(rule);
}

function landingFolderName_(name) {
  const cleaned = String(name || "").replace(/[^\w\s-]/g, "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().slice(0, 80);
  return cleaned || "event";
}

/** Text written by the public must never run as a formula (=, +, -, @ start a formula in Sheets). */
function landingCell_(value) {
  const s = value === null || value === undefined ? "" : String(value);
  return /^[=+\-@]/.test(s) ? "'" + s : s;
}

function landingRowKey_(ref, email) {
  return String(ref || "").trim().toUpperCase() + "|" + String(email || "").trim().toLowerCase();
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/gas/event-sheet-client.ts
import "server-only";

/**
 * Client for the landing-page actions in gas/sheets-sync/Code.gs. Same web app as
 * sheets-sync-client.ts (GAS_SHEETS_SYNC_URL). Sheet actions use SHEETS_SYNC_SECRET as
 * `token`; the Drive upload uses GAS_SHARED_SECRET as `secret`. Neither secret is ever
 * logged or returned. Every function returns a result instead of throwing; callers that
 * need retries (the outbox) turn `ok: false` into a thrown error themselves.
 */

type GasReply = Record<string, unknown> & { status?: unknown; message?: unknown };
const TIMEOUT_MS = 25_000;

async function postToGas(body: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<{ ok: true; data: GasReply } | { ok: false; message: string }> {
  const url = process.env.GAS_SHEETS_SYNC_URL;
  if (!url) return { ok: false, message: "GAS_SHEETS_SYNC_URL is not configured." };
  try {
    const res = await fetch(url, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
      cache: "no-store",
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(TIMEOUT_MS),
    });
    if (!res.ok) return { ok: false, message: `Apps Script returned HTTP ${res.status}.` };
    const data = (await res.json().catch(() => null)) as GasReply | null;
    if (!data) return { ok: false, message: "Apps Script returned a non-JSON reply." };
    if (data.status !== "success") {
      return { ok: false, message: typeof data.message === "string" && data.message ? data.message : "Apps Script reported an error." };
    }
    return { ok: true, data };
  } catch (err) {
    return { ok: false, message: err instanceof Error && err.name === "TimeoutError" ? "Apps Script timed out." : "Could not reach Apps Script." };
  }
}

export async function createEventSheet(
  title: string,
  folderName: string = title,
): Promise<{ ok: true; sheetId: string; driveFolderId: string } | { ok: false; message: string }> {
  const token = process.env.SHEETS_SYNC_SECRET;
  if (!token) return { ok: false, message: "SHEETS_SYNC_SECRET is not configured." };
  const r = await postToGas({ token, action: "createEventSheet", title, folderName });
  if (!r.ok) return r;
  const { sheetId, driveFolderId } = r.data;
  if (typeof sheetId !== "string" || !sheetId || typeof driveFolderId !== "string" || !driveFolderId) {
    return { ok: false, message: "Apps Script did not return the new sheet." };
  }
  return { ok: true, sheetId, driveFolderId };
}

export async function appendRegistrationRows(sheetId: string, rows: string[][]): Promise<{ ok: boolean; message?: string }> {
  const token = process.env.SHEETS_SYNC_SECRET;
  if (!token) return { ok: false, message: "SHEETS_SYNC_SECRET is not configured." };
  const r = await postToGas({ token, action: "appendRegistrationRows", sheetId, rows });
  return r.ok ? { ok: true } : { ok: false, message: r.message };
}

export interface VoucherFile { base64: string; mimeType: string; filename: string }

export async function uploadLandingVoucher(
  pageSlug: string,
  file: VoucherFile,
  folderId?: string | null,
): Promise<{ ok: true; url: string } | { ok: false; message: string }> {
  const secret = process.env.GAS_SHARED_SECRET;
  if (!secret) return { ok: false, message: "GAS_SHARED_SECRET is not configured." };
  const r = await postToGas({
    action: "uploadLandingVoucher",
    secret,
    pageSlug,
    mimeType: file.mimeType,
    base64: file.base64,
    filename: file.filename,
    folderId: folderId ?? null,
  });
  if (!r.ok) return r;
  const url = r.data.url;
  if (typeof url !== "string" || !/^https:\/\//.test(url)) return { ok: false, message: "Apps Script did not return a file link." };
  return { ok: true, url };
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/data/landing-event-sheet.ts
import "server-only";
import { createAdminSupabase } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";
import { normalizeContent } from "@/lib/landing/content";

export interface PageSheetInfo {
  id: string;
  slug: string;
  title: string;
  sheetId: string | null;
  driveFolderId: string | null;
  refPrefix: string | null;
  draftRefPrefix: string;
}

export async function getPageSheetInfo(id: string): Promise<PageSheetInfo | null> {
  const admin = createAdminSupabase();
  const { data, error } = await admin
    .from("landing_pages")
    .select("id, slug, title, draft, sheet_id, drive_folder_id, ref_prefix")
    .eq("id", id)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (error) throw error;
  if (!data) return null;
  return {
    id: data.id,
    slug: data.slug,
    title: data.title,
    sheetId: data.sheet_id,
    driveFolderId: data.drive_folder_id,
    refPrefix: data.ref_prefix,
    draftRefPrefix: normalizeContent(data.draft).registration.refPrefix,
  };
}

/** Saves the new sheet only if the page still has none (guards a double click). */
export async function saveEventSheet(
  id: string,
  v: { sheetId: string; driveFolderId: string; refPrefix: string },
): Promise<{ ok: true } | { ok: false; reason: "already-set" | "db-error" }> {
  const admin = createAdminSupabase();
  const { data, error } = await admin
    .from("landing_pages")
    .update({ sheet_id: v.sheetId, drive_folder_id: v.driveFolderId, ref_prefix: v.refPrefix })
    .eq("id", id)
    .is("sheet_id", null)
    .select("id")
    .maybeSingle();
  if (error) return { ok: false, reason: "db-error" };
  if (!data) return { ok: false, reason: "already-set" };
  return { ok: true };
}
```

```ts
// src/app/api/admin/landing-pages/[id]/sheet/route.ts
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth/require-admin";
import { isPageId } from "@/lib/validations/landing";
import { getPageSheetInfo, saveEventSheet } from "@/lib/data/landing-event-sheet";
import { createEventSheet } from "@/lib/gas/event-sheet-client";

export const maxDuration = 60;

const PREFIX_RE = /^[A-Z0-9]{2,8}$/;

/**
 * Creates the event's Google Sheet (tab "Form Responses 1", headers A->W) and its
 * voucher folder via Apps Script, then stores sheet_id / drive_folder_id / ref_prefix.
 * Refuses when the page already has a sheet, so a retry never makes a second one.
 */
export async function POST(_req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const auth = await requireAdmin();
  if (!auth.ok) return auth.response;
  const { id } = await params;
  // Part 0 L2: a malformed id is "not found" after the auth gate, before any query.
  if (!isPageId(id)) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Page not found" }, { status: 404 });

  const page = await getPageSheetInfo(id).catch(() => undefined);
  if (page === undefined) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Could not load the page." }, { status: 500 });
  if (!page) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Page not found" }, { status: 404 });
  if (page.sheetId) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "This page already has a sheet.", sheetId: page.sheetId }, { status: 409 });
  }

  const refPrefix = (page.refPrefix ?? page.draftRefPrefix).trim().toUpperCase();
  if (!PREFIX_RE.test(refPrefix)) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Set a reference prefix (2 to 8 letters or numbers, for example PPC) in the registration settings first." },
      { status: 422 },
    );
  }

  const created = await createEventSheet(page.title, page.title);
  if (!created.ok) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: `Could not create the sheet: ${created.message}` }, { status: 502 });
  }

  const saved = await saveEventSheet(id, { sheetId: created.sheetId, driveFolderId: created.driveFolderId, refPrefix });
  if (!saved.ok) {
    if (saved.reason === "already-set") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Another sheet was created for this page at the same moment. Delete the extra one in Drive.", sheetId: created.sheetId },
        { status: 409 },
      );
    }
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "The sheet was created but could not be saved. Try again." }, { status: 500 });
  }

  return NextResponse.json(
    {
      sheetId: created.sheetId,
      driveFolderId: created.driveFolderId,
      refPrefix,
      sheetUrl: `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${created.sheetId}/edit`,
    },
    { status: 201 },
  );
}
```

Stop and hand the user these exact steps. Never use the web editor's "Deploy > New version": it silently redeploys stale code. In PowerShell, from the repo root:

```powershell
cd "gas/clasp-project"
..\..\node_modules\.bin\clasp.cmd pull
Copy-Item ..\sheets-sync\Code.gs "Sheet Sync.js" -Force
..\..\node_modules\.bin\clasp.cmd push -f
..\..\node_modules\.bin\clasp.cmd deployments
..\..\node_modules\.bin\clasp.cmd redeploy <the-deployment-id-inside-GAS_SHEETS_SYNC_URL>
cd ..\..
git status --short gas/clasp-project
```

The deployment id is the long string just before `/exec` in `GAS_SHEETS_SYNC_URL` in `.env.local`. `clasp pull` also rewrites `Code.js` and `appsscript.json` with whatever is live; if the final `git status` lists them as modified, that is the live copy and must not be committed: run `git checkout -- gas/clasp-project/Code.js gas/clasp-project/appsscript.json`. `Sheet Sync.js` must show no change (it already matches the committed copy). No new Script Properties are needed (`SYNC_SECRET` and `SHARED_SECRET` already exist). If Apps Script asks for new permissions on first use (it creates spreadsheets and moves Drive files), open the project in script.google.com, run `handleCreateEventSheet_` once from the editor, and accept. After:

The cron is a daily safety net only: on the Hobby plan Vercel runs crons at most once a day and only within the scheduled hour. Real-time delivery comes from `waitUntil` in the register route, which also drains any other due jobs after its own, plus the admin Retry button.

```ts
// src/lib/emails/landing-registration.ts
import type { PaymentAccount } from "@/lib/data/landing-payment-accounts";
import { isValidWaGroupUrl, type WaGroupButton } from "@/lib/landing/registration/wa-groups";

/**
 * Registration emails ported from the legacy PPC/MDC/W20 Apps Scripts (subjects and merge
 * fields kept). Pure builders: the job handlers send them. Every merge value goes through
 * esc(); links are rendered only when they are https (WhatsApp groups only when they pass
 * isValidWaGroupUrl). Subjects are single-line.
 */

export interface BuiltEmail { subject: string; html: string }
export interface RegionInfo { label: string; classTime: string; timezoneLabel: string }
export interface MemberLine { name: string; email: string; whatsapp: string; profession: string }
export interface LandingEmailContext {
  name: string;
  eventLabel: string;
  refId: string;
  optionLabel: string;
  currency: string;
  amount: number;
  groupSize: number;
  region: RegionInfo | null;
  startsOn: string;
  accounts: PaymentAccount[];
  waGroups: WaGroupButton[];
  verifyUrl: string;
  supportWhatsapp: string;
}
export interface AdminAlertContext extends LandingEmailContext {
  email: string;
  whatsapp: string;
  profession: string;
  city: string;
  discovery: string;
  paymentMethod: string;
  promoCode: string;
  voucherUrl: string;
  members: MemberLine[];
  sheetUrl: string;
  agentName: string;
  utmCampaign: string;
  isFree: boolean;
}

const C = { deep: "#023122", primary: "#04704D", mint: "#80D8AD", ink: "#191C1D", muted: "#5B6660", line: "#E2E8E4", soft: "#F2F8F4" };

export function esc(value: unknown): string {
  return String(value ?? "")
    .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
    .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
    .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
    .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
    .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
}
const oneLine = (s: string) => s.replace(/[\r\n]+/g, " ").replace(/\s{2,}/g, " ").trim();
export function firstName(name: string): string {
  return name.trim().split(/\s+/)[0] || "there";
}
export function money(currency: string, amount: number): string {
  return `${currency} ${Math.round(amount).toLocaleString("en-US")}`;
}
export function formatStartsOn(iso: string): string {
  if (!iso.trim()) return "";
  const t = Date.parse(iso);
  if (Number.isNaN(t)) return "";
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", { day: "numeric", month: "long", year: "numeric", timeZone: "Asia/Karachi" }).format(new Date(t));
}
const digits = (s: string) => s.replace(/\D/g, "");
const httpsHref = (url: string): string | null => (/^https:\/\/[^\s"<>]+$/.test(url) ? url : null);

function button(label: string, href: string, solid = true): string {
  const safe = httpsHref(href);
  if (!safe) return "";
  const look = solid ? `background:${C.primary};color:#ffffff;` : `background:#ffffff;color:${C.primary};border:2px solid ${C.primary};`;
  return `<p style="margin:12px 0;"><a href="${esc(safe)}" style="${look}display:inline-block;padding:12px 24px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;">${esc(label)}</a></p>`;
}
const para = (html: string) => `<p style="margin:0 0 14px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.6;color:${C.ink};">${html}</p>`;
const h3 = (text: string) => `<h3 style="margin:20px 0 10px;font-size:16px;color:${C.deep};">${esc(text)}</h3>`;

function table(rows: [string, string][]): string {
  const body = rows
    .filter(([, v]) => v !== "")
    .map(([k, v]) => `<tr><td style="padding:6px 14px 6px 0;color:${C.muted};font-size:14px;vertical-align:top;">${esc(k)}</td><td style="padding:6px 0;font-size:14px;color:${C.ink};font-weight:600;">${esc(v)}</td></tr>`)
    .join("");
  return body ? `<table role="presentation" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="margin:0 0 18px;border-collapse:collapse;">${body}</table>` : "";
}
function refBox(refId: string): string {
  if (!refId) return "";
  return `<div style="margin:0 0 18px;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:8px;background:${C.soft};border:1px solid ${C.line};"><div style="font-size:12px;color:${C.muted};text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;">Your reference ID</div><div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:700;color:${C.deep};">${esc(refId)}</div></div>`;
}
function accountsHtml(accounts: PaymentAccount[]): string {
  if (accounts.length === 0) return "";
  const cards = accounts
    .map((a) => `<div style="margin:0 0 10px;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid ${C.line};border-radius:8px;"><div style="font-weight:700;color:${C.deep};margin-bottom:6px;">${esc(a.label)}</div>${a.rows.map((r) => `<div style="font-size:14px;color:${C.ink};">${esc(r.label)}: <strong>${esc(r.value)}</strong></div>`).join("")}</div>`)
    .join("");
  return `${h3("Payment accounts")}${para("If you still need to pay, use one of these accounts:")}${cards}`;
}
function waHtml(groups: WaGroupButton[], intro: string): string {
  const buttons = groups.filter((g) => isValidWaGroupUrl(g.url)).map((g) => button(`Join ${g.label} group`, g.url)).join("");
  return buttons ? `${h3("WhatsApp group")}${para(esc(intro))}${buttons}` : "";
}
const scheduleRows = (c: LandingEmailContext): [string, string][] => [
  ["Class time", c.region ? `${c.region.classTime} (${c.region.timezoneLabel})` : ""],
  ["Starts", c.startsOn],
];

function shell(heading: string, bodyHtml: string, supportWhatsapp: string): string {
  const n = digits(supportWhatsapp);
  const support = n ? `Questions? WhatsApp us at <a href="https://wa.me/${n}" style="color:${C.primary};">+${n}</a>.` : "";
  return `<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"><title>${esc(heading)}</title></head><body style="margin:0;padding:0;background:#f4f7f5;font-family:Inter,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;"><table role="presentation" width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0"><tr><td align="center" style="padding:32px 16px;"><table role="presentation" width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="max-width:560px;background:#ffffff;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;"><tr><td style="background:${C.deep};padding:28px 24px;text-align:center;"><div style="font-family:Montserrat,sans-serif;font-size:24px;font-weight:700;color:${C.mint};">PZ Academy</div></td></tr><tr><td style="padding:28px 24px;"><h1 style="margin:0 0 18px;font-family:Montserrat,sans-serif;font-size:21px;color:${C.deep};">${esc(heading)}</h1>${bodyHtml}<p style="margin:24px 0 0;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid ${C.line};font-size:13px;color:${C.muted};">${support}</p></td></tr></table></td></tr></table></body></html>`;
}

export function buildReceivedEmail(c: LandingEmailContext): BuiltEmail {
  const fn = firstName(c.name);
  const body = [
    para(`Hi ${esc(fn)}, thank you for registering for <strong>${esc(c.eventLabel)}</strong>. We will check your payment screenshot and confirm your seat within 24 hours.`),
    refBox(c.refId),
    table([["Registration", c.optionLabel], ["Amount due", money(c.currency, c.amount)], ["Group size", c.groupSize > 1 ? String(c.groupSize) : ""], ...scheduleRows(c)]),
    accountsHtml(c.accounts),
    waHtml(c.waGroups, "Join the group for session updates. We approve join requests once your payment is verified."),
    c.verifyUrl ? para("Want it confirmed faster? Send us your details on WhatsApp:") + button("Send verification on WhatsApp", c.verifyUrl, false) : "",
  ].join("");
  return { subject: oneLine(`Got your registration, ${fn} - confirming within 24h`), html: shell("We got your registration", body, c.supportWhatsapp) };
}

export function buildMemberReceivedEmail(c: LandingEmailContext & { leadName: string }): BuiltEmail {
  const fn = firstName(c.name);
  const body = [
    para(`Hi ${esc(fn)}, ${esc(c.leadName)} has registered you for <strong>${esc(c.eventLabel)}</strong> as part of their group. Your group lead handles the payment, and we will confirm within 24 hours.`),
    refBox(c.refId),
    table([["Registration", c.optionLabel], ...scheduleRows(c)]),
    waHtml(c.waGroups, "Join the group for session updates. We approve join requests once the payment is verified."),
  ].join("");
  return { subject: oneLine(`You're in ${firstName(c.leadName)}'s group - confirming within 24h`), html: shell("You're in the group", body, c.supportWhatsapp) };
}

export function buildFreeJoiningEmail(c: LandingEmailContext): BuiltEmail {
  const fn = firstName(c.name);
  const body = [
    para(`Hi ${esc(fn)}, you're registered for <strong>${esc(c.eventLabel)}</strong>. Here is how to join.`),
    refBox(c.refId),
    table([["Registration", c.optionLabel], ...scheduleRows(c)]),
    waHtml(c.waGroups, "The live link is shared only in this group before the session. Join now so you don't miss it."),
  ].join("");
  return { subject: oneLine(`You're in, ${fn} - here are your joining details`), html: shell("Your joining details", body, c.supportWhatsapp) };
}

export function buildAdminAlertEmail(c: AdminAlertContext): BuiltEmail {
  const kind = c.groupSize > 1 ? "Group" : "Individual";
  const amount = c.isFree ? "Free" : money(c.currency, c.amount);
  const membersHtml = c.members.length
    ? `${h3("Group members")}<table role="presentation" cellpadding="6" cellspacing="0" style="border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13px;margin:0 0 18px;"><tr>${["Name", "Email", "WhatsApp", "Profession"].map((h) => `<th align="left" style="border-bottom:1px solid ${C.line};color:${C.muted};">${h}</th>`).join("")}</tr>${c.members.map((m) => `<tr><td>${esc(m.name)}</td><td>${esc(m.email)}</td><td>${esc(m.whatsapp)}</td><td>${esc(m.profession)}</td></tr>`).join("")}</table>`
    : "";
  const body = [
    table([
      ["Ref", c.refId], ["Name", c.name], ["Email", c.email], ["WhatsApp", c.whatsapp], ["Profession", c.profession],
      ["City / country", c.city], ["Region", c.region?.label ?? ""], ["Heard via", c.discovery], ["Registration", c.optionLabel],
      ["Expected amount", amount], ["Payment via", c.paymentMethod], ["Promo code", c.promoCode],
      ["Group size", c.groupSize > 1 ? String(c.groupSize) : ""], ["Agent", c.agentName], ["UTM campaign", c.utmCampaign],
    ]),
    membersHtml,
    button("View receipt", c.voucherUrl),
    button("Open sheet", c.sheetUrl, false),
    digits(c.whatsapp) ? button(`WhatsApp ${firstName(c.name)}`, `https://wa.me/${digits(c.whatsapp)}`, false) : "",
  ].join("");
  return {
    subject: oneLine(`${kind} ${c.eventLabel} Registration - ${c.name}${c.groupSize > 1 ? ` x${c.groupSize}` : ""} - ${amount}`),
    html: shell(`New ${kind.toLowerCase()} registration`, body, ""),
  };
}

export function buildVoucherResubmittedEmail(c: { name: string; email: string; refId: string; eventLabel: string; voucherUrl: string; sheetUrl: string }): BuiltEmail {
  const body = [
    para(`${esc(c.name)} (${esc(c.email)}) uploaded a new payment screenshot for <strong>${esc(c.eventLabel)}</strong>.`),
    table([["Ref", c.refId]]),
    button("View new receipt", c.voucherUrl),
    button("Open sheet", c.sheetUrl, false),
  ].join("");
  return { subject: oneLine(`New voucher uploaded - ${c.name} (${c.refId})`), html: shell("New payment screenshot", body, "") };
}

export function withTestPrefix(e: BuiltEmail): BuiltEmail {
  return { ...e, subject: `[TEST] ${e.subject}` };
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/landing/registration/background.ts
import "server-only";
import { waitUntil } from "@vercel/functions";

/**
 * Keeps work running after the response is sent (Next 14.2 has no stable after()).
 * On Vercel, waitUntil extends the function's lifetime; locally the promise simply runs.
 * Rejections are swallowed here: anything that matters is retried by the landing_jobs outbox.
 */
export function runInBackground(task: Promise<unknown>): void {
  waitUntil(
    task.catch((err: unknown) => {
      console.error("[landing] background task failed:", err instanceof Error ? err.message : "unknown error");
    }),
  );
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/landing/registration/job-handlers.ts
import "server-only";
import { sendTransactionalEmail } from "@/lib/brevo";
import { createAdminSupabase } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";
import { getRegistrationBundle, markEmailStatus, type RegistrationBundle, type RegistrationRecord } from "@/lib/data/landing-registrations";
import { getRegistrablePageById, type RegistrablePage } from "@/lib/data/landing-public";
import { listPaymentAccounts } from "@/lib/data/landing-payment-accounts";
import { appendRegistrationRows } from "@/lib/gas/event-sheet-client";
import { toSheetRow, type SheetRegistration } from "./sheet-row";
import { selectWaGroups } from "./wa-groups";
import { buildVerifyMessage, whatsappVerifyUrl } from "./labels";
import {
  buildAdminAlertEmail, buildFreeJoiningEmail, buildMemberReceivedEmail, buildReceivedEmail, buildVoucherResubmittedEmail,
  formatStartsOn, withTestPrefix, type BuiltEmail, type LandingEmailContext,
} from "@/lib/emails/landing-registration";
import type { JobType } from "@/lib/data/landing-jobs";

/** email_status value once the "received" email reached this person (makes retries idempotent). */
export const RECEIVED_SENT = "received_sent";

type Loaded = { bundle: RegistrationBundle; page: RegistrablePage };

async function load(registrationId: string): Promise<Loaded | null> {
  const bundle = await getRegistrationBundle(registrationId);
  if (!bundle) return null;
  const page = await getRegistrablePageById(bundle.lead.pageId);
  return page ? { bundle, page } : null;
}

async function agentNameFor(agentId: string | null): Promise<string> {
  if (!agentId) return "";
  const { data } = await createAdminSupabase().from("profiles").select("full_name").eq("id", agentId).maybeSingle();
  return data?.full_name ?? "";
}

/** Test mode (ruling 2): mail only the admin who ran the test (stored as the test row's student_id). */
async function testRecipient(lead: RegistrationRecord): Promise<string | null> {
  if (!lead.studentId) return null;
  const { data } = await createAdminSupabase().auth.admin.getUserById(lead.studentId);
  return data?.user?.email ?? null;
}

async function deliver(lead: RegistrationRecord, intendedTo: string, toName: string, email: BuiltEmail): Promise<void> {
  const to = lead.isTest ? await testRecipient(lead) : intendedTo;
  if (!to) return;
  const final = lead.isTest ? withTestPrefix(email) : email;
  await sendTransactionalEmail({ to, toName, subject: final.subject, htmlContent: final.html });
}

const sheetUrl = (page: RegistrablePage) => (page.sheetId ? `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${page.sheetId}/edit` : "");

async function emailContext(lead: RegistrationRecord, page: RegistrablePage): Promise<LandingEmailContext> {
  const cfg = page.registration;
  const region = cfg.regions.find((r) => r.key === lead.region) ?? null;
  const isFree = lead.status === "free";
  const accounts = !isFree && region ? await listPaymentAccounts(region.accountKeys) : [];
  const refId = lead.refId ?? "";
  const verifyMessage = buildVerifyMessage(cfg, { name: lead.name, email: lead.email, refId, optionLabel: lead.optionLabel, isFree });
  return {
    name: lead.name,
    eventLabel: cfg.eventLabel || page.title,
    refId,
    optionLabel: lead.optionLabel,
    currency: lead.currency,
    amount: lead.expectedAmount ?? 0,
    groupSize: lead.groupSize,
    region: region ? { label: region.label, classTime: region.classTime, timezoneLabel: region.timezoneLabel } : null,
    startsOn: formatStartsOn(page.content.settings.countdownTo),
    accounts,
    waGroups: selectWaGroups(cfg, lead.optionKeys, lead.mode),
    verifyUrl: verifyMessage ? whatsappVerifyUrl(cfg.whatsappVerifyNumber, verifyMessage) : "",
    supportWhatsapp: cfg.whatsappVerifyNumber,
  };
}

/**
 * One database row -> Part A's SheetRegistration (Task 5). Members carry the lead's ref and
 * email (ruling 1) and no payment method; the whole-registration total rides on every row
 * (toSheetRow blanks it on member rows). `paymentMethodLabel` is the lead's account label.
 */
export function toSheetRegistration(
  r: RegistrationRecord,
  lead: RegistrationRecord,
  page: RegistrablePage,
  agentName: string,
  paymentMethodLabel: string,
): SheetRegistration {
  return {
    rowType: r.rowType,
    name: r.name,
    email: r.email,
    whatsapp: r.whatsapp,
    profession: r.profession,
    discovery: r.discovery,
    optionLabel: r.optionLabel,
    promoCodeText: r.promoCodeText ?? "",
    promoCodeUsed: lead.promoCodeText ?? "",
    voucherUrl: r.voucherUrl ?? "",
    submittedAt: r.createdAt,
    expectedAmount: lead.expectedAmount ?? 0,
    currency: lead.currency,
    groupLeadEmail: lead.email,
    paymentMethodLabel: r.rowType === "member" ? "" : paymentMethodLabel,
    amountReceived: r.amountReceived,
    status: r.status,
    emailStatus: r.emailStatus ?? "",
    source: `landing:${page.slug}`,
    refId: lead.refId ?? "",
    regionKey: lead.region,
    agentName,
    utmCampaign: lead.utm.utm_campaign ?? "",
  };
}

async function sheetAppend(registrationId: string): Promise<void> {
  const loaded = await load(registrationId);
  if (!loaded) return;
  const { bundle, page } = loaded;
  if (bundle.lead.isTest || !page.sheetId) return; // nothing to write: done, not failed
  const agentName = await agentNameFor(bundle.lead.agentId);
  const method = bundle.lead.paymentMethod ?? "";
  const accounts = method ? await listPaymentAccounts([method]) : [];
  const paymentMethodLabel = accounts[0]?.label ?? method;
  const rows = [bundle.lead, ...bundle.members].map((r) =>
    toSheetRow(toSheetRegistration(r, bundle.lead, page, agentName, paymentMethodLabel)),
  );
  const res = await appendRegistrationRows(page.sheetId, rows);
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(res.message ?? "Sheet append failed");
}

async function emailReceived(registrationId: string): Promise<void> {
  const loaded = await load(registrationId);
  if (!loaded) return;
  const { lead } = loaded.bundle;
  if (lead.emailStatus === RECEIVED_SENT) return;
  const ctx = await emailContext(lead, loaded.page);
  const email = lead.status === "free" ? buildFreeJoiningEmail(ctx) : buildReceivedEmail(ctx);
  await deliver(lead, lead.email, lead.name, email);
  await markEmailStatus(lead.id, RECEIVED_SENT);
}

async function emailMembers(registrationId: string): Promise<void> {
  const loaded = await load(registrationId);
  if (!loaded) return;
  const { lead, members } = loaded.bundle;
  const pending = members.filter((mem) => mem.emailStatus !== RECEIVED_SENT);
  if (pending.length === 0) return;
  const base = await emailContext(lead, loaded.page);
  let firstError: Error | null = null;
  for (const member of pending) {
    try {
      const ctx = { ...base, name: member.name, accounts: [] };
      const email = lead.status === "free" ? buildFreeJoiningEmail(ctx) : buildMemberReceivedEmail({ ...ctx, leadName: lead.name });
      await deliver(lead, member.email, member.name, email);
      await markEmailStatus(member.id, RECEIVED_SENT);
    } catch (err) {
      if (!firstError) firstError = err instanceof Error ? err : new Error("member email failed");
    }
  }
  if (firstError) throw firstError;
}

async function emailAdmin(registrationId: string): Promise<void> {
  const loaded = await load(registrationId);
  if (!loaded) return;
  const { lead, members } = loaded.bundle;
  const adminTo = process.env.LANDING_ADMIN_EMAIL ?? "";
  if (!lead.isTest && !adminTo) {
    console.warn("[landing-jobs] LANDING_ADMIN_EMAIL is not set; admin alert skipped");
    return;
  }
  const ctx = await emailContext(lead, loaded.page);
  const email = buildAdminAlertEmail({
    ...ctx,
    email: lead.email,
    whatsapp: lead.whatsapp,
    profession: lead.profession,
    city: lead.city,
    discovery: lead.discovery,
    paymentMethod: lead.paymentMethod ?? "",
    promoCode: lead.promoCodeText ?? "",
    voucherUrl: lead.voucherUrl ?? "",
    members: members.map((mem) => ({ name: mem.name, email: mem.email, whatsapp: mem.whatsapp, profession: mem.profession })),
    sheetUrl: sheetUrl(loaded.page),
    agentName: await agentNameFor(lead.agentId),
    utmCampaign: lead.utm.utm_campaign ?? "",
    isFree: lead.status === "free",
  });
  await deliver(lead, adminTo, "PZ Academy", email);
}

/** Resubmitted voucher: one best-effort alert to the team. Never throws (not an outbox job). */
export async function notifyVoucherResubmitted(registrationId: string): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const to = process.env.LANDING_ADMIN_EMAIL;
    if (!to) return;
    const loaded = await load(registrationId);
    if (!loaded) return;
    const { lead } = loaded.bundle;
    const email = buildVoucherResubmittedEmail({
      name: lead.name,
      email: lead.email,
      refId: lead.refId ?? "",
      eventLabel: loaded.page.registration.eventLabel || loaded.page.title,
      voucherUrl: lead.voucherUrl ?? "",
      sheetUrl: sheetUrl(loaded.page),
    });
    await sendTransactionalEmail({ to, toName: "PZ Academy", subject: email.subject, htmlContent: email.html });
  } catch {
    console.warn("[landing-jobs] voucher re-upload alert failed");
  }
}

export const JOB_HANDLERS: Record<JobType, (registrationId: string) => Promise<void>> = {
  sheet_append: sheetAppend,
  email_received: emailReceived,
  email_members: emailMembers,
  email_admin: emailAdmin,
};
```

```ts
// src/lib/data/landing-jobs.ts
import "server-only";
import { createAdminSupabase } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";
import { JOB_HANDLERS } from "@/lib/landing/registration/job-handlers";

/**
 * Outbox for registration side effects (Sheet row, emails). The register route enqueues
 * and immediately runs them via waitUntil; the daily cron and the admin Retry button drain
 * whatever is left. A job is claimed by bumping `attempts` with an optimistic filter on the
 * old value and taking a 10-minute lease in next_run_at, so two workers never run it twice
 * and a crashed worker's job is picked up again after the lease.
 */

export type JobType = "sheet_append" | "email_received" | "email_members" | "email_admin";
export const JOB_TYPES: readonly JobType[] = ["sheet_append", "email_received", "email_members", "email_admin"];
export const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5;
export const BACKOFF_MINUTES = [1, 5, 15, 60] as const;
const LEASE_MINUTES = 10;

interface JobRow { id: string; registration_id: string; type: string; attempts: number }
type Outcome = "done" | "retry" | "failed" | "skipped";

const plusMinutes = (d: Date, m: number) => new Date(d.getTime() + m * 60_000).toISOString();

/** When to try again after `failedAttempts` failures (1-based): 1, 5, 15, then 60 minutes. */
export function nextRunAt(failedAttempts: number, now: Date): string {
  const i = Math.min(Math.max(failedAttempts, 1), BACKOFF_MINUTES.length) - 1;
  return plusMinutes(now, BACKOFF_MINUTES[i]);
}

export async function enqueueJobs(registrationId: string, types: JobType[]): Promise<void> {
  if (types.length === 0) return;
  try {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const { error } = await createAdminSupabase()
      .from("landing_jobs")
      .insert(types.map((type) => ({ registration_id: registrationId, type, status: "pending", attempts: 0, next_run_at: now })));
    if (error) console.error("[landing-jobs] enqueue failed:", error.code);
  } catch {
    console.error("[landing-jobs] enqueue crashed");
  }
}

async function runJob(job: JobRow): Promise<Outcome> {
  const admin = createAdminSupabase();
  const attempts = job.attempts + 1;
  const { data: claimed } = await admin
    .from("landing_jobs")
    .update({ status: "running", attempts, next_run_at: plusMinutes(new Date(), LEASE_MINUTES) })
    .eq("id", job.id)
    .eq("attempts", job.attempts)
    .in("status", ["pending", "running"])
    .select("id")
    .maybeSingle();
  if (!claimed) return "skipped";

  try {
    const handler = JOB_HANDLERS[job.type as JobType];
    if (!handler) throw new Error(`Unknown job type ${job.type}`);
    await handler(job.registration_id);
    await admin.from("landing_jobs").update({ status: "done", last_error: null }).eq("id", job.id);
    return "done";
  } catch (err) {
    const message = (err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)).slice(0, 500);
    const dead = attempts >= MAX_ATTEMPTS;
    await admin
      .from("landing_jobs")
      .update(dead ? { status: "failed", last_error: message } : { status: "pending", last_error: message, next_run_at: nextRunAt(attempts, new Date()) })
      .eq("id", job.id);
    console.warn(`[landing-jobs] ${job.type} attempt ${attempts} failed`);
    return dead ? "failed" : "retry";
  }
}

const byTypeOrder = (a: JobRow, b: JobRow) => JOB_TYPES.indexOf(a.type as JobType) - JOB_TYPES.indexOf(b.type as JobType);

/** Runs this registration's due jobs in a fixed order (Sheet first). Never throws. */
export async function runJobsFor(registrationId: string): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const { data } = await createAdminSupabase()
      .from("landing_jobs")
      .select("id, registration_id, type, attempts")
      .eq("registration_id", registrationId)
      .eq("status", "pending")
      .lte("next_run_at", new Date().toISOString());
    for (const job of [...((data ?? []) as JobRow[])].sort(byTypeOrder)) await runJob(job);
  } catch {
    console.error("[landing-jobs] runJobsFor crashed");
  }
}

export async function drainDueJobs(limit = 25): Promise<{ ran: number; failed: number }> {
  let ran = 0;
  let failed = 0;
  try {
    const { data } = await createAdminSupabase()
      .from("landing_jobs")
      .select("id, registration_id, type, attempts")
      .in("status", ["pending", "running"])
      .lte("next_run_at", new Date().toISOString())
      .order("next_run_at", { ascending: true })
      .limit(limit);
    for (const job of (data ?? []) as JobRow[]) {
      const outcome = await runJob(job);
      if (outcome === "skipped") continue;
      ran += 1;
      if (outcome !== "done") failed += 1;
    }
  } catch {
    console.error("[landing-jobs] drain crashed");
  }
  return { ran, failed };
}

/** Admin Retry: failed jobs of one page go back to pending with a fresh attempt budget. */
export async function retryFailedJobs(pageId: string): Promise<number> {
  const admin = createAdminSupabase();
  const { data: regs, error } = await admin.from("landing_registrations").select("id").eq("page_id", pageId).in("row_type", ["individual", "lead"]);
  if (error) throw error;
  const ids = (regs ?? []).map((r) => r.id);
  let total = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i += 200) {
    const { data, error: upErr } = await admin
      .from("landing_jobs")
      .update({ status: "pending", attempts: 0, next_run_at: new Date().toISOString() })
      .in("registration_id", ids.slice(i, i + 200))
      .eq("status", "failed")
      .select("id");
    if (upErr) throw upErr;
    total += (data ?? []).length;
  }
  return total;
}
```

```ts
// src/app/api/cron/landing-jobs/route.ts
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { drainDueJobs } from "@/lib/data/landing-jobs";

// Cron target: must run per request (same reason as /api/keep-alive).
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";
export const maxDuration = 60;

/**
 * Daily safety net for the landing_jobs outbox (Hobby plan: crons run at most once a day).
 * Registrations normally run their own jobs via waitUntil; this catches anything that
 * crashed or is waiting on backoff.
 */
export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const cronSecret = process.env.CRON_SECRET;
  if (cronSecret && req.headers.get("authorization") !== `Bearer ${cronSecret}`) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }
  const result = await drainDueJobs(25);
  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, ...result });
}
```

```ts
// src/app/api/admin/landing-pages/[id]/jobs/retry/route.ts
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth/require-admin";
import { isPageId } from "@/lib/validations/landing";
import { drainDueJobs, retryFailedJobs } from "@/lib/data/landing-jobs";
import { runInBackground } from "@/lib/landing/registration/background";

export const maxDuration = 60;

export async function POST(_req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const auth = await requireAdmin();
  if (!auth.ok) return auth.response;
  const { id } = await params;
  // Part 0 L2: a malformed id is "not found" after the auth gate, before any query.
  if (!isPageId(id)) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Page not found" }, { status: 404 });
  try {
    const requeued = await retryFailedJobs(id);
    runInBackground(drainDueJobs(25));
    return NextResponse.json({ requeued });
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Could not retry the waiting jobs." }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
```

### Task 11: Public read routes (config, quote + promo, status, funnel event, me)

Five JSON routes outside `/api/admin`, exactly the contract's "Public API routes" list minus `register` (Task 12). Every `[slug]` route looks the page up with `getRegistrablePage(slug)`, so drafts (and unknown or malformed slugs) are 404 before anything else runs. Behaviour per route:

| Route | Draft / unknown | `registration.enabled = false` | Closed page |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET config` | 404 | 404 "Registration is not open on this page." | 200 with `status: "closed"` (the widget shows "closed") |
| `POST quote` | 404 | 404 | 200 (read-only pricing; an admin can test a closed page, see Task 12) |
| `GET status` | 404 | 200 (people check status after the form is switched off) | 200 |
| `POST event` | 404 | 204 (page analytics) | 204 |

Every reply carries `Cache-Control: no-store`: `config` depends on the visitor's country header and on the clock (Early Bird), the others on the request body or the session. `x-vercel-ip-country` is only trusted when it is two capital letters.

`config` hides two fields from the public copy: every `options[].waGroupUrl` (the group links are only revealed in the register reply, so they cannot be scraped from the page) and `refPrefix` (internal). The shape stays `RegistrationConfig & { earlyBirdActive: boolean }`, which is what the Part C widget types as `PublicConfig.registration` and passes to `computeQuote`.

```ts
// src/lib/validations/landing-public.ts
// Request schemas of the public /api/landing/* routes. Pure: safe to import anywhere.
import { z } from "zod";
import { MAX_GROUP_SIZE } from "@/lib/landing/registration/config";

const SLUG_RE = /^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$/;
const EMAIL_RE = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;

/** Same shape rule as Phase 1 slugs. Anything else can never match a page, so it is a 404 without a query. */
export function isPublicSlug(slug: string): boolean {
  return slug.length >= 3 && slug.length <= 60 && SLUG_RE.test(slug);
}

export function isEmail(v: string): boolean {
  return v.length <= 200 && EMAIL_RE.test(v);
}

export const quoteRequestSchema = z.object({
  regionKey: z.string().trim().min(1).max(6),
  mode: z.enum(["live", "recorded"]),
  optionKeys: z.array(z.string().min(1).max(32)).min(1).max(12),
  tierKey: z.string().min(1).max(32),
  groupSize: z.number().int().min(1).max(MAX_GROUP_SIZE),
  promoCode: z.string().trim().toUpperCase().max(40).default(""),
  email: z.string().trim().toLowerCase().max(200).default(""),
});

export const FUNNEL_TYPES = ["view", "start", "step", "submit"] as const;

export const eventRequestSchema = z.object({
  // crypto.randomUUID() or "<ms>-<8 base-36 chars>" from the widget.
  sessionId: z.string().regex(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,100}$/),
  type: z.enum(FUNNEL_TYPES),
  utm: z.unknown().optional(),
  ref: z.string().max(100).optional(),
});

export const statusQuerySchema = z.object({
  ref: z.string().trim().toUpperCase().regex(/^[A-Z0-9-]{3,40}$/),
  email: z.string().trim().toLowerCase().max(200).regex(EMAIL_RE),
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/landing/registration/public-config.ts
// What the public registration routes may show about a page's registration settings. Pure (client-safe).
import type { RegistrationConfig } from "./config";
import { isEarlyBird, type QuoteResult } from "./pricing";

/** Same shape as the stored config (the widget prices with it), plus the server's Early Bird verdict. */
export type PublicRegistration = RegistrationConfig & { earlyBirdActive: boolean };
export type QuoteFailureReason = Extract<QuoteResult, { ok: false }>["reason"];

/**
 * WhatsApp group links are returned only by the register route (after someone registers), so they
 * cannot be lifted from the page source. The ref prefix is internal.
 */
export function toPublicRegistration(config: RegistrationConfig, now: Date): PublicRegistration {
  return {
    ...config,
    options: config.options.map((o) => ({ ...o, waGroupUrl: "" })),
    refPrefix: "",
    earlyBirdActive: isEarlyBird(config, now),
  };
}

/** Every payment account any region uses, each once, in region order. */
export function regionAccountKeys(config: RegistrationConfig): string[] {
  return [...new Set(config.regions.flatMap((r) => r.accountKeys))];
}

/** People-facing text (and the form field to highlight) for a selection the engine cannot price. */
export const QUOTE_ERRORS: Record<QuoteFailureReason, { message: string; field: string }> = {
  no_region: { message: "Choose the country you are registering from.", field: "regionKey" },
  mode_not_offered: { message: "That learning mode is not offered for this event.", field: "mode" },
  no_option: { message: "Choose what you want to register for.", field: "optionKeys" },
  no_price: { message: "That option is not available in your country.", field: "optionKeys" },
  mixed_free: { message: "Free and paid options cannot be combined. Choose one of them.", field: "optionKeys" },
  bad_tier: { message: "Choose individual or one of the group options.", field: "tierKey" },
  bad_group_size: { message: "The number of people does not match the group option you chose.", field: "groupSize" },
  free_group: { message: "Group registration is only available for paid options.", field: "tierKey" },
};
```

```ts
// src/lib/api/landing-public-http.ts
import "server-only";
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getRegistrablePage, type RegistrablePage } from "@/lib/data/landing-public";
import { isPublicSlug } from "@/lib/validations/landing-public";

/**
 * Public landing replies are never cached by the CDN or the browser: they depend on the
 * visitor's country header, the clock (Early Bird) and the request body or session.
 */
export const NO_STORE: Record<string, string> = { "Cache-Control": "no-store" };

export const CLOSED_MESSAGE = "Registration for this event is closed.";

export function publicJson(body: unknown, status = 200, headers: Record<string, string> = NO_STORE): NextResponse {
  return NextResponse.json(body, { status, headers });
}

export type PageGate = { ok: true; page: RegistrablePage } | { ok: false; response: NextResponse };

/**
 * Shared page lookup for /api/landing/[slug]/*. Drafts, unknown and malformed slugs are 404
 * (never a hint that a draft exists). With `registration: true` (the default) a page whose
 * registration form is switched off is also 404. Closed pages pass: each route decides.
 */
export async function loadPublicPage(slug: string, opts: { registration: boolean } = { registration: true }): Promise<PageGate> {
  if (!isPublicSlug(slug)) return { ok: false, response: publicJson({ error: "Page not found" }, 404) };
  let page: RegistrablePage | null;
  try {
    page = await getRegistrablePage(slug);
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, response: publicJson({ error: "We could not load this page. Please try again in a moment." }, 500) };
  }
  if (!page) return { ok: false, response: publicJson({ error: "Page not found" }, 404) };
  if (opts.registration && !page.registration.enabled) {
    return { ok: false, response: publicJson({ error: "Registration is not open on this page." }, 404) };
  }
  return { ok: true, page };
}
```

```ts
// src/app/api/landing/[slug]/config/route.ts
import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { listPaymentAccounts, type PaymentAccount } from "@/lib/data/landing-payment-accounts";
import { loadPublicPage, publicJson } from "@/lib/api/landing-public-http";
import { regionAccountKeys, toPublicRegistration } from "@/lib/landing/registration/public-config";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const COUNTRY_RE = /^[A-Z]{2}$/;

/** Everything the registration widget needs, read once when the modal opens. */
export async function GET(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }) {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const gate = await loadPublicPage(slug);
  if (!gate.ok) return gate.response;
  const { page } = gate;

  let accounts: PaymentAccount[];
  try {
    accounts = await listPaymentAccounts(regionAccountKeys(page.registration));
  } catch {
    return publicJson({ error: "We could not load the payment details. Please try again in a moment." }, 500);
  }

  // Set by Vercel's edge from the visitor's IP; only a hint for the default region (the visitor can change it).
  const country = (req.headers.get("x-vercel-ip-country") ?? "").trim().toUpperCase();
  return publicJson({
    pageId: page.id,
    status: page.status,
    registration: toPublicRegistration(page.registration, new Date()),
    accounts,
    country: COUNTRY_RE.test(country) ? country : null,
  });
}
```

```ts
// src/app/api/landing/[slug]/quote/route.ts
import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { emailUsedPromo, getPromoByCode } from "@/lib/data/landing-promo-codes";
import { loadPublicPage, publicJson } from "@/lib/api/landing-public-http";
import { computeQuote } from "@/lib/landing/registration/pricing";
import { applyPromo } from "@/lib/landing/registration/promo";
import { isEmail, quoteRequestSchema } from "@/lib/validations/landing-public";

/**
 * Live price for the widget's order summary. The register route repeats this exact calculation
 * on submit; nothing the browser computes is ever stored. A failed quote is data (200), not an error.
 * Closed pages still quote: it is read-only, and an admin may run a test registration on them.
 */
export async function POST(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }) {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const gate = await loadPublicPage(slug);
  if (!gate.ok) return gate.response;
  const { page } = gate;

  const parsed = quoteRequestSchema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => null));
  if (!parsed.success) return publicJson({ error: "Invalid input" }, 400);
  const b = parsed.data;

  const now = new Date();
  const quote = computeQuote({
    config: page.registration, regionKey: b.regionKey, mode: b.mode, optionKeys: b.optionKeys, tierKey: b.tierKey, groupSize: b.groupSize, now,
  });
  if (!quote.ok || quote.isFree || !b.promoCode) return publicJson({ quote });

  try {
    const promoCode = await getPromoByCode(b.promoCode);
    const emailAlreadyUsed = promoCode !== null && promoCode.oneperEmail && isEmail(b.email)
      ? await emailUsedPromo(promoCode.id, b.email)
      : false;
    const promo = applyPromo({
      promo: promoCode, pageId: page.id, optionKeys: quote.optionKeys, currency: quote.currency, total: quote.total, now, emailAlreadyUsed,
    });
    return publicJson({ quote, promo });
  } catch {
    return publicJson({ error: "We could not check that promo code. Please try again." }, 500);
  }
}
```

```ts
// src/app/api/landing/[slug]/status/route.ts
import { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { getRegistrationStatus } from "@/lib/data/landing-registrations";
import { loadPublicPage, publicJson } from "@/lib/api/landing-public-http";
import { statusQuerySchema } from "@/lib/validations/landing-public";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

/** "Check my registration": reference + the email used. Works after registration is switched off. */
export async function GET(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }) {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const gate = await loadPublicPage(slug, { registration: false });
  if (!gate.ok) return gate.response;

  const url = new URL(req.url);
  const parsed = statusQuerySchema.safeParse({ ref: url.searchParams.get("ref") ?? "", email: url.searchParams.get("email") ?? "" });
  if (!parsed.success) {
    return publicJson({ error: "Enter your reference (for example PZA-PPC-001) and the email you registered with." }, 400);
  }

  try {
    // Scoped to the page in the URL: a ref + email from another event is "not found" here.
    const found = await getRegistrationStatus(parsed.data.ref, parsed.data.email, gate.page.id);
    if (!found) {
      return publicJson({ error: "We could not find a registration with that reference and email. Check both and try again." }, 404);
    }
    return publicJson(found);
  } catch {
    return publicJson({ error: "We could not check your registration. Please try again in a moment." }, 500);
  }
}
```

```ts
// src/app/api/landing/[slug]/event/route.ts
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { recordFunnelEvent } from "@/lib/data/landing-funnel";
import { resolveAgentCode } from "@/lib/data/landing-agent-links";
import { loadPublicPage, NO_STORE, publicJson } from "@/lib/api/landing-public-http";
import { cleanUtm } from "@/lib/landing/registration/utm";
import { eventRequestSchema } from "@/lib/validations/landing-public";

/**
 * Funnel analytics (view / start / step / submit). The widget sends it with navigator.sendBeacon,
 * whose body arrives as text, so the body is read as text and parsed here.
 */
export async function POST(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }) {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const gate = await loadPublicPage(slug, { registration: false });
  if (!gate.ok) return gate.response;

  let raw: unknown = null;
  try {
    raw = JSON.parse(await req.text());
  } catch {
    raw = null;
  }
  const parsed = eventRequestSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return publicJson({ error: "Invalid input" }, 400);

  const agent = parsed.data.ref ? await resolveAgentCode(parsed.data.ref) : null;
  await recordFunnelEvent({
    pageId: gate.page.id,
    sessionId: parsed.data.sessionId,
    type: parsed.data.type,
    utm: cleanUtm(parsed.data.utm),
    agentId: agent?.agentId ?? null,
  });
  return new NextResponse(null, { status: 204, headers: NO_STORE });
}
```

```ts
// src/app/api/landing/me/route.ts
import { createServerSupabase } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { publicJson } from "@/lib/api/landing-public-http";

// Session based: must run per request and must never be cached.
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

/**
 * Prefill for the registration widget when the visitor is signed in. The public page itself is
 * static (ISR), so it asks here instead of reading cookies. Guests (and any error) get null.
 */
export async function GET() {
  try {
    const supabase = await createServerSupabase();
    const {
      data: { user },
    } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
    if (!user) return publicJson(null);
    const { data: profile } = await supabase.from("profiles").select("full_name, phone, profession").eq("id", user.id).maybeSingle();
    return publicJson({
      name: profile?.full_name ?? "",
      email: user.email ?? "",
      whatsapp: profile?.phone ?? "",
      profession: profile?.profession ?? "",
    });
  } catch {
    return publicJson(null);
  }
}
```

The static `me` folder and the dynamic `[slug]` folder are siblings under `src/app/api/landing/`; Next resolves `/api/landing/me` to the static one. No page can take the slug `me` (Phase 1 slugs are at least 3 characters).
