```tsx
// src/components/admin/landing/registration/RegistrationSetup.tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { AlertTriangle, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, ExternalLink, Plus, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { PaymentAccount } from "@/lib/data/landing-payment-accounts";
import { registrationProblems, type Mode, type RegistrationConfig } from "@/lib/landing/registration/config";
import { isValidWaGroupUrl } from "@/lib/landing/registration/wa-groups";
import { REG_STEPS, type RegistrationStepKey } from "@/lib/landing/registration/setup-steps";
import {
  TIER_PRESETS, TZ_CHOICES, addOption, addTier, localToOffsetIso, offsetIsoToLocal, removeOption, removeTier,
  toggleAccount, updateOption, updateTier,
} from "@/lib/landing/registration/admin-edit";
import { PricesStep } from "./PricesStep";
import { WaTestLinkButton } from "./WaTestLinkButton";
import { CONTROL, HELP, ICON_BTN, LABEL } from "./styles";

export type PaymentAccountSummary = Pick<PaymentAccount, "key" | "label" | "kind" | "displayText">;

const CARD = "space-y-3 rounded-xl border border-pz-outline-variant bg-pz-surface-container-low p-4";
const ERROR = "font-body text-xs font-medium text-pz-danger";
const WARN = "flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-pz-warning/40 bg-pz-warning/10 p-2 font-body text-xs text-pz-on-surface";
const TEXT_BTN = "inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-pz-outline-variant px-3 py-2 font-body text-sm font-semibold text-pz-on-surface hover:bg-pz-surface-container-high focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring max-md:min-h-11";

const lines = (v: string) => v.split("\n").map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
const whole = (v: string, min = 0) => { const n = Number(v); return Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.max(min, Math.round(n)) : min; };

export function RegistrationSetup({
  registration: r, accounts, step, onStep, onChange,
}: {
  registration: RegistrationConfig;
  accounts: PaymentAccountSummary[];
  step: RegistrationStepKey;
  onStep: (s: RegistrationStepKey) => void;
  onChange: (next: RegistrationConfig) => void;
}) {
  const problems = r.enabled ? registrationProblems(r) : [];
  const index = REG_STEPS.findIndex((s) => s.key === step);
  const current = REG_STEPS[index] ?? REG_STEPS[0];

  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="reg-setup-h" className="space-y-4">
      <div className={cn(CARD, "flex items-start justify-between gap-3")}>
        <div>
          <h3 id="reg-setup-h" className="font-headline text-sm font-bold text-pz-on-surface">Registration form</h3>
          <p className={HELP}>People register and pay on this page. Turn off to send the Register button to a link instead.</p>
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          role="switch"
          aria-checked={r.enabled}
          aria-label="Use the built-in registration form"
          onClick={() => onChange({ ...r, enabled: !r.enabled })}
          className={cn("relative h-6 w-11 shrink-0 rounded-full transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring", r.enabled ? "bg-pz-solid-forest" : "bg-pz-outline-variant")}
        >
          <span className={cn("absolute top-0.5 h-5 w-5 rounded-full bg-pz-surface-container-lowest shadow transition-transform", r.enabled ? "translate-x-5" : "translate-x-0.5")} />
        </button>
      </div>

      <nav aria-label="Registration setup steps">
        <ol className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
          {REG_STEPS.map((s, i) => {
            const count = problems.filter((p) => p.step === s.key).length;
            const active = s.key === current.key;
            return (
              <li key={s.key}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  aria-current={active ? "step" : undefined}
                  onClick={() => onStep(s.key)}
                  className={cn(
                    "inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border px-3 py-1.5 font-body text-xs font-semibold focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring max-md:min-h-11",
                    active ? "border-pz-solid-forest bg-pz-solid-forest text-white" : "border-pz-outline-variant text-pz-on-surface hover:bg-pz-surface-container-high",
                  )}
                >
                  <span>{i + 1} {s.label}</span>
                  {count > 0 && <span className="rounded-full bg-pz-warning px-1.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-pz-on-surface">{count}</span>}
                </button>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ol>
      </nav>

      <div className="space-y-4">
        <h3 className="font-headline text-base font-bold text-pz-on-surface">{current.label}</h3>
        {current.key === "buy" && <BuyStep r={r} onChange={onChange} />}
        {current.key === "groups" && <GroupsStep r={r} onChange={onChange} />}
        {current.key === "prices" && <PricesStep r={r} onChange={onChange} />}
        {current.key === "earlybird" && <EarlyBirdStep r={r} onChange={onChange} />}
        {current.key === "accounts" && <AccountsStep r={r} accounts={accounts} onChange={onChange} />}
        {current.key === "promo" && <PromoStep />}
        {current.key === "whatsapp" && <WhatsAppStep r={r} onChange={onChange} />}
        {current.key === "details" && <DetailsStep r={r} onChange={onChange} />}
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-t border-pz-outline-variant pt-3">
        <button type="button" className={TEXT_BTN} disabled={index <= 0} onClick={() => onStep(REG_STEPS[Math.max(0, index - 1)].key)}>
          <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" /> Back
        </button>
        <button type="button" className={TEXT_BTN} disabled={index >= REG_STEPS.length - 1} onClick={() => onStep(REG_STEPS[Math.min(REG_STEPS.length - 1, index + 1)].key)}>
          Next step <ArrowRight className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
        </button>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

function BuyStep({ r, onChange }: { r: RegistrationConfig; onChange: (n: RegistrationConfig) => void }) {
  const toggleMode = (m: Mode) => onChange({ ...r, modes: r.modes.includes(m) ? r.modes.filter((x) => x !== m) : [...r.modes, m] });
  const bundles = r.options.filter((o) => o.kind === "bundle");
  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <fieldset className={CARD}>
        <legend className={LABEL}>How people take part</legend>
        <label className="flex items-center gap-2 font-body text-sm text-pz-on-surface">
          <input type="checkbox" checked={r.modes.includes("live")} onChange={() => toggleMode("live")} /> Live sessions
        </label>
        <label className="flex items-center gap-2 font-body text-sm text-pz-on-surface">
          <input type="checkbox" checked={r.modes.includes("recorded")} onChange={() => toggleMode("recorded")} /> Recorded lectures
        </label>
        {r.modes.includes("recorded") && (
          <label className="block space-y-1">
            <span className={LABEL}>Recorded price, % of the regular price</span>
            <span className={`block ${HELP}`}>85 means recorded costs 85% of the regular (not Early Bird) price. 100 means the same price.</span>
            <input type="number" inputMode="numeric" min={1} max={100} aria-label="Recorded price, % of the regular price" className={`${CONTROL} w-28`} value={String(r.recordedPercentOfRegular)} onChange={(e) => onChange({ ...r, recordedPercentOfRegular: Math.min(100, whole(e.target.value, 1)) })} />
          </label>
        )}
      </fieldset>

      <section className={CARD} aria-label="Options people can buy">
        <p className={HELP}>A package is chosen on its own (for example Full Course, or Free / Pro). Modules can be combined.</p>
        <ul className="space-y-2">
          {r.options.map((o, i) => (
            <li key={o.key} className="grid grid-cols-[1fr_auto] gap-2 rounded-lg border border-pz-outline-variant bg-pz-surface-container-lowest p-3 lg:grid-cols-[1.6fr_1fr_auto_auto]">
              <input aria-label={`Option ${i + 1} name`} className={CONTROL} value={o.label} onChange={(e) => onChange(updateOption(r, o.key, { label: e.target.value }))} />
              <select aria-label={`Option ${i + 1} type`} className={CONTROL} value={o.kind} onChange={(e) => onChange(updateOption(r, o.key, { kind: e.target.value as "bundle" | "module" }))}>
                <option value="bundle">Whole package</option>
                <option value="module">Single module</option>
              </select>
              <label className="flex items-center gap-2 font-body text-sm text-pz-on-surface">
                <input type="checkbox" checked={o.free} onChange={(e) => onChange(updateOption(r, o.key, { free: e.target.checked }))} /> Free (no payment)
              </label>
              <button type="button" aria-label={`Remove option ${i + 1}`} className={ICON_BTN} onClick={() => onChange(removeOption(r, o.key))}>
                <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
              </button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <button type="button" className={TEXT_BTN} onClick={() => onChange(addOption(r, "bundle", "New package"))}><Plus className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" /> Add a package</button>
          <button type="button" className={TEXT_BTN} onClick={() => onChange(addOption(r, "module", "New module"))}><Plus className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" /> Add a module</button>
        </div>
        {bundles.length > 0 && r.options.some((o) => o.kind === "module") && (
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <label className="flex items-center gap-2 font-body text-sm text-pz-on-surface">
              <input type="checkbox" checked={r.moduleMix.enabled} onChange={(e) => onChange({ ...r, moduleMix: { enabled: e.target.checked, bundleOptionKey: r.moduleMix.bundleOptionKey || bundles[0].key } })} />
              Choosing every module switches to the package
            </label>
            {r.moduleMix.enabled && (
              <select aria-label="Package to switch to" className={`${CONTROL} w-auto`} value={r.moduleMix.bundleOptionKey} onChange={(e) => onChange({ ...r, moduleMix: { enabled: true, bundleOptionKey: e.target.value } })}>
                {bundles.map((b) => <option key={b.key} value={b.key}>{b.label}</option>)}
              </select>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

function GroupsStep({ r, onChange }: { r: RegistrationConfig; onChange: (n: RegistrationConfig) => void }) {
  const presets = TIER_PRESETS.filter((p) => !r.tiers.some((t) => t.key === p.key));
  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <p className={HELP}>Individual (one person, full price) is always offered. Add group sizes with a discount per person. Groups are not offered for free options.</p>
      <ul className="space-y-2">
        {r.tiers.map((t) => (
          <li key={t.key} className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 rounded-lg border border-pz-outline-variant bg-pz-surface-container-lowest p-3 lg:grid-cols-[1.4fr_0.7fr_0.7fr_0.7fr_auto]">
            <input aria-label={`Name for ${t.label}`} className={CONTROL} value={t.label} onChange={(e) => onChange(updateTier(r, t.key, { label: e.target.value }))} />
            <input type="number" inputMode="numeric" aria-label={`Smallest size for ${t.label}`} className={CONTROL} value={String(t.minSize)} onChange={(e) => onChange(updateTier(r, t.key, { minSize: whole(e.target.value, 2) }))} />
            <input type="number" inputMode="numeric" aria-label={`Largest size for ${t.label}`} className={CONTROL} value={String(t.maxSize)} onChange={(e) => onChange(updateTier(r, t.key, { maxSize: whole(e.target.value, 2) }))} />
            <input type="number" inputMode="numeric" aria-label={`Percent off for ${t.label}`} className={CONTROL} value={String(t.percentOff)} onChange={(e) => onChange(updateTier(r, t.key, { percentOff: Math.min(90, whole(e.target.value)) }))} />
            <button type="button" aria-label={`Remove group ${t.label}`} className={ICON_BTN} onClick={() => onChange(removeTier(r, t.key))}><Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" /></button>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        {presets.map((p) => (
          <button key={p.key} type="button" className={TEXT_BTN} onClick={() => onChange(addTier(r, p))}>
            <Plus className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" /> Add {p.label} ({p.percentOff}% off)
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function EarlyBirdStep({ r, onChange }: { r: RegistrationConfig; onChange: (n: RegistrationConfig) => void }) {
  const { local, offset } = offsetIsoToLocal(r.earlyBirdEndsAt);
  const t = Date.parse(r.earlyBirdEndsAt);
  const preview = Number.isNaN(t)
    ? null
    : `Ends ${new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", { dateStyle: "full", timeStyle: "short", timeZone: "Asia/Karachi" }).format(t)} Pakistan time (${new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", { timeStyle: "short", timeZone: "UTC" }).format(t)} UTC)`;
  const choices = TZ_CHOICES.some((c) => c.offset === offset) ? TZ_CHOICES : [...TZ_CHOICES, { label: `UTC${offset}`, offset }];
  return (
    <div className={CARD}>
      <div className="grid gap-3 lg:grid-cols-2">
        <label className="space-y-1">
          <span className={LABEL}>Early Bird ends</span>
          <input type="datetime-local" aria-label="Early Bird ends" className={CONTROL} value={local} onChange={(e) => onChange({ ...r, earlyBirdEndsAt: localToOffsetIso(e.target.value, offset) })} />
        </label>
        <label className="space-y-1">
          <span className={LABEL}>Time zone</span>
          <select aria-label="Time zone" className={CONTROL} value={offset} onChange={(e) => onChange({ ...r, earlyBirdEndsAt: local ? localToOffsetIso(local, e.target.value) : "" })}>
            {choices.map((c) => <option key={c.offset} value={c.offset}>{c.label}</option>)}
          </select>
        </label>
      </div>
      {preview && <p className="font-body text-sm text-pz-on-surface">{preview}</p>}
      <p className={HELP}>Early Bird ends at this exact moment for everyone, wherever they are. Leave it empty for no Early Bird.</p>
      {r.earlyBirdEndsAt && (
        <button type="button" className="font-body text-sm font-semibold text-pz-primary underline-offset-2 hover:underline" onClick={() => onChange({ ...r, earlyBirdEndsAt: "" })}>
          Clear Early Bird
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function AccountsStep({ r, accounts, onChange }: { r: RegistrationConfig; accounts: PaymentAccountSummary[]; onChange: (n: RegistrationConfig) => void }) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <p className={HELP}>Accounts are shared by every page. Visitors only see the accounts ticked for their country. To change an account number, ask a developer (the accounts screen comes later).</p>
      {r.regions.length === 0 && <p className={HELP}>Add a country in "Prices by country" first.</p>}
      {r.regions.map((g) => (
        <fieldset key={g.key} className={CARD} aria-label={g.label}>
          <legend className={LABEL}>{g.label}</legend>
          <ul className="space-y-1.5">
            {accounts.map((a) => (
              <li key={a.key}>
                <label className="flex items-start gap-2 font-body text-sm text-pz-on-surface">
                  <input type="checkbox" className="mt-1" checked={g.accountKeys.includes(a.key)} onChange={() => onChange(toggleAccount(r, g.key, a.key))} />
                  <span>
                    <span className="block font-semibold">{a.label}</span>
                    <span className={HELP}>{a.displayText}</span>
                  </span>
                </label>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </fieldset>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

function PromoStep() {
  return (
    <div className={CARD}>
      <p className="font-body text-sm text-pz-on-surface">Promo codes are made once and can work on one page or on all pages. The server checks every code, so a made-up code never gives a discount.</p>
      <Link href="/dashboard/admin/landing-promo-codes" target="_blank" className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 font-body text-sm font-semibold text-pz-primary underline-offset-2 hover:underline">
        Open promo codes <ExternalLink className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
      </Link>
    </div>
  );
}

function WhatsAppStep({ r, onChange }: { r: RegistrationConfig; onChange: (n: RegistrationConfig) => void }) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <p className={HELP}>People see a Join button for the group of what they chose. Several modules show each module's group; every module or the package shows only the package's group. Recorded lectures show no group.</p>
      <ul className="space-y-3">
        {r.options.map((o) => {
          const bad = o.waGroupUrl !== "" && !isValidWaGroupUrl(o.waGroupUrl);
          return (
            <li key={o.key} className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="block space-y-1">
                <span className={LABEL}>{`WhatsApp group link for ${o.label}`}</span>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <input type="url" aria-label={`WhatsApp group link for ${o.label}`} aria-invalid={bad || undefined} placeholder="https://chat.whatsapp.com/…" className={CONTROL} value={o.waGroupUrl} onChange={(e) => onChange(updateOption(r, o.key, { waGroupUrl: e.target.value.trim() }))} />
                  <WaTestLinkButton url={o.waGroupUrl} />
                </div>
              </label>
              {bad && <p role="alert" className={ERROR}>Paste a WhatsApp group invite link, like https://chat.whatsapp.com/AbC123</p>}
              {o.waGroupUrl === "" && (
                <p className={WARN}><AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-pz-warning" aria-hidden="true" />{`No group link: people who choose ${o.label} won't see a Join button.`}</p>
              )}
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ul>
      <p className={WARN}><AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-pz-warning" aria-hidden="true" />In WhatsApp, open each group&apos;s settings and turn on Approve new members, so only people you have verified can join.</p>
      <label className="block space-y-1">
        <span className={LABEL}>WhatsApp number for payment checks</span>
        <span className={`block ${HELP}`}>Digits only, with country code, for example 923700199429. The success screen's "Message us on WhatsApp" button opens a chat with this number.</span>
        <input inputMode="numeric" aria-label="WhatsApp number for payment checks" className={CONTROL} value={r.whatsappVerifyNumber} onChange={(e) => onChange({ ...r, whatsappVerifyNumber: e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "") })} />
      </label>
    </div>
  );
}

function DetailsStep({ r, onChange }: { r: RegistrationConfig; onChange: (n: RegistrationConfig) => void }) {
  return (
    <div className={cn(CARD, "space-y-4")}>
      <label className="block space-y-1">
        <span className={LABEL}>Event name in messages</span>
        <input aria-label="Event name in messages" placeholder="PPC Batch 3" className={CONTROL} value={r.eventLabel} onChange={(e) => onChange({ ...r, eventLabel: e.target.value })} />
      </label>
      <label className="block space-y-1">
        <span className={LABEL}>Reference prefix</span>
        <span className={`block ${HELP}`}>2 to 6 capital letters or digits. Every registration gets a reference like the one shown.</span>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <input aria-label="Reference prefix" maxLength={6} className={`${CONTROL} w-32`} value={r.refPrefix} onChange={(e) => onChange({ ...r, refPrefix: e.target.value.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, "") })} />
          <span className="rounded-full bg-pz-surface-container-high px-2.5 py-1 font-mono text-xs text-pz-on-surface">{`PZA-${r.refPrefix || "XXX"}-001`}</span>
        </div>
      </label>
      <label className="block space-y-1">
        <span className={LABEL}>Success screen title</span>
        <input aria-label="Success screen title" placeholder="You're registered!" className={CONTROL} value={r.successTitle} onChange={(e) => onChange({ ...r, successTitle: e.target.value })} />
      </label>
      <label className="block space-y-1">
        <span className={LABEL}>Seat limit</span>
        <span className={`block ${HELP}`}>Counts every person, group members included. 0 means no limit.</span>
        <input type="number" inputMode="numeric" min={0} aria-label="Seat limit" className={`${CONTROL} w-28`} value={String(r.capacity)} onChange={(e) => onChange({ ...r, capacity: whole(e.target.value) })} />
      </label>
      <LinesField label="Professions" help="One per line." value={r.professions} onChange={(v) => onChange({ ...r, professions: v })} />
      <LinesField label="How did you hear about us? choices" help="One per line. Leave empty to hide the question." value={r.discoveryOptions} onChange={(v) => onChange({ ...r, discoveryOptions: v })} />
      <label className="block space-y-1">
        <span className={LABEL}>Meta Pixel ID (optional)</span>
        <span className={`block ${HELP}`}>Leave empty to use the academy&apos;s main Pixel.</span>
        <input inputMode="numeric" aria-label="Meta Pixel ID (optional)" className={CONTROL} value={r.pixelId} onChange={(e) => onChange({ ...r, pixelId: e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "") })} />
      </label>
    </div>
  );
}
```

Add `LinesField` at the end of the same file. It keeps the raw text locally so pressing Enter at the end of the list works, and re-syncs from the prop only when the list changed from outside:

```tsx
function LinesField({ label, help, value, onChange }: { label: string; help: string; value: string[]; onChange: (v: string[]) => void }) {
  const [text, setText] = useState(value.join("\n"));
  useEffect(() => {
    if (lines(text).join("\n") !== value.join("\n")) setText(value.join("\n"));
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [value]);
  return (
    <label className="block space-y-1">
      <span className={LABEL}>{label}</span>
      <span className={`block ${HELP}`}>{help}</span>
      <textarea aria-label={label} rows={4} className={CONTROL} value={text} onChange={(e) => { setText(e.target.value); onChange(lines(e.target.value)); }} />
    </label>
  );
}
```

  - `PixelLoader({ pixelId, contentName })` (client; loads the Pixel after `load` + idle; nothing when `pixelId` is empty).

  - `RegistrationLauncher({ className, children })`, `RegistrationHost({ slug, tracking? })`.
  - `RegistrationModalProps { slug: string; open: boolean; onClose: () => void; testMode?: boolean; tracking?: boolean; portalContainer?: HTMLElement | null }`; `RegistrationModal` is both the named and the default export (the default is what `lazy()` loads).
  - `useRegistrationConfig(slug: string, enabled?: boolean): RegistrationConfigState & { retry: () => void }` where `RegistrationConfigState = { status: "loading" } | { status: "error"; message: string } | { status: "ready"; config: PublicConfig; me: MeProfile | null }`.
  - `usePricingQuote(args: { slug: string; config: RegistrationConfig; selection: Selection; promoCode: string; email: string; debounceMs?: number }): PricingQuote` with `Selection = { regionKey: string; mode: Mode; optionKeys: string[]; tierKey: string; groupSize: number }` and `PricingQuote = { quote: QuoteResult | null; promo: PromoResult | null; source: "local" | "server"; pending: boolean }`.
  - `Register` gains `builtIn?: boolean`; `LandingRenderer` gains `slug?: string` (only the public route passes it; preview does not, so the preview never tracks or opens the modal).

```ts
// src/lib/landing/registration/region-pick.ts
import type { RegionDef } from "./config";

// Vercel's x-vercel-ip-country is ISO 3166 alpha-2; region keys are the page's own short codes.
const COUNTRY_TO_REGION: Record<string, string> = { PK: "PK", AE: "UAE", SA: "KSA", PH: "PH", IN: "IN" };

/** Which region to preselect: a valid ?region= override, else the visitor's country, else International, else the default. */
export function pickRegion(regions: RegionDef[], country: string | null, defaultKey: string, override?: string | null): string {
  const has = (k: string) => regions.some((r) => r.key === k);
  const o = (override ?? "").trim().toUpperCase();
  if (o && has(o)) return o;
  if (country) {
    const c = country.trim().toUpperCase();
    const mapped = COUNTRY_TO_REGION[c] ?? c;
    if (has(mapped)) return mapped;
    if (has("INTL")) return "INTL";
  }
  if (has(defaultKey)) return defaultKey;
  return regions[0]?.key ?? "";
}
```

```ts
}
```

```ts
// src/components/landing/registration/storage.ts
// Storage and cookies can throw (private mode, blocked site data, quota). Nothing here ever does.
export interface KV { getItem(k: string): string | null; setItem(k: string, v: string): void; removeItem(k: string): void }

function wrap(get: () => Storage): KV | null {
  try {
    const s = get();
    return {
      getItem: (k) => { try { return s.getItem(k); } catch { return null; } },
      setItem: (k, v) => { try { s.setItem(k, v); } catch { /* full or blocked */ } },
      removeItem: (k) => { try { s.removeItem(k); } catch { /* blocked */ } },
    };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function safeLocal(): KV | null {
  return typeof window === "undefined" ? null : wrap(() => window.localStorage);
}
export function safeSession(): KV | null {
  return typeof window === "undefined" ? null : wrap(() => window.sessionStorage);
}
export function documentCookie(): string {
  try { return typeof document === "undefined" ? "" : document.cookie; } catch { return ""; }
}
```

```ts
// src/components/landing/registration/attribution.ts
import type { KV } from "./storage";

export const AGENT_REF_KEY = "pz_agent_ref";
export const UTM_KEY = "pz_utm";
export const FBC_KEY = "pz_fbc";
const DAY = 86_400_000;
const AGENT_REF_MS = 30 * DAY;
const FBC_MS = 90 * DAY;
const UTM_KEYS = ["utm_source", "utm_medium", "utm_campaign", "utm_content", "utm_term"] as const;
const REF_RE = /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,39}$/i;
const FBCLID_RE = /^[\w-]{10,500}$/;

function readStamped(kv: KV | null, key: string, now: number): string {
  if (!kv) return "";
  const raw = kv.getItem(key);
  if (!raw) return "";
  try {
    const v = JSON.parse(raw) as { value?: unknown; code?: unknown; exp?: unknown };
    const value = typeof v.code === "string" ? v.code : typeof v.value === "string" ? v.value : "";
    if (typeof v.exp !== "number" || v.exp <= now || !value) { kv.removeItem(key); return ""; }
    return value;
  } catch {
    kv.removeItem(key);
    return "";
  }
}

/** Run once per page view. A new valid ?ref= replaces the stored one (last agent link wins). */
export function captureAttribution(search: string, now: number, local: KV | null, session: KV | null): void {
  const q = new URLSearchParams(search);
  const ref = (q.get("ref") ?? "").trim();
  if (local && REF_RE.test(ref)) local.setItem(AGENT_REF_KEY, JSON.stringify({ code: ref.toLowerCase(), exp: now + AGENT_REF_MS }));
  const utm: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const k of UTM_KEYS) {
    const v = (q.get(k) ?? "").trim().slice(0, 150);
    if (v) utm[k] = v;
  }
  if (session && Object.keys(utm).length > 0) session.setItem(UTM_KEY, JSON.stringify(utm));
  const fbclid = (q.get("fbclid") ?? "").trim();
  if (local && FBCLID_RE.test(fbclid)) local.setItem(FBC_KEY, JSON.stringify({ value: `fb.1.${now}.${fbclid}`, exp: now + FBC_MS }));
}

export function readAgentRef(now: number, local: KV | null): string {
  return readStamped(local, AGENT_REF_KEY, now);
}

export function readUtm(session: KV | null): Record<string, string> {
  if (!session) return {};
  try {
    const v = JSON.parse(session.getItem(UTM_KEY) ?? "{}") as Record<string, unknown>;
    return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(v).filter(([k, x]) => (UTM_KEYS as readonly string[]).includes(k) && typeof x === "string")) as Record<string, string>;
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

export function readCookie(cookie: string, name: string): string {
  for (const part of cookie.split(";")) {
    const [k, ...rest] = part.trim().split("=");
    if (k === name) {
      try { return decodeURIComponent(rest.join("=")); } catch { return rest.join("="); }
    }
  }
  return "";
}

/** The Pixel's own _fbc cookie wins; otherwise the value built from a captured fbclid. */
export function readFbc(now: number, local: KV | null, cookie: string): string {
  return readCookie(cookie, "_fbc") || readStamped(local, FBC_KEY, now);
}
export function readFbp(cookie: string): string {
  return readCookie(cookie, "_fbp");
}

export function readAttribution(now: number, local: KV | null, session: KV | null, cookie: string) {
  return { refCode: readAgentRef(now, local), utm: readUtm(session), fbp: readFbp(cookie), fbc: readFbc(now, local, cookie) };
}
```

```ts
// src/components/landing/registration/pixel.ts
export type PixelEvent = "PageView" | "ViewContent" | "Lead" | "InitiateCheckout" | "CompleteRegistration";

type Fbq = ((...args: unknown[]) => void) & { callMethod?: (...a: unknown[]) => void; queue: unknown[][]; loaded: boolean; version: string; push: Fbq };
declare global { interface Window { fbq?: Fbq; _fbq?: Fbq } }

const PIXEL_ID_RE = /^\d{6,20}$/;
const MAX_PENDING = 20;
let installedId: string | null = null;
let pending: unknown[][] = [];

export function newEventId(): string {
  if (typeof crypto !== "undefined" && typeof crypto.randomUUID === "function") return crypto.randomUUID();
  return `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`;
}

/** Meta's base code, typed. Returns true only the first time a valid id is installed. */
export function installPixel(pixelId: string): boolean {
  if (typeof window === "undefined" || installedId || !PIXEL_ID_RE.test(pixelId)) return false;
  if (!window.fbq) {
    const n = function (...args: unknown[]) {
      if (n.callMethod) n.callMethod(...args);
      else n.queue.push(args);
    } as Fbq;
    n.push = n;
    n.loaded = true;
    n.version = "2.0";
    n.queue = [];
    window.fbq = n;
    window._fbq = n;
    const s = document.createElement("script");
    s.async = true;
    s.src = "https://connect.facebook.net/en_US/fbevents.js";
    document.head.appendChild(s);
  }
  window.fbq("init", pixelId);
  installedId = pixelId;
  const queued = pending;
  pending = [];
  for (const args of queued) window.fbq(...args);
  return true;
}

/** Sends a browser event with an event id (for de-duplication with the server later). Queues until installed. */
export function track(name: PixelEvent, data: Record<string, unknown> = {}, eventId: string = newEventId()): string {
  const args: unknown[] = ["track", name, data, { eventID: eventId }];
  if (typeof window !== "undefined" && installedId && window.fbq) window.fbq(...args);
  else if (pending.length < MAX_PENDING) pending.push(args);
  return eventId;
}

export function __resetPixelForTests(): void {
  installedId = null;
  pending = [];
}
```

```tsx
// src/components/landing/registration/PixelLoader.tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";
import { installPixel, track } from "./pixel";

/** Loads the Meta Pixel only after the page has loaded and the browser is idle, so it never competes with LCP. */
export function PixelLoader({ pixelId, contentName }: { pixelId: string; contentName: string }) {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!pixelId) return;
    let cancelled = false;
    let idle: number | undefined;
    let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
    const start = () => {
      if (cancelled) return;
      if (installPixel(pixelId)) {
        track("PageView");
        track("ViewContent", { content_name: contentName });
      }
    };
    const schedule = () => {
      if (typeof window.requestIdleCallback === "function") idle = window.requestIdleCallback(start, { timeout: 3000 });
      else timer = setTimeout(start, 1500);
    };
    // "After interactive": as soon as the document has parsed (and then idle), never during parsing.
    if (document.readyState !== "loading") schedule();
    else window.addEventListener("load", schedule, { once: true });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      window.removeEventListener("load", schedule);
      if (idle !== undefined && typeof window.cancelIdleCallback === "function") window.cancelIdleCallback(idle);
      if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
    };
  }, [pixelId, contentName]);
  return null;
}
```

```ts
// src/components/landing/registration/funnel.ts
import { readAgentRef, readUtm } from "./attribution";
import { newEventId } from "./pixel";
import { safeLocal, safeSession, type KV } from "./storage";

export type FunnelType = "view" | "start" | "step" | "submit";
const SESSION_KEY = "pz_session_id";
let fallbackSessionId: string | null = null;

export function getSessionId(session: KV | null = safeSession()): string {
  const stored = session?.getItem(SESSION_KEY);
  if (stored) return stored;
  const id = fallbackSessionId ?? newEventId();
  fallbackSessionId = id;
  session?.setItem(SESSION_KEY, id);
  return id;
}

/** The JSON body POST /api/landing/[slug]/event expects: { sessionId, type, utm, ref? }. */
export function buildFunnelBody(type: FunnelType, now: number, local: KV | null, session: KV | null): string {
  const ref = readAgentRef(now, local);
  return JSON.stringify({ sessionId: getSessionId(session), type, utm: readUtm(session), ...(ref ? { ref } : {}) });
}

/** Fire-and-forget; never throws, never blocks navigation. */
export function sendFunnelEvent(slug: string, type: FunnelType): void {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  const body = buildFunnelBody(type, Date.now(), safeLocal(), safeSession());
  const url = `/api/landing/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/event`;
  try {
    if (typeof navigator !== "undefined" && typeof navigator.sendBeacon === "function" && navigator.sendBeacon(url, new Blob([body], { type: "application/json" }))) return;
  } catch {
    // fall through to fetch
  }
  try {
    const p = fetch(url, { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body, keepalive: true }) as Promise<unknown> | undefined;
    if (p && typeof p.catch === "function") p.catch(() => undefined);
  } catch {
    // never throw from analytics
  }
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";
import { captureAttribution } from "./attribution";
import { sendFunnelEvent } from "./funnel";
import { safeLocal, safeSession } from "./storage";

const viewed = new Set<string>(); // React strict mode runs effects twice in dev; count one view per page load

export function AttributionCapture({ slug }: { slug: string }) {
  useEffect(() => {
    captureAttribution(window.location.search, Date.now(), safeLocal(), safeSession());
    if (viewed.has(slug)) return;
    viewed.add(slug);
    sendFunnelEvent(slug, "view");
  }, [slug]);
  return null;
}
```

```ts
// src/components/landing/registration/registration-bus.ts
// Every Register button on the page opens the ONE modal mounted by RegistrationHost.
type Listener = () => void;
const listeners = new Set<Listener>();
let pendingOpen = false;

export function openRegistration(): void {
  if (listeners.size === 0) { pendingOpen = true; return; }
  for (const l of Array.from(listeners)) l();
}

export function onOpenRegistration(listener: Listener): () => void {
  listeners.add(listener);
  if (pendingOpen) { pendingOpen = false; listener(); }
  return () => { listeners.delete(listener); };
}

/** Warm the modal's code on hover/focus so the click feels instant. Never loaded before intent. */
export function prefetchRegistration(): void {
  void import("./RegistrationModal").catch(() => undefined);
}
```

```tsx
// src/components/landing/registration/RegistrationHost.tsx
"use client";

import { lazy, Suspense, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { onOpenRegistration } from "./registration-bus";

const RegistrationModal = lazy(() => import("./RegistrationModal"));

/** Mounted once per public page. Loads the modal code on the first open and keeps it mounted so a closed-then-reopened form keeps its answers. */
export function RegistrationHost({ slug, tracking = true }: { slug: string; tracking?: boolean }) {
  const [everOpened, setEverOpened] = useState(false);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [container, setContainer] = useState<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => onOpenRegistration(() => { setEverOpened(true); setOpen(true); }), []);
  return (
    <div ref={setContainer} className="font-landing-body">
      {everOpened && (
        <Suspense fallback={<OpeningNotice />}>
          <RegistrationModal slug={slug} open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} tracking={tracking} portalContainer={container} />
        </Suspense>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function OpeningNotice() {
  return (
    <div role="status" className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-landing-near-black/50">
      <span className="rounded-landing bg-landing-surface-container-lowest px-5 py-3 font-headline text-sm font-bold text-landing-deep shadow-landing-soft-lg">Opening registration…</span>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```ts
// src/components/landing/registration/useRegistrationConfig.ts
"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import type { MeProfile, PublicConfig } from "./types";

export type RegistrationConfigState =
  | { status: "loading" }
  | { status: "error"; message: string }
  | { status: "ready"; config: PublicConfig; me: MeProfile | null };

/** Fetches the public config and the logged-in profile in parallel, only while `enabled` (the modal is open). */
export function useRegistrationConfig(slug: string, enabled = true): RegistrationConfigState & { retry: () => void } {
  const [state, setState] = useState<RegistrationConfigState>({ status: "loading" });
  const [attempt, setAttempt] = useState(0);
  const [loadedFor, setLoadedFor] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) return;
    const key = `${slug}#${attempt}`;
    if (loadedFor === key) return; // reopening the modal does not refetch
    let cancelled = false;
    setState({ status: "loading" });
    (async () => {
      try {
        const [cfgRes, me] = await Promise.all([
          fetch(`/api/landing/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/config`, { cache: "no-store" }),
          fetch("/api/landing/me", { cache: "no-store", credentials: "same-origin" })
            .then(async (r) => (r.ok ? ((await r.json()) as MeProfile | null) : null))
            .catch(() => null),
        ]);
        if (cancelled) return;
        if (cfgRes.status === 404) {
          setState({ status: "error", message: "This registration form isn't available any more." });
          return;
        }
        if (!cfgRes.ok) throw new Error(String(cfgRes.status));
        const config = (await cfgRes.json()) as PublicConfig;
        if (cancelled) return;
        setState({ status: "ready", config, me: me && typeof me.email === "string" && me.email ? me : null });
        setLoadedFor(key);
      } catch {
        if (!cancelled) setState({ status: "error", message: "We couldn't load the registration form. Check your connection and try again." });
      }
    })();
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, [slug, enabled, attempt, loadedFor]);

  const retry = useCallback(() => setAttempt((a) => a + 1), []);
  return { ...state, retry };
}
```

```ts
// src/components/landing/registration/usePricingQuote.ts
"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { computeQuote, type QuoteResult } from "@/lib/landing/registration/pricing";
import type { Mode, RegistrationConfig } from "@/lib/landing/registration/config";
import type { PromoResult } from "@/lib/landing/registration/promo";
import type { QuoteResponse } from "./types";

export interface Selection { regionKey: string; mode: Mode; optionKeys: string[]; tierKey: string; groupSize: number }
export interface PricingQuote { quote: QuoteResult | null; promo: PromoResult | null; source: "local" | "server"; pending: boolean }

/**
 * Instant price from the same pure engine the server uses, then the server's answer (which wins: it
 * owns the clock for Early Bird and validates promo codes). Only the newest selection's answer is shown.
 */
export function usePricingQuote({
  slug, config, selection, promoCode, email, debounceMs = 300,
}: { slug: string; config: RegistrationConfig; selection: Selection; promoCode: string; email: string; debounceMs?: number }): PricingQuote {
  const code = promoCode.trim();
  const key = JSON.stringify([selection.regionKey, selection.mode, [...selection.optionKeys].sort(), selection.tierKey, selection.groupSize, code, code ? email.trim().toLowerCase() : ""]);
  const hasChoice = selection.optionKeys.length > 0;

  const local = useMemo<QuoteResult | null>(
    () => (hasChoice ? computeQuote({ config, ...selection, now: new Date() }) : null),
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    [config, key],
  );

  const [server, setServer] = useState<{ key: string; quote: QuoteResult; promo: PromoResult | null } | null>(null);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!hasChoice) { setPending(false); return; }
    const ctrl = new AbortController();
    setPending(true);
    const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
      try {
        const body: Record<string, unknown> = { ...selection };
        if (code) { body.promoCode = code; if (email.trim()) body.email = email.trim().toLowerCase(); }
        const res = await fetch(`/api/landing/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/quote`, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify(body),
          signal: ctrl.signal,
        });
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error(String(res.status));
        const data = (await res.json()) as QuoteResponse;
        if (!ctrl.signal.aborted) setServer({ key, quote: data.quote, promo: data.promo ?? null });
      } catch {
        // Offline or aborted: the local price stays on screen; the server re-checks at submit anyway.
      } finally {
        if (!ctrl.signal.aborted) setPending(false);
      }
    }, debounceMs);
    return () => { clearTimeout(timer); ctrl.abort(); };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [key, slug, debounceMs]);

  if (server && server.key === key) return { quote: server.quote, promo: server.promo, source: "server", pending };
  return { quote: local, promo: null, source: "local", pending };
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/landing/registration/form-state.ts
// The registration form as plain data, so every rule is unit-tested without rendering.
import type { Mode, RegistrationConfig } from "./config";
import type { QuoteResult } from "./pricing";
import type { RegisterPayload } from "./submit-schema";
import { pickRegion } from "./region-pick";

export type StepKey = "choose" | "details" | "pay" | "upload";
export interface PersonDraft { name: string; email: string; whatsapp: string; profession: string }
export interface LeadDraft extends PersonDraft { city: string; discovery: string }
export interface FormState {
  step: StepKey;
  regionKey: string;
  mode: Mode;
  optionKeys: string[];
  tierKey: string;
  groupSize: number;
  lead: LeadDraft;
  members: PersonDraft[];
  consent: boolean;
  paymentMethod: string;
  promoInput: string;
  promoApplied: string;
  voucher: File | null;
  honeypot: string;
  emailLocked: boolean;
  detailsCollapsed: boolean;
}
export type FieldErrors = Record<string, string>;

export const INDIVIDUAL = "individual";
// Same cap as the server (Task 12 MAX_VOUCHER_UPLOAD_BYTES): Vercel rejects bodies over 4.5 MB.
export const MAX_VOUCHER_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024;
export const VOUCHER_TYPES = ["image/jpeg", "image/png", "image/webp", "application/pdf"];
const EMAIL_RE = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
const emptyPerson = (): PersonDraft => ({ name: "", email: "", whatsapp: "", profession: "" });
const digits = (v: string) => v.replace(/\D/g, "");

export function initialState(
  config: RegistrationConfig,
  { country, me, regionParam }: { country: string | null; me: PersonDraft | null; regionParam?: string | null },
): FormState {
  const lead: LeadDraft = {
    name: me?.name.trim() ?? "",
    email: me?.email.trim().toLowerCase() ?? "",
    whatsapp: me?.whatsapp.trim() ?? "",
    profession: me?.profession.trim() ?? "",
    city: "",
    discovery: "",
  };
  return {
    step: "choose",
    regionKey: pickRegion(config.regions, country, config.defaultRegionKey, regionParam),
    mode: config.modes[0] ?? "live",
    optionKeys: config.options.length === 1 ? [config.options[0].key] : [],
    tierKey: INDIVIDUAL,
    groupSize: 1,
    lead,
    members: [],
    consent: false,
    paymentMethod: "",
    promoInput: "",
    promoApplied: "",
    voucher: null,
    honeypot: "",
    emailLocked: !!me && lead.email !== "",
    detailsCollapsed: !!me && lead.name !== "" && lead.email !== "" && lead.whatsapp !== "" && lead.profession !== "",
  };
}

export function stepsFor(isFree: boolean): StepKey[] {
  return isFree ? ["choose", "details"] : ["choose", "details", "pay", "upload"];
}

export function isFreeSelection(config: RegistrationConfig, optionKeys: string[]): boolean {
  if (optionKeys.length === 0) return false;
  return optionKeys.every((k) => config.options.find((o) => o.key === k)?.free === true);
}

/** Packages are chosen alone; modules combine; choosing every module collapses to the package when module mix is on. */
export function toggleOption(config: RegistrationConfig, optionKeys: string[], key: string): { optionKeys: string[]; collapsed: boolean } {
  const opt = config.options.find((o) => o.key === key);
  if (!opt) return { optionKeys, collapsed: false };
  if (opt.kind === "bundle") return { optionKeys: [key], collapsed: false };
  const modules = config.options.filter((o) => o.kind === "module").map((o) => o.key);
  const current = optionKeys.filter((k) => modules.includes(k));
  const next = current.includes(key) ? current.filter((k) => k !== key) : [...current, key];
  const { enabled, bundleOptionKey } = config.moduleMix;
  if (enabled && bundleOptionKey && modules.length > 1 && modules.every((m) => next.includes(m))) {
    return { optionKeys: [bundleOptionKey], collapsed: true };
  }
  return { optionKeys: modules.filter((m) => next.includes(m)), collapsed: false };
}

export function tierBounds(config: RegistrationConfig, tierKey: string): { min: number; max: number } | null {
  if (tierKey === INDIVIDUAL) return { min: 1, max: 1 };
  const t = config.tiers.find((x) => x.key === tierKey);
  return t ? { min: t.minSize, max: t.maxSize } : null;
}

export function resizeMembers(members: PersonDraft[], groupSize: number): PersonDraft[] {
  const want = Math.max(0, groupSize - 1);
  if (members.length >= want) return members.slice(0, want);
  return [...members, ...Array.from({ length: want - members.length }, emptyPerson)];
}

export function chooseTier(state: FormState, config: RegistrationConfig, tierKey: string): FormState {
  const b = tierBounds(config, tierKey);
  if (!b) return state;
  return { ...state, tierKey, groupSize: b.min, members: resizeMembers(state.members, b.min) };
}

export function setGroupSize(state: FormState, config: RegistrationConfig, n: number): FormState {
  const b = tierBounds(config, state.tierKey);
  if (!b) return state;
  const size = Math.min(b.max, Math.max(b.min, Math.round(Number.isFinite(n) ? n : b.min)));
  return { ...state, groupSize: size, members: resizeMembers(state.members, size) };
}

export function quoteProblem(quote: QuoteResult | null, config: RegistrationConfig, tierKey: string): { field: string; message: string } | null {
  if (!quote || quote.ok) return null;
  const b = tierBounds(config, tierKey) ?? { min: 1, max: 1 };
  switch (quote.reason) {
    case "no_region": return { field: "regionKey", message: "Choose where you are registering from." };
    case "no_option": return { field: "optionKeys", message: "Choose what you want to join." };
    case "no_price": return { field: "optionKeys", message: "This option isn't sold in your country yet. Choose another country or option." };
    case "bad_tier": return { field: "tierKey", message: "Choose Individual or one of the group options." };
    case "bad_group_size": return { field: "groupSize", message: `Group size must be between ${b.min} and ${b.max} people.` };
    case "mode_not_offered": return { field: "mode", message: "Choose live sessions or recorded lectures." };
    case "free_group": return { field: "tierKey", message: "Groups aren't available for the free option. Choose Individual." };
    case "mixed_free": return { field: "optionKeys", message: "Choose either the free option or paid options, not both." };
    default: return { field: "optionKeys", message: "Please check your choice." };
  }
}

function checkPerson(p: PersonDraft, prefix: string, n: number | null, errors: FieldErrors, needProfession: boolean): void {
  const who = n === null ? null : `member ${n}`;
  if (p.name.trim().length < 2) errors[`${prefix}.name`] = who ? `Enter ${who}'s full name.` : "Enter your full name.";
  if (!EMAIL_RE.test(p.email.trim())) errors[`${prefix}.email`] = who ? `Enter a valid email for ${who}.` : "Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com.";
  const d = digits(p.whatsapp).length;
  if (d < 10 || d > 15) errors[`${prefix}.whatsapp`] = who ? `Enter ${who}'s WhatsApp number with the country code.` : "Enter your WhatsApp number with the country code, like 923001234567.";
  if (needProfession && p.profession.trim() === "") errors[`${prefix}.profession`] = "Choose your profession.";
}

const CONSENT_MESSAGE = "Please tick the box to agree to the registration terms.";

export function validateStep(
  step: StepKey, state: FormState, config: RegistrationConfig, quote: QuoteResult | null,
  { hasAccounts, isFree }: { hasAccounts: boolean; isFree: boolean },
): FieldErrors {
  const errors: FieldErrors = {};
  if (step === "choose") {
    if (!config.regions.some((r) => r.key === state.regionKey)) errors.regionKey = "Choose where you are registering from.";
    if (state.optionKeys.length === 0) errors.optionKeys = "Choose what you want to join.";
    else {
      const p = quoteProblem(quote, config, state.tierKey);
      if (p) errors[p.field] = p.message;
    }
  }
  if (step === "details") {
    checkPerson(state.lead, "lead", null, errors, config.professions.length > 0);
    if (state.lead.city.trim() === "") errors["lead.city"] = "Enter your city or country.";
    const seen = new Set([state.lead.email.trim().toLowerCase()]);
    state.members.slice(0, Math.max(0, state.groupSize - 1)).forEach((m, i) => {
      checkPerson(m, `members.${i}`, i + 2, errors, false);
      const e = m.email.trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!errors[`members.${i}.email`] && seen.has(e)) errors[`members.${i}.email`] = "Each person needs their own email address.";
      seen.add(e);
    });
    if (isFree && !state.consent) errors.consent = CONSENT_MESSAGE;
  }
  if (step === "pay") {
    if (hasAccounts && !state.paymentMethod) errors.paymentMethod = "Choose the account you paid into.";
    if (state.promoInput.trim() !== "" && state.promoInput.trim().toUpperCase() !== state.promoApplied) errors.promoCode = "Press Apply to use your promo code, or clear the box.";
  }
  if (step === "upload") {
    const f = state.voucher;
    if (!f) errors.voucher = "Upload a photo or PDF of your payment receipt.";
    else if (!VOUCHER_TYPES.includes(f.type)) errors.voucher = "Upload a JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF file.";
    else if (f.size > MAX_VOUCHER_BYTES) errors.voucher = "This file is bigger than 4 MB. Send a screenshot instead.";
    if (!state.consent) errors.consent = CONSENT_MESSAGE;
  }
  return errors;
}

export function nextStep(steps: StepKey[], step: StepKey): StepKey | "submit" {
  const i = steps.indexOf(step);
  return i < 0 || i >= steps.length - 1 ? "submit" : steps[i + 1];
}
export function prevStep(steps: StepKey[], step: StepKey): StepKey | null {
  const i = steps.indexOf(step);
  return i <= 0 ? null : steps[i - 1];
}

/** Which step a server-reported field belongs to (e.g. "lead.email" -> details). */
export function fieldStep(field: string, steps: StepKey[]): StepKey {
  const last = steps[steps.length - 1];
  if (field === "consent" || field === "lead.consent") return last;
  if (field.startsWith("lead.") || field.startsWith("members")) return "details";
  if ((field === "paymentMethod" || field === "promoCode") && steps.includes("pay")) return "pay";
  if (field === "voucher" && steps.includes("upload")) return "upload";
  return "choose";
}

export function buildPayload(state: FormState, attribution: RegisterPayload["attribution"], testMode: boolean, isFree: boolean): RegisterPayload {
  const person = (p: PersonDraft) => ({ name: p.name.trim(), email: p.email.trim().toLowerCase(), whatsapp: digits(p.whatsapp), profession: p.profession.trim() });
  return {
    regionKey: state.regionKey,
    mode: state.mode,
    optionKeys: state.optionKeys,
    tierKey: state.tierKey,
    groupSize: state.groupSize,
    lead: { ...person(state.lead), city: state.lead.city.trim(), discovery: state.lead.discovery, consent: true },
    members: state.members.slice(0, Math.max(0, state.groupSize - 1)).map(person),
    paymentMethod: isFree ? "" : state.paymentMethod,
    promoCode: isFree ? "" : state.promoApplied,
    honeypot: state.honeypot,
    attribution,
    testMode,
  };
}
```

```ts
// src/components/landing/registration/submit.ts
import type { RegisterPayload } from "@/lib/landing/registration/submit-schema";
import type { RegisterErrorBody, RegisterSuccess } from "./types";

export type SubmitOutcome = { ok: true; data: RegisterSuccess } | { ok: false; status: number; error: string; field?: string };

export const NETWORK_MESSAGE = "We couldn't reach our server. Check your connection. Your details are still here, so you can try again.";

export function messageForStatus(status: number): string {
  if (status === 400 || status === 422) return "Some details need fixing. Please check the highlighted fields.";
  if (status === 404) return "This registration form isn't available any more.";
  if (status === 403 || status === 410) return "Registration for this event is closed.";
  if (status === 409) return "We couldn't complete this registration. Please read the message and try again.";
  if (status === 413) return "This file is too big. Upload a file under 4 MB.";
  if (status === 415) return "Upload a JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF file.";
  if (status === 429) return "Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.";
  return "Something went wrong on our side. Your details are still here, please try again in a moment.";
}

/** POSTs multipart `payload` (JSON) + optional `voucher` file. Never throws. The server recomputes every price. */
export async function submitRegistration(slug: string, payload: RegisterPayload, voucher: File | null, { timeoutMs = 60_000 }: { timeoutMs?: number } = {}): Promise<SubmitOutcome> {
  const fd = new FormData();
  fd.append("payload", JSON.stringify(payload));
  if (voucher) fd.append("voucher", voucher, voucher.name);
  const ctrl = new AbortController();
  const timer = setTimeout(() => ctrl.abort(), timeoutMs);
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/landing/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/register`, { method: "POST", body: fd, signal: ctrl.signal });
    const body = (await res.json().catch(() => null)) as (Partial<RegisterSuccess> & Partial<RegisterErrorBody>) | null;
    if (res.ok && body && typeof body.refId === "string") return { ok: true, data: body as RegisterSuccess };
    if (res.ok) return { ok: false, status: 500, error: messageForStatus(500) };
    // 429 always gets our wording; otherwise the server's own message (it is written for people) wins.
    const error = res.status !== 429 && typeof body?.error === "string" && body.error.trim() ? body.error : messageForStatus(res.status);
    return { ok: false, status: res.status, error, field: typeof body?.field === "string" ? body.field : undefined };
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, status: 0, error: NETWORK_MESSAGE };
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer);
  }
}
```

(The error style deliberately avoids a red token: the landing palette has none. Errors are bold deep-green text with a primary underline plus `aria-invalid` outlines, and are always paired with text, never colour alone. If the Stitch screen shows a specific error colour, add it ONCE to the `landing` group in `tailwind.config.ts` as `error: '<hex from the screen>'` and use `text-landing-error`; never write the hex in a component.)

```tsx
// src/components/landing/registration/Field.tsx
"use client";

import { useId } from "react";
import { R_ERROR, R_HINT, R_INPUT, R_LABEL } from "./ui";

type Common = { label: string; error?: string; hint?: string; ariaLabel?: string; name?: string };

export function TextField({
  label, error, hint, ariaLabel, value, onChange, type = "text", inputMode, autoComplete, readOnly, placeholder, name,
}: Common & {
  value: string; onChange: (v: string) => void; type?: "text" | "email" | "tel";
  inputMode?: "text" | "email" | "tel" | "numeric"; autoComplete?: string; readOnly?: boolean; placeholder?: string;
}) {
  const id = useId();
  const describedBy = [hint ? `${id}-hint` : null, error ? `${id}-err` : null].filter(Boolean).join(" ") || undefined;
  return (
    <div>
      <label htmlFor={id} className={R_LABEL}>{label}</label>
      {hint && <span id={`${id}-hint`} className={R_HINT}>{hint}</span>}
      <input
        id={id} name={name} type={type} inputMode={inputMode} autoComplete={autoComplete} readOnly={readOnly}
        placeholder={placeholder} value={value} aria-label={ariaLabel} aria-invalid={error ? true : undefined}
        aria-describedby={describedBy} onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)} className={R_INPUT}
      />
      {error && <span id={`${id}-err`} role="alert" className={R_ERROR}>{error}</span>}
    </div>
  );
}

export function SelectField({
  label, error, hint, ariaLabel, value, onChange, options, placeholder = "Choose…",
}: Common & { value: string; onChange: (v: string) => void; options: string[]; placeholder?: string }) {
  const id = useId();
  const describedBy = [hint ? `${id}-hint` : null, error ? `${id}-err` : null].filter(Boolean).join(" ") || undefined;
  return (
    <div>
      <label htmlFor={id} className={R_LABEL}>{label}</label>
      {hint && <span id={`${id}-hint`} className={R_HINT}>{hint}</span>}
      <select id={id} value={value} aria-label={ariaLabel} aria-invalid={error ? true : undefined} aria-describedby={describedBy} onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)} className={R_INPUT}>
        <option value="">{placeholder}</option>
        {options.map((o) => <option key={o} value={o}>{o}</option>)}
      </select>
      {error && <span id={`${id}-err`} role="alert" className={R_ERROR}>{error}</span>}
    </div>
  );
}

export function ConsentField({ checked, onChange, error }: { checked: boolean; onChange: (v: boolean) => void; error?: string }) {
  const id = useId();
  return (
    <div>
      <label className="flex min-h-12 cursor-pointer items-start gap-3 font-landing-body text-base text-landing-on-surface">
        <input type="checkbox" checked={checked} onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.checked)} aria-invalid={error ? true : undefined} aria-describedby={error ? `${id}-err` : undefined} className="mt-1 h-5 w-5 shrink-0 accent-landing-primary" />
        <span>I have read and understood the registration details, payment terms and schedule.</span>
      </label>
      {error && <span id={`${id}-err`} role="alert" className={R_ERROR}>{error}</span>}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// src/components/landing/registration/CopyButton.tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export function CopyButton({ value, label }: { value: string; label: string }) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!copied) return;
    const t = setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1800);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [copied]);
  async function copy() {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(value);
      setCopied(true);
    } catch {
      // Old browsers: select the text so a long-press copy works.
      const el = document.createElement("textarea");
      el.value = value;
      document.body.appendChild(el);
      el.select();
      try { document.execCommand("copy"); setCopied(true); } catch { /* leave it selected */ }
      el.remove();
    }
  }
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      aria-label={`Copy ${label}`}
      onClick={() => void copy()}
      className="inline-flex min-h-11 min-w-[5.5rem] items-center justify-center rounded-landing border border-landing-primary px-3 font-headline text-sm font-bold text-landing-primary hover:bg-landing-mint-light focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-landing-mint"
    >
      <span aria-live="polite">{copied ? "✓ Copied" : "Copy"}</span>
    </button>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// src/components/landing/registration/StepChoose.tsx
"use client";

import { useMemo } from "react";
import { computeQuote } from "@/lib/landing/registration/pricing";
import { formatMoney } from "@/lib/landing/registration/format";
import { INDIVIDUAL, type FieldErrors, type FormState } from "@/lib/landing/registration/form-state";
import type { Mode, RegistrationConfig } from "@/lib/landing/registration/config";
import { R_CHOICE, R_ERROR, R_HINT, R_INPUT, R_LABEL } from "./ui";

const LEGEND = "font-headline text-base font-bold text-landing-near-black";

export function StepChoose({
  config, state, errors, notice, isFree, onRegion, onMode, onToggleOption, onTier, onGroupSize,
}: {
  config: RegistrationConfig; state: FormState; errors: FieldErrors; notice: string | null; isFree: boolean;
  onRegion: (k: string) => void; onMode: (m: Mode) => void; onToggleOption: (k: string) => void;
  onTier: (k: string) => void; onGroupSize: (n: number) => void;
}) {
  const region = config.regions.find((r) => r.key === state.regionKey);
  const now = useMemo(() => new Date(), []);
  const priceOf = (key: string) => {
    const q = computeQuote({ config, regionKey: state.regionKey, mode: state.mode, optionKeys: [key], tierKey: INDIVIDUAL, groupSize: 1, now });
    return q.ok ? q : null;
  };
  const tier = config.tiers.find((t) => t.key === state.tierKey);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {config.regions.length > 1 && (
        <fieldset aria-describedby={errors.regionKey ? "err-region" : undefined}>
          <legend className={LEGEND}>Registering from</legend>
          <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {config.regions.map((r) => (
              <label key={r.key} className="inline-flex min-h-11 cursor-pointer items-center rounded-full border-2 border-landing-border bg-landing-surface-container-lowest px-4 font-landing-body text-base font-semibold text-landing-on-surface has-[:checked]:border-landing-primary has-[:checked]:bg-landing-mint-light has-[:focus-visible]:ring-2 has-[:focus-visible]:ring-landing-mint">
                <input type="radio" name="region" className="sr-only" checked={state.regionKey === r.key} onChange={() => onRegion(r.key)} />
                {r.label}
              </label>
            ))}
          </div>
          {errors.regionKey && <span id="err-region" role="alert" className={R_ERROR}>{errors.regionKey}</span>}
        </fieldset>
      )}

      {config.modes.length > 1 && (
        <fieldset>
          <legend className={LEGEND}>How do you want to learn?</legend>
          <div className="mt-2 grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2">
            {config.modes.map((m) => (
              <label key={m} className={R_CHOICE}>
                <input type="radio" name="mode" className="mt-1 h-5 w-5 accent-landing-primary" checked={state.mode === m} onChange={() => onMode(m)} />
                <span>
                  <span className="block font-headline text-base font-bold text-landing-near-black">{m === "live" ? "Live sessions" : "Recorded lectures"}</span>
                  <span className={R_HINT}>{m === "live" ? "Real-time on Zoom" : "Self-paced, watch anytime"}</span>
                </span>
              </label>
            ))}
          </div>
          {errors.mode && <span role="alert" className={R_ERROR}>{errors.mode}</span>}
        </fieldset>
      )}

      <fieldset>
        <legend className={LEGEND}>What do you want to join?</legend>
        <div className="mt-2 grid gap-2">
          {config.options.map((o) => {
            const q = priceOf(o.key);
            const checked = state.optionKeys.includes(o.key);
            return (
              <label key={o.key} className={R_CHOICE}>
                <input
                  type={o.kind === "bundle" ? "radio" : "checkbox"}
                  name={o.kind === "bundle" ? "bundle" : undefined}
                  className="mt-1 h-5 w-5 accent-landing-primary"
                  checked={checked}
                  onChange={() => onToggleOption(o.key)}
                />
                <span className="flex flex-1 flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-x-3">
                  <span className="font-headline text-base font-bold text-landing-near-black">{o.label}</span>
                  {q && (
                    <span className="font-landing-body text-base text-landing-on-surface">
                      {q.isFree ? "Free" : formatMoney(q.perPerson, q.currency)}
                      {q.earlyBirdApplied && q.listPerPerson > q.perPerson && (
                        <s className="ml-2 text-sm text-landing-muted">{formatMoney(q.listPerPerson, q.currency)}</s>
                      )}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </span>
              </label>
            );
          })}
        </div>
        {notice && <p role="status" className="mt-2 font-landing-body text-sm font-semibold text-landing-primary">✓ {notice}</p>}
        {errors.optionKeys && <span role="alert" className={R_ERROR}>{errors.optionKeys}</span>}
      </fieldset>

      {!isFree && config.tiers.length > 0 && (
        <fieldset>
          <legend className={LEGEND}>Who is registering?</legend>
          <div className="mt-2 grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-3">
            <label className={R_CHOICE}>
              <input type="radio" name="tier" className="mt-1 h-5 w-5 accent-landing-primary" checked={state.tierKey === INDIVIDUAL} onChange={() => onTier(INDIVIDUAL)} />
              <span className="font-headline text-base font-bold text-landing-near-black">Individual</span>
            </label>
            {config.tiers.map((t) => (
              <label key={t.key} className={R_CHOICE}>
                <input type="radio" name="tier" className="mt-1 h-5 w-5 accent-landing-primary" checked={state.tierKey === t.key} onChange={() => onTier(t.key)} />
                <span>
                  <span className="block font-headline text-base font-bold text-landing-near-black">{t.label}</span>
                  {t.percentOff > 0 && <span className={R_HINT}>{`${t.percentOff}% off per person`}</span>}
                </span>
              </label>
            ))}
          </div>
          {tier && tier.minSize < tier.maxSize && (
            <label className="mt-3 block max-w-[12rem]">
              <span className={R_LABEL}>Group size (including you)</span>
              <input type="number" inputMode="numeric" min={tier.minSize} max={tier.maxSize} value={state.groupSize} onChange={(e) => onGroupSize(Number(e.target.value))} aria-invalid={errors.groupSize ? true : undefined} className={R_INPUT} />
            </label>
          )}
          {(errors.tierKey || errors.groupSize) && <span role="alert" className={R_ERROR}>{errors.tierKey ?? errors.groupSize}</span>}
        </fieldset>
      )}

      {region && state.mode === "live" && region.classTime && (
        <p className={R_HINT}>{`Class time: ${region.classTime} (${region.timezoneLabel})`}</p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// src/components/landing/registration/StepDetails.tsx
"use client";

import type { FieldErrors, FormState, LeadDraft, PersonDraft } from "@/lib/landing/registration/form-state";
import type { RegistrationConfig } from "@/lib/landing/registration/config";
import { ConsentField, SelectField, TextField } from "./Field";
import { R_BTN_SECONDARY, R_CARD } from "./ui";

export function StepDetails({
  config, state, errors, isFree, onLead, onMember, onExpand, onConsent, onHoneypot,
}: {
  config: RegistrationConfig; state: FormState; errors: FieldErrors; isFree: boolean;
  onLead: (patch: Partial<LeadDraft>) => void; onMember: (i: number, patch: Partial<PersonDraft>) => void;
  onExpand: () => void; onConsent: (v: boolean) => void; onHoneypot: (v: string) => void;
}) {
  const lead = state.lead;
  const memberCount = Math.max(0, state.groupSize - 1);
  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      {state.detailsCollapsed ? (
        <div className={`${R_CARD} flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3`}>
          <div>
            <p className="font-headline text-base font-bold text-landing-near-black">Confirm your details</p>
            <p className="font-landing-body text-base text-landing-on-surface">{`Registering as ${lead.name} · ${lead.email}`}</p>
          </div>
          <button type="button" onClick={onExpand} className={R_BTN_SECONDARY}>Change</button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
          <TextField label="Full name" autoComplete="name" value={lead.name} onChange={(v) => onLead({ name: v })} error={errors["lead.name"]} />
          <TextField label="Email" type="email" inputMode="email" autoComplete="email" value={lead.email} readOnly={state.emailLocked} hint={state.emailLocked ? "This is your account email." : undefined} onChange={(v) => onLead({ email: v })} error={errors["lead.email"]} />
          <TextField label="WhatsApp number" type="tel" inputMode="tel" autoComplete="tel" placeholder="923001234567" hint="With country code" value={lead.whatsapp} onChange={(v) => onLead({ whatsapp: v })} error={errors["lead.whatsapp"]} />
          {config.professions.length > 0 && (
            <SelectField label="Profession" value={lead.profession} options={config.professions} onChange={(v) => onLead({ profession: v })} error={errors["lead.profession"]} />
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
        <TextField label="City / Country" autoComplete="address-level2" value={lead.city} onChange={(v) => onLead({ city: v })} error={errors["lead.city"]} />
        {config.discoveryOptions.length > 0 && (
          <SelectField label="How did you hear about us?" hint="Optional" value={lead.discovery} options={config.discoveryOptions} onChange={(v) => onLead({ discovery: v })} />
        )}
      </div>

      {memberCount > 0 && (
        <section aria-labelledby="members-h" className="space-y-3">
          <h3 id="members-h" className="font-headline text-base font-bold text-landing-near-black">Group members</h3>
          <p className="font-landing-body text-sm text-landing-muted">You are the group lead. Each member gets their own confirmation email.</p>
          {state.members.slice(0, memberCount).map((m, i) => {
            const n = i + 2;
            return (
              <fieldset key={i} className={`${R_CARD} grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2`}>
                <legend className="px-1 font-headline text-sm font-bold text-landing-deep">{`Member ${n}`}</legend>
                <TextField label="Full name" ariaLabel={`Member ${n} full name`} value={m.name} onChange={(v) => onMember(i, { name: v })} error={errors[`members.${i}.name`]} />
                <TextField label="Email" ariaLabel={`Member ${n} email`} type="email" inputMode="email" value={m.email} onChange={(v) => onMember(i, { email: v })} error={errors[`members.${i}.email`]} />
                <TextField label="WhatsApp number" ariaLabel={`Member ${n} WhatsApp number`} type="tel" inputMode="tel" value={m.whatsapp} onChange={(v) => onMember(i, { whatsapp: v })} error={errors[`members.${i}.whatsapp`]} />
                {config.professions.length > 0 && (
                  <SelectField label="Profession (optional)" ariaLabel={`Member ${n} profession`} value={m.profession} options={config.professions} onChange={(v) => onMember(i, { profession: v })} />
                )}
              </fieldset>
            );
          })}
        </section>
      )}

      {/* Honeypot: invisible to people and screen readers; bots that fill every field get silently dropped by the server. */}
      <div aria-hidden="true" className="absolute -left-[9999px] top-auto h-px w-px overflow-hidden">
        <label>
          Website
          <input type="text" name="website" tabIndex={-1} autoComplete="off" value={state.honeypot} onChange={(e) => onHoneypot(e.target.value)} />
        </label>
      </div>

      {isFree && <ConsentField checked={state.consent} onChange={onConsent} error={errors.consent} />}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// src/components/landing/registration/StepPay.tsx
"use client";

import type { FieldErrors, FormState } from "@/lib/landing/registration/form-state";
import type { PaymentAccount } from "@/lib/data/landing-payment-accounts";
import { formatMoney } from "@/lib/landing/registration/format";
import { CopyButton } from "./CopyButton";
import { R_BTN_SECONDARY, R_CARD, R_CHOICE, R_ERROR, R_HINT, R_INPUT, R_LABEL } from "./ui";

export type PromoStatus = { kind: "idle" } | { kind: "checking" } | { kind: "ok"; message: string } | { kind: "error"; message: string };

const linkFor = (value: string): string | null => {
  const v = value.trim();
  if (/^https:\/\/(www\.)?paypal\.me\//i.test(v)) return v;
  if (/^(www\.)?paypal\.me\//i.test(v)) return `https://${v.replace(/^www\./i, "")}`;
  return null;
};

export function StepPay({
  accounts, state, errors, amountDue, currency, promoStatus, onMethod, onPromoInput, onApply, onRemovePromo,
}: {
  accounts: PaymentAccount[]; state: FormState; errors: FieldErrors; amountDue: number | null; currency: string;
  promoStatus: PromoStatus; onMethod: (key: string) => void; onPromoInput: (v: string) => void; onApply: () => void; onRemovePromo: () => void;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      <div className="rounded-landing bg-landing-mint-light p-4">
        <p className="font-landing-body text-sm text-landing-on-surface">Send exactly</p>
        <p className="font-headline text-2xl font-black text-landing-deep">{amountDue === null ? "…" : formatMoney(amountDue, currency)}</p>
        <p className={R_HINT}>Pay into one of these accounts, take a screenshot of the receipt, then continue to upload it.</p>
      </div>

      <fieldset>
        <legend className="font-headline text-base font-bold text-landing-near-black">Choose how you pay</legend>
        <div className="mt-2 space-y-2">
          {accounts.map((a) => {
            const selected = state.paymentMethod === a.key;
            return (
              <div key={a.key} className={R_CHOICE + " flex-col"}>
                <label className="flex w-full cursor-pointer items-start gap-3">
                  <input type="radio" name="paymentMethod" className="mt-1 h-5 w-5 accent-landing-primary" checked={selected} onChange={() => onMethod(a.key)} />
                  <span>
                    <span className="block font-headline text-base font-bold text-landing-near-black">{a.label}</span>
                    <span className={R_HINT}>{a.displayText}</span>
                  </span>
                </label>
                {selected && (
                  <dl className="mt-2 w-full space-y-2 border-t border-landing-border pt-3">
                    {a.rows.map((row) => {
                      const link = linkFor(row.value);
                      return (
                        <div key={row.label} className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                          <div className="min-w-0">
                            <dt className="font-landing-body text-sm text-landing-muted">{row.label}</dt>
                            <dd className="break-all font-landing-body text-base font-semibold text-landing-on-surface">{row.value}</dd>
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex gap-2">
                            {link && <a href={link} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className={R_BTN_SECONDARY + " !min-h-11 !px-3 !text-sm"}>Pay via PayPal</a>}
                            <CopyButton value={row.value} label={row.label} />
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      );
                    })}
                  </dl>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
        {errors.paymentMethod && <span role="alert" className={R_ERROR}>{errors.paymentMethod}</span>}
      </fieldset>

      <div className={R_CARD}>
        <label htmlFor="promo-code" className={R_LABEL}>Promo code</label>
        <div className="mt-1.5 flex gap-2">
          <input
            id="promo-code" value={state.promoInput} autoCapitalize="characters" autoComplete="off"
            aria-invalid={errors.promoCode || promoStatus.kind === "error" ? true : undefined}
            onChange={(e) => onPromoInput(e.target.value.toUpperCase())}
            className={R_INPUT + " !mt-0"}
          />
          <button type="button" onClick={onApply} disabled={state.promoInput.trim() === "" || promoStatus.kind === "checking"} className={R_BTN_SECONDARY}>Apply</button>
        </div>
        {promoStatus.kind === "checking" && <p role="status" className={R_HINT}>Checking…</p>}
        {promoStatus.kind === "ok" && (
          <p role="status" className="mt-1 font-landing-body text-sm font-semibold text-landing-primary">
            {promoStatus.message}{" "}
            <button type="button" onClick={onRemovePromo} className="underline underline-offset-2">Remove</button>
          </p>
        )}
        {promoStatus.kind === "error" && <p role="alert" className={R_ERROR}>{promoStatus.message}</p>}
        {errors.promoCode && promoStatus.kind !== "error" && <p role="alert" className={R_ERROR}>{errors.promoCode}</p>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
