```tsx
// src/components/admin/landing/promo/PromoCodesManager.tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { Pause, Pencil, Play, Plus, TicketPercent } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/ui/empty-state";
import { useAsyncAction } from "@/hooks/useAsyncAction";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { PromoCode } from "@/lib/landing/registration/promo";
import {
  PROMO_CURRENCIES, PROMO_STATE_LABEL, describeDiscount, draftFromPromo, draftToInput, emptyPromoDraft, normalizeCodeInput,
  optionChoices, patchFromInput, promoState, type PromoDraft, type PromoErrors, type PromoPageOption, type PromoStateKey,
} from "@/lib/landing/registration/promo-form";
import { CONTROL, HELP, LABEL } from "../registration/styles";

const ERROR = "block font-body text-xs font-medium text-pz-danger";
const CHECK_ROW = "flex items-center gap-2 font-body text-sm text-pz-on-surface max-md:min-h-11";
const STATE_CLASS: Record<PromoStateKey, string> = {
  active: "bg-pz-primary-container text-pz-on-primary-container",
  paused: "bg-pz-surface-container-high text-pz-on-surface-variant",
  scheduled: "bg-pz-secondary-container text-pz-on-secondary-container",
  expired: "bg-pz-surface-container-high text-pz-on-surface-variant",
  used_up: "bg-pz-error-container text-pz-on-error-container",
};

function formatPkt(iso: string): string {
  return new Date(iso).toLocaleString("en-GB", { day: "numeric", month: "short", year: "numeric", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", timeZone: "Asia/Karachi" });
}
function datesText(p: PromoCode): string {
  if (p.startsAt && p.endsAt) return `${formatPkt(p.startsAt)} to ${formatPkt(p.endsAt)}`;
  if (p.endsAt) return `Until ${formatPkt(p.endsAt)}`;
  if (p.startsAt) return `From ${formatPkt(p.startsAt)}`;
  return "No end date";
}
function usesText(p: PromoCode): string {
  return p.maxUses === null ? `${p.usedCount} used` : `${p.usedCount} of ${p.maxUses} used`;
}
function whereText(p: PromoCode, pages: PromoPageOption[]): string {
  const where = p.pageIds.length === 0 ? "All pages" : p.pageIds.map((id) => pages.find((x) => x.id === id)?.title ?? "A deleted page").join(", ");
  if (p.optionKeys.length === 0) return where;
  const all = pages.flatMap((x) => x.options);
  return `${where} · only ${p.optionKeys.map((k) => all.find((o) => o.key === k)?.label ?? k).join(", ")}`;
}
const toggleIn = (list: string[], v: string) => (list.includes(v) ? list.filter((x) => x !== v) : [...list, v]);
// Server field names (Task 13's `{ error, field }`) that have a place in this form.
const FORM_FIELDS = ["code", "value", "maxDiscountPercent", "fixedAmounts", "pageIds", "maxUses", "startsAt", "endsAt"] as const;

type Editing = { mode: "new" } | { mode: "edit"; promo: PromoCode } | null;

export function PromoCodesManager({ codes, pages }: { codes: PromoCode[]; pages: PromoPageOption[] }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<Editing>(null);
  const now = new Date();

  const { run: toggleActive, pendingKey } = useAsyncAction(async (p: PromoCode) => {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/admin/landing-promo-codes/${p.id}`, {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ active: !p.active }),
      });
      const body = (await res.json().catch(() => null)) as { error?: string } | null;
      if (!res.ok) { toast.error(body?.error ?? "Could not update the promo code."); return; }
      toast.success(p.active ? `${p.code} paused.` : `${p.code} is active again.`);
      router.refresh();
    } catch {
      toast.error("Could not reach the server. Please try again.");
    }
  }, { getKey: (p) => p.id });

  const dialog = (
    <Dialog open={editing !== null} onOpenChange={(o) => { if (!o) setEditing(null); }}>
      {editing && (
        <DialogContent className="max-h-[90dvh] overflow-y-auto sm:max-w-2xl">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>{editing.mode === "edit" ? `Edit ${editing.promo.code}` : "New promo code"}</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>The registration form checks the code on the server, so the discount is always exactly what you set here.</DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <PromoForm key={editing.mode === "edit" ? editing.promo.id : "new"} existing={editing.mode === "edit" ? editing.promo : null} pages={pages} onDone={() => setEditing(null)} />
        </DialogContent>
      )}
    </Dialog>
  );

  if (codes.length === 0) {
    return (
      <>
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-pz-outline-variant bg-pz-surface-container-lowest">
          <EmptyState
            icon={TicketPercent}
            title="No promo codes yet"
            description="Make a code like PZ10 for 10% off, for one page or for every page."
            action={{ label: "Create your first code", onClick: () => setEditing({ mode: "new" }) }}
          />
        </div>
        {dialog}
      </>
    );
  }

  const actions = (p: PromoCode) => (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-1">
      <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="sm" aria-label={`Edit ${p.code}`} onClick={() => setEditing({ mode: "edit", promo: p })}>
        <Pencil aria-hidden="true" /> Edit
      </Button>
      <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="sm" aria-label={`${p.active ? "Pause" : "Resume"} ${p.code}`} disabled={pendingKey === p.id} onClick={() => void toggleActive(p)}>
        {p.active ? <Pause aria-hidden="true" /> : <Play aria-hidden="true" />}
        {p.active ? "Pause" : "Resume"}
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
  const stateChip = (p: PromoCode) => {
    const s = promoState(p, now);
    return <span className={cn("inline-flex rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 font-body text-xs font-semibold", STATE_CLASS[s])}>{PROMO_STATE_LABEL[s]}</span>;
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex justify-end">
        <Button type="button" onClick={() => setEditing({ mode: "new" })}>
          <Plus aria-hidden="true" /> New promo code
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* Phone: cards */}
      <ul className="space-y-3 md:hidden">
        {codes.map((p) => (
          <li key={p.id} className="space-y-2 rounded-xl border border-pz-outline-variant bg-pz-surface-container-lowest p-4">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <span className="font-mono text-base font-bold text-pz-on-surface">{p.code}</span>
              {stateChip(p)}
            </div>
            <p className="font-body text-sm text-pz-on-surface">{describeDiscount(p)}</p>
            <p className={HELP}>{whereText(p, pages)}</p>
            <p className={HELP}>{`${usesText(p)} · ${datesText(p)}`}</p>
            {actions(p)}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>

      {/* Laptop: table */}
      <div className="hidden overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border border-pz-outline-variant bg-pz-surface-container-lowest md:block">
        <table aria-label="Promo codes" className="w-full text-left text-sm">
          <thead className="bg-pz-surface-container-high font-headline text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-pz-on-surface-variant">
            <tr>
              <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Code</th>
              <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Discount</th>
              <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Works on</th>
              <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Uses</th>
              <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Dates (Pakistan time)</th>
              <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Status</th>
              <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-semibold">Actions</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-pz-outline-variant">
            {codes.map((p) => (
              <tr key={p.id}>
                <td className="px-4 py-3 font-mono font-bold text-pz-on-surface">{p.code}</td>
                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-pz-on-surface">{describeDiscount(p)}</td>
                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-pz-on-surface-variant">{whereText(p, pages)}</td>
                <td className="px-4 py-3 tabular-nums text-pz-on-surface-variant">{usesText(p)}</td>
                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-pz-on-surface-variant">{datesText(p)}</td>
                <td className="px-4 py-3">{stateChip(p)}</td>
                <td className="px-4 py-3">{actions(p)}</td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
      {dialog}
    </div>
  );
}

function PromoForm({ existing, pages, onDone }: { existing: PromoCode | null; pages: PromoPageOption[]; onDone: () => void }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [d, setD] = useState<PromoDraft>(() => (existing ? draftFromPromo(existing) : emptyPromoDraft()));
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<PromoErrors>({});
  const formRef = useRef<HTMLFormElement>(null);
  const set = (patch: Partial<PromoDraft>) => setD((x) => ({ ...x, ...patch }));
  const choices = optionChoices(pages, d.scope === "pages" ? d.pageIds : []);

  // Keyboard and screen-reader users land on the first field that needs fixing.
  useEffect(() => {
    formRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[aria-invalid="true"]')?.focus();
  }, [errors]);

  const { run: save, pending } = useAsyncAction(async () => {
    const available = new Set(choices.map((c) => c.key));
    const checked = draftToInput({ ...d, optionKeys: d.optionKeys.filter((k) => available.has(k)) }, existing?.ownerAgentId ?? null);
    if (!checked.ok) { setErrors(checked.errors); return; }
    setErrors({});
    const code = checked.input.code;
    try {
      const res = await fetch(existing ? `/api/admin/landing-promo-codes/${existing.id}` : "/api/admin/landing-promo-codes", {
        method: existing ? "PATCH" : "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(existing ? patchFromInput(checked.input) : checked.input),
      });
      const body = (await res.json().catch(() => null)) as { error?: string; field?: string } | null;
      if (res.status === 409) { setErrors({ code: body?.error ?? `${code} already exists. Choose another code.` }); return; }
      const field = body?.field?.split(".")[0];
      if (res.status === 400 && body?.error && field && (FORM_FIELDS as readonly string[]).includes(field)) {
        setErrors({ [field]: body.error } as PromoErrors);
        return;
      }
      if (!res.ok) { toast.error(body?.error ?? "Could not save the promo code."); return; }
      toast.success(existing ? `${code} saved.` : `${code} created.`);
      router.refresh();
      onDone();
    } catch {
      toast.error("Could not reach the server. Please try again.");
    }
  });

  const invalid = (k: keyof PromoErrors) => (errors[k] ? true : undefined);

  return (
    <form ref={formRef} noValidate onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); void save(); }} className="space-y-5">
      <label className="block space-y-1">
        <span className={LABEL}>Code</span>
        <span className={`block ${HELP}`}>
          {existing ? "Codes can't be renamed. Make a new code instead." : "What people type, for example PZ10. Capital letters, numbers, - and _ only."}
        </span>
        <input
          aria-label="Code" aria-invalid={invalid("code")} readOnly={!!existing} maxLength={40} autoComplete="off"
          className={cn(CONTROL, "font-mono uppercase")} value={d.code} onChange={(e) => set({ code: normalizeCodeInput(e.target.value) })}
        />
        {errors.code && <span role="alert" className={ERROR}>{errors.code}</span>}
      </label>

      <fieldset className="space-y-2">
        <legend className={LABEL}>Discount</legend>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-4">
          <label className={CHECK_ROW}><input type="radio" name="promo-type" checked={d.type === "percent"} onChange={() => set({ type: "percent" })} />Percentage off</label>
          <label className={CHECK_ROW}><input type="radio" name="promo-type" checked={d.type === "fixed"} onChange={() => set({ type: "fixed" })} />Fixed amount off</label>
        </div>
        {d.type === "percent" ? (
          <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <label className="block space-y-1">
              <span className={LABEL}>Percent off</span>
              <input aria-label="Percent off" aria-invalid={invalid("value")} type="number" inputMode="numeric" min={1} max={100} className={CONTROL} value={d.value} onChange={(e) => set({ value: e.target.value })} />
              {errors.value && <span role="alert" className={ERROR}>{errors.value}</span>}
            </label>
            <label className="block space-y-1">
              <span className={LABEL}>Never more than (%)</span>
              <span className={`block ${HELP}`}>Optional. Leave empty for no limit.</span>
              <input aria-label="Never more than (%)" aria-invalid={invalid("maxDiscountPercent")} type="number" inputMode="numeric" min={0} max={100} className={CONTROL} value={d.maxDiscountPercent} onChange={(e) => set({ maxDiscountPercent: e.target.value })} />
              {errors.maxDiscountPercent && <span role="alert" className={ERROR}>{errors.maxDiscountPercent}</span>}
            </label>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <span className={`block ${HELP}`}>Discount on the whole registration, in each currency. Leave a currency empty if the code should not work there.</span>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-3">
              {PROMO_CURRENCIES.map((c) => (
                <label key={c} className="block space-y-1">
                  <span className={LABEL}>{c}</span>
                  <input
                    aria-label={`Amount off in ${c}`} aria-invalid={invalid("fixedAmounts")} type="number" inputMode="numeric" min={0} className={CONTROL}
                    value={d.fixedAmounts[c] ?? ""} onChange={(e) => set({ fixedAmounts: { ...d.fixedAmounts, [c]: e.target.value } })}
                  />
                </label>
              ))}
            </div>
            {errors.fixedAmounts && <span role="alert" className={ERROR}>{errors.fixedAmounts}</span>}
          </div>
        )}
      </fieldset>

      <fieldset className="space-y-2">
        <legend className={LABEL}>Where it works</legend>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-4">
          <label className={CHECK_ROW}><input type="radio" name="promo-scope" checked={d.scope === "all"} onChange={() => set({ scope: "all" })} />All pages</label>
          <label className={CHECK_ROW}><input type="radio" name="promo-scope" checked={d.scope === "pages"} onChange={() => set({ scope: "pages" })} />Only these pages</label>
        </div>
        {d.scope === "pages" && (
          <ul aria-label="Pages" className="max-h-48 space-y-1 overflow-y-auto rounded-lg border border-pz-outline-variant p-2">
            {pages.map((p) => (
              <li key={p.id}>
                <label className={CHECK_ROW}><input type="checkbox" checked={d.pageIds.includes(p.id)} onChange={() => set({ pageIds: toggleIn(d.pageIds, p.id) })} />{p.title}</label>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
        {errors.pageIds && <span role="alert" className={ERROR}>{errors.pageIds}</span>}
        {choices.length > 0 && (
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <span className={`block ${HELP}`}>Only for these options (optional). Leave all unticked for every option.</span>
            <ul aria-label="Options" className="max-h-48 space-y-1 overflow-y-auto rounded-lg border border-pz-outline-variant p-2">
              {choices.map((c) => (
                <li key={c.key}>
                  <label className={CHECK_ROW}><input type="checkbox" checked={d.optionKeys.includes(c.key)} onChange={() => set({ optionKeys: toggleIn(d.optionKeys, c.key) })} />{c.label}</label>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </div>
        )}
      </fieldset>

      <fieldset className="space-y-2">
        <legend className={LABEL}>Limits</legend>
        <label className="block space-y-1 sm:max-w-xs">
          <span className={LABEL}>Total uses (optional)</span>
          <span className={`block ${HELP}`}>Each registration counts once, whatever the group size. Test registrations never count.</span>
          <input aria-label="Total uses" aria-invalid={invalid("maxUses")} type="number" inputMode="numeric" min={1} className={CONTROL} value={d.maxUses} onChange={(e) => set({ maxUses: e.target.value })} />
          {errors.maxUses && <span role="alert" className={ERROR}>{errors.maxUses}</span>}
        </label>
        <label className={CHECK_ROW}><input type="checkbox" checked={d.oneperEmail} onChange={(e) => set({ oneperEmail: e.target.checked })} />One use per email address</label>
      </fieldset>

      <fieldset className="space-y-2">
        <legend className={LABEL}>Dates (Pakistan time)</legend>
        <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <label className="block space-y-1">
            <span className={LABEL}>Starts</span>
            <input aria-label="Starts" aria-invalid={invalid("startsAt")} type="datetime-local" className={CONTROL} value={d.startsAt} onChange={(e) => set({ startsAt: e.target.value })} />
            {errors.startsAt && <span role="alert" className={ERROR}>{errors.startsAt}</span>}
          </label>
          <label className="block space-y-1">
            <span className={LABEL}>Ends</span>
            <input aria-label="Ends" aria-invalid={invalid("endsAt")} type="datetime-local" className={CONTROL} value={d.endsAt} onChange={(e) => set({ endsAt: e.target.value })} />
            {errors.endsAt && <span role="alert" className={ERROR}>{errors.endsAt}</span>}
          </label>
        </div>
        <p className={HELP}>Leave both empty for a code that works until you pause it.</p>
      </fieldset>

      <label className={CHECK_ROW}><input type="checkbox" checked={d.active} onChange={(e) => set({ active: e.target.checked })} />Code is active</label>

      <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 border-t border-pz-outline-variant pt-3">
        <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={onDone}>Cancel</Button>
        <Button type="submit" disabled={pending} aria-busy={pending || undefined}>
          {pending ? "Saving…" : existing ? "Save changes" : "Create code"}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// src/components/admin/landing/promo/AgentLinksPanel.tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { Copy, Link2 } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { useAsyncAction } from "@/hooks/useAsyncAction";
import { agentLinkUrl, type AgentChoice, type LinkPage } from "@/lib/landing/registration/promo-form";
import { CONTROL, HELP, LABEL } from "../registration/styles";

/**
 * Ruling 8: an admin makes a sales agent's share link. The code belongs to the agent (one per
 * agent, created on first use by Task 13's route); the page only changes the path.
 */
export function AgentLinksPanel({ agents, pages }: { agents: AgentChoice[]; pages: LinkPage[] }) {
  const [agentId, setAgentId] = useState(agents[0]?.id ?? "");
  const [slug, setSlug] = useState(pages[0]?.slug ?? "");
  const [generated, setGenerated] = useState<{ agentId: string; code: string } | null>(null);
  const origin = typeof window === "undefined" ? "" : window.location.origin;
  const link = generated && generated.agentId === agentId && slug ? agentLinkUrl(origin, slug, generated.code) : "";

  const { run: generate, pending } = useAsyncAction(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/landing-agent-links", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ agentId }),
      });
      const body = (await res.json().catch(() => null)) as { code?: string; error?: string } | null;
      if (!res.ok || !body?.code) { toast.error(body?.error ?? "Could not create the link."); return; }
      setGenerated({ agentId, code: body.code });
    } catch {
      toast.error("Could not reach the server. Please try again.");
    }
  });

  const copy = async () => {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(link);
      toast.success("Link copied.");
    } catch {
      toast.error("Could not copy. Select the link and copy it yourself.");
    }
  };

  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="agent-links-heading" className="space-y-4 rounded-xl border border-pz-outline-variant bg-pz-surface-container-lowest p-4 md:p-6">
      <div className="space-y-1">
        <h2 id="agent-links-heading" className="font-headline text-lg font-bold text-pz-on-surface">Agent links</h2>
        <p className={HELP}>Each sales agent has one personal code. People who open their link and register within 30 days are credited to that agent.</p>
      </div>
      {agents.length === 0 ? (
        <p className={HELP}>No sales agents yet. Add one in Sales Team first.</p>
      ) : pages.length === 0 ? (
        <p className={HELP}>Publish a landing page first. Links only work on published pages.</p>
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <label className="block space-y-1">
              <span className={LABEL}>Sales agent</span>
              <select aria-label="Sales agent" className={CONTROL} value={agentId} onChange={(e) => setAgentId(e.target.value)}>
                {agents.map((a) => <option key={a.id} value={a.id}>{a.name}</option>)}
              </select>
            </label>
            <label className="block space-y-1">
              <span className={LABEL}>Page</span>
              <select aria-label="Page" className={CONTROL} value={slug} onChange={(e) => setSlug(e.target.value)}>
                {pages.map((p) => <option key={p.slug} value={p.slug}>{p.title}</option>)}
              </select>
            </label>
          </div>
          <Button type="button" onClick={() => void generate()} disabled={pending || !agentId} aria-busy={pending || undefined}>
            <Link2 aria-hidden="true" /> {pending ? "Generating…" : "Generate link"}
          </Button>
          {link && (
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <label className="block space-y-1">
                <span className={LABEL}>Share link</span>
                <input aria-label="Share link" readOnly className={`${CONTROL} font-mono`} value={link} onFocus={(e) => e.currentTarget.select()} />
              </label>
              <Button type="button" variant="outline" aria-label="Copy share link" onClick={() => void copy()}>
                <Copy aria-hidden="true" /> Copy
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}
```

(While generating, the button text is "Generating…"; its accessible name returns to "Generate link" afterwards, which the tests rely on.)

```tsx
// src/app/dashboard/admin/landing-promo-codes/page.tsx
import { requireAdminPage } from "@/lib/auth/require-admin";
import { listPromoCodes } from "@/lib/data/landing-promo-codes";
import { getLandingPage, listLandingPages } from "@/lib/data/landing-pages";
import { listSalesAgents } from "@/lib/data/sales-agents";
import { PromoCodesManager } from "@/components/admin/landing/promo/PromoCodesManager";
import { AgentLinksPanel } from "@/components/admin/landing/promo/AgentLinksPanel";
import type { AgentChoice, LinkPage, PromoPageOption } from "@/lib/landing/registration/promo-form";

export const metadata = { title: "Promo Codes — PZ Academy" };

export default async function AdminPromoCodesPage() {
  await requireAdminPage();
  const [codes, summaries, salesAgents] = await Promise.all([listPromoCodes(), listLandingPages(), listSalesAgents()]);
  // Option names come from each page's draft registration settings (what admins edit);
  // getLandingPage runs normalizeContent, so draft.registration is always present (Task 2).
  const full = await Promise.all(summaries.map((s) => getLandingPage(s.id)));
  const pages: PromoPageOption[] = full.flatMap((p) =>
    p ? [{ id: p.id, title: p.title, options: p.draft.registration.options.map((o) => ({ key: o.key, label: o.label })) }] : [],
  );
  const agents: AgentChoice[] = salesAgents.map((a) => ({ id: a.id, name: a.fullName || a.email || "Unnamed agent" }));
  const linkPages: LinkPage[] = summaries.filter((s) => s.status === "published").map((s) => ({ slug: s.slug, title: s.title }));

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div>
        <h1 className="font-headline font-bold text-2xl text-pz-secondary">Promo Codes</h1>
        <p className="font-body text-pz-on-surface-variant text-sm mt-1">
          Discount codes for the registration form on your landing pages. The server checks every code, so a made-up code never gives a discount.
        </p>
      </div>
      <PromoCodesManager codes={codes} pages={pages} />
      <AgentLinksPanel agents={agents} pages={linkPages} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
describe("reduced motion", () => {
  const dir = path.join(process.cwd(), "src/components/landing/registration");
  it("every animation class in the public registration UI is behind motion-safe", () => {
    const MOTION = /[\w:[\]=!/-]*(?:animate-(?!none)[\w-]+|slide-(?:in|out)[\w-]*|fade-(?:in|out)[\w-]*|zoom-(?:in|out)[\w-]*|\bscale-\d+)/g;
    for (const f of fs.readdirSync(dir).filter((n) => /\.(tsx|ts)$/.test(n))) {
      const src = fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, f), "utf8");
      for (const token of src.match(MOTION) ?? []) {
        expect(token.includes("motion-safe:") || token.includes("motion-reduce:"), `${f}: ${token}`).toBe(true);
      }
    }
  });
  it("the global stylesheet switches animations off when the OS asks", () => {
    const css = fs.readFileSync(path.join(process.cwd(), "src/app/globals.css"), "utf8");
    expect(css).toMatch(/@media \(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce\)/);
    expect(css).toMatch(/animation-duration:\s*0\.01ms !important/);
  });
});

describe("colour contrast of the landing palette (WCAG AA, 4.5:1 for text)", () => {
  function landingColors(): Record<string, string> {
    const src = fs.readFileSync(path.join(process.cwd(), "tailwind.config.ts"), "utf8");
    const block = /\blanding:\s*\{([\s\S]*?)\n\s*\}/.exec(src);
    if (!block) throw new Error("landing colour group not found in tailwind.config.ts");
    const out: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const m of block[1].matchAll(/'?([a-z-]+)'?\s*:\s*'(#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6})'/g)) out[m[1]] = m[2];
    return out;
  }
  const lum = (hex: string) => {
    const [r, g, b] = [1, 3, 5]
      .map((i) => parseInt(hex.slice(i, i + 2), 16) / 255)
      .map((c) => (c <= 0.03928 ? c / 12.92 : ((c + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4));
    return 0.2126 * r + 0.7152 * g + 0.0722 * b;
  };
  const ratio = (a: string, b: string) => {
    const [hi, lo] = [lum(a), lum(b)].sort((x, y) => y - x);
    return (hi + 0.05) / (lo + 0.05);
  };
  const c = landingColors();
  it.each([
    ["on-surface", "surface"], ["on-surface", "surface-container-lowest"],
    ["muted", "surface"], ["muted", "surface-container-lowest"], ["muted", "surface-container-low"], ["muted", "mint-light"],
    ["near-black", "surface-container-low"], ["near-black", "mint-light"],
    ["primary", "surface"], ["primary", "surface-container-lowest"], ["primary", "mint-light"],
    ["deep", "surface-container-lowest"], ["deep", "mint-light"],
    ["on-primary", "primary"], ["on-primary", "primary-hover"],
    ["near-black", "whatsapp"], ["near-black", "whatsapp-hover"],
  ])("%s text on %s", (fg, bg) => {
    expect(c[fg], fg).toBeTruthy();
    expect(c[bg], bg).toBeTruthy();
    expect(ratio(c[fg], c[bg])).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4.5);
  });
  it("white on the WhatsApp green would fail, which is why the Join buttons use near-black text", () => {
    expect(ratio(c["on-primary"], c.whatsapp)).toBeLessThan(4.5);
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Return focus to the opener**

`src/components/landing/registration/registration-bus.ts`. Before:

```ts
type Listener = () => void;
const listeners = new Set<Listener>();
let pendingOpen = false;

export function openRegistration(): void {
  if (listeners.size === 0) { pendingOpen = true; return; }
  for (const l of Array.from(listeners)) l();
}
```

After:

```ts
type Listener = () => void;
const listeners = new Set<Listener>();
let pendingOpen = false;
let opener: HTMLElement | null = null;

/** `from` is the Register button that was pressed; focus goes back to it when the form closes. */
export function openRegistration(from?: HTMLElement | null): void {
  opener = from ?? null;
  if (listeners.size === 0) { pendingOpen = true; return; }
  for (const l of Array.from(listeners)) l();
}

/** The element that last opened the form, handed out once. */
export function takeOpener(): HTMLElement | null {
  const el = opener;
  opener = null;
  return el;
}
```

After:


```tsx
          onCloseAutoFocus={(e) => {

            const el = takeOpener();
            if (el && el.isConnected) {
              e.preventDefault();
              el.focus();
```

- [ ] **Step 10: Manual pass at 390 / 820 / 1280 px (dev server, Chrome)**

Use Chrome DevTools device toolbar with exact widths 390 (iPhone 12-15), 820 (iPad Air) and 1280 (laptop). On a published ZZ page, logged out, then as `hamzaansari4you@gmail.com`:

1. **Registration modal, every step and the success screen.** 390: full-screen sheet, sticky top bar (title, back arrow from step 2, close) and sticky bottom bar (total + Continue) never cover a field; the page behind does not scroll; no sideways scroll at any step; the on-screen keyboard does not hide the focused field (iOS Safari or Chrome Android if available). 820: two columns with the "Your order" panel visible; nothing clipped. 1280: 960 px two-column modal centred. Inputs never zoom the page on focus (16 px text).
2. **Keyboard only** (no mouse): Tab into the Register button, Enter opens the form, focus lands inside it; Tab cycles inside the dialog only; arrow keys move between country chips and between radio options; Space ticks checkboxes; Continue with empty fields moves focus to the first problem; Escape closes and focus returns to the same Register button; Copy buttons work with Enter. Every focused control shows a visible ring.
3. **Screen reader** (NVDA on Windows with Chrome): the dialog is announced with its "Register · <event>" name; each step heading is read on arrival; errors are read when they appear; the step list reads "1 Choose (done)"; the success heading is read; the reference number and the Copy button's "Copy reference number" are announced.
4. **Reduced motion:** DevTools > Rendering > "Emulate CSS media feature prefers-reduced-motion: reduce": the modal and admin dialogs appear without sliding or zooming.

- [ ] **Step 3: Create the bundle and caching check**

```js
// scripts/check-landing-bundle.mjs
// Production-build checks for the public landing pages.
//   node scripts/check-landing-bundle.mjs                       after `next build`
//   node scripts/check-landing-bundle.mjs --url <page url>      also checks caching, with `next start` running
// Exit codes: 0 PASS, 1 FAIL, 2 no usable build.
import { existsSync, readFileSync, readdirSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { gzipSync } from "node:zlib";

const nextDir = join(process.cwd(), ".next");
// Text that exists only inside the lazily loaded registration modal (StepPay, StepUpload, SuccessScreen).
const MARKERS = ["Choose how you pay", "Upload your payment receipt", "Check your registration status"];
// What a visitor downloads before touching Register: the page plus the layouts around it.
const ENTRIES = ["/e/[slug]/page", "/e/layout", "/layout"];

let failed = false;
const fail = (message) => { console.error(`FAIL: ${message}`); failed = true; };

function walk(dir, out = []) {
  for (const e of readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    const p = join(dir, e.name);
    if (e.isDirectory()) walk(p, out);
    else if (e.name.endsWith(".js")) out.push(p);
  }
  return out;
}

const manifestPath = join(nextDir, "app-build-manifest.json");
if (!existsSync(manifestPath)) {
  console.error("No production build in .next. Stop the dev server, then run: node node_modules/next/dist/bin/next build");
  process.exit(2);
}
const pages = JSON.parse(readFileSync(manifestPath, "utf8")).pages ?? {};
if (!pages["/e/[slug]/page"]) {
  console.error('"/e/[slug]/page" is missing from .next/app-build-manifest.json');
  process.exit(2);
}

const files = [...new Set(ENTRIES.flatMap((k) => pages[k] ?? []))].filter((f) => f.endsWith(".js"));
let raw = 0;
let gz = 0;
for (const f of files) {
  const buf = readFileSync(join(nextDir, f));
  raw += buf.length;
  gz += gzipSync(buf).length;
  const text = buf.toString("utf8");
  for (const m of MARKERS) if (text.includes(m)) fail(`first-load file ${f} contains registration modal text "${m}"`);
}
console.log(`/e/[slug] first-load JS: ${files.length} files, ${(raw / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB raw, ${(gz / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB gzipped`);

const lazy = walk(join(nextDir, "static", "chunks")).filter((p) => readFileSync(p, "utf8").includes(MARKERS[0]));
if (lazy.length === 0) fail(`no chunk contains "${MARKERS[0]}": the modal text changed, update MARKERS in this script`);
else console.log(`Registration modal lives in ${lazy.length} lazily loaded chunk(s).`);

const at = process.argv.indexOf("--url");
if (at > 0 && process.argv[at + 1]) {
  const page = process.argv[at + 1].replace(/\/$/, "");
  for (const url of [page, `${page}/status`]) {
    for (let n = 0; n < 2; n++) {
      const res = await fetch(url, { redirect: "manual" });
      const cc = res.headers.get("cache-control") ?? "";
      console.log(`${url} -> ${res.status}; cache-control: ${cc}; x-nextjs-cache: ${res.headers.get("x-nextjs-cache") ?? "-"}`);
      if (res.status !== 200) fail(`${url} answered ${res.status}`);
      if (/no-store|private/.test(cc) || !/s-maxage=/.test(cc)) fail(`${url} is not served as a cached static page`);
    }
  }
}

if (failed) process.exit(1);
console.log("PASS");
```
